 Hong Kong Crisis

values.label: SCRIPT:CHI02AudioHolder01
values.text:
<Red Guard speaking> 
 'General, we're all that's left of the assault force! We need to build a Command Center and get the radar up to receive new orders'

values.label: SCRIPT:CHI02AudioHolder02
values.text:
<Red Guard speaking> 
 'General, if we don't get our radar up we can't receive intelligence on the enemy's position. We need that radar'

values.label: SCRIPT:CHI02AudioHolder03
values.text:
<'EVA' speaking> 
 'General, you're alive!?! We thought we lost you when the bridge went down. Well, you're not out of danger yet, so let's get started'

values.label: SCRIPT:CHI02AudioHolder04
values.text:
<'EVA' speaking> 
 'First, you're going to need to finish your base. The barracks, reactor, and supply center are all essential to your survival, so finish constructing them immediately. I'll contact you again once your base is complete'

values.label: SCRIPT:CHI02AudioHolder05
values.text:
<'EVA' speaking> 
 'Excellent, your base is complete, except for a War Factory. We need to get you one now. There should be a surplus base--with a War Factory--here'

values.label: SCRIPT:CHI02AudioHolder06
values.text:
<'EVA' speaking> 
 'I don't know what condition the base is in, but it should allow you to build armored units to help your fight. Get there as soon as possible, General.'

values.label: SCRIPT:CHI02AudioHolder07
values.text:
<'EVA' speaking> 
 'Now we know the GLA's reason for coming to Hong Kong: They're targeting key buildings around the city. Our main objective is to destroy all of the GLA's forces, but if we can also keep them from destroying those buildings, our leaders would be most grateful.'

values.label: SCRIPT:CHI02AudioHolder08
values.text:
<'EVA' speaking> 
 'If you can keep your radar operating, I can track the Terrorists for you and give you their possible targets.'

values.label: SCRIPT:CHI02AudioHolder09
values.text:
<'EVA' speaking> 
 'General, a Terrorist is leaving the Convention Center, and he's strapped with enough explosives to bring down a building! I'll mark the Terrorist in red on your radar. I'll mark his possible targets in yellow. Stop him before he reaches one of those targets!'

values.label: SCRIPT:CHI02AudioHolder10
values.text:
<'EVA' speaking> 
 'Another Terrorist has left the Convention Center! I'll mark his location in red. His possible targets are marked in yellow. Stop him, General.'

values.label: SCRIPT:CHI02AudioHolder11
values.text:
<'EVA' speaking> 
 'General, this building is a Terrorist target--we must protect it!'

values.label: SCRIPT:CHI02AudioHolder12
values.text:
<'EVA' speaking> 
 'General, the Terrorists have taken over the Convention Center! You're going to have to destroy the Convention Center and the attached parking structures to stop the Terrorist threat.'

values.label: SCRIPT:CHI02AudioHolder13
values.text:
<'EVA' speaking> 
 'Excellent, you've reached the surplus base. Hmm, it's not much to look at, but it will allow you to build tanks, and more War Factories, if you need.'

values.label: SCRIPT:CHI02AudioHolder14
values.text:
<'EVA' speaking> 
 'The Terrorist threat is finished. Good work, General.'

values.label: SCRIPT:CHI02AudioHolder15
values.text:
<'EVA' speaking> 
 'General, I've detected GLA armored units on the move. They didn't come from the Convention Center, so the GLA must have another base somewhere in Hong Kong. Find that base and destroy it!'

values.label: SCRIPT:CHI02AudioHolder16
values.text:
<'EVA' speaking> 
 'General, the GLA have brought their Toxin Tractors with them. You'll know them by the green ooze they spray. Keep your infantry units away from them and use your tanks to deal with this new threat.'

values.label: SCRIPT:CHI02AudioHolder17
values.text:
<'EVA' speaking> 
 'Good work, General, you've destroyed the Toxin base. Now they shouldn't be able to build any more Toxin Tractors.'

values.label: SCRIPT:CHI02AudioHolder18
values.text:
<'EVA' speaking> 
 'Wait, General, there is a large force up ahead. I'll call for an EMP strike to clear the area, standby.'

values.label: SCRIPT:CHI02AudioHolder19
values.text:
<'EVA' speaking> 
 'That should give you a clear path to their base. Let's finish this, General.'

values.label: SCRIPT:CHI02AudioHolder20
values.text:
<AutoFerry Capt. speaking> 
 'Finally, the military is here! Those Terrorists are ruining my business! If you put your forces aboard I'll take you out to the Convention Center. You can sneak in the backdoor and catch them by surprise. Jut hit the Transport button when you're ready.'

values.label: SCRIPT:TrainingMove
values.text: Left click on units to select them. Selected units can be given commands. With a unit selected you can left click on the ground to give them a move command. Left click on enemy soldiers to order your selected unit to attack

values.label: SCRIPT:TrainingCommand
values.text: You have liberated a USA Command Center. Here you can use many of your special abilities. To choose technologies and special weapons click on the flashing General button

values.label: SCRIPT:TrainingExplor
values.text: The Fog of War around your units can be pushed back by moving into new and unexplored areas. The Fog shows you where you have explored and where you have not. Explore new areas to find enemy forces and resources to expand your army

values.label: SCRIPT:TrainingBarracks
values.text: You have liberated a USA Barracks. Buildings like this allow you to train new units. The Barracks trains soldiers. Left click on your new Barracks to see what soldiers you can train. Left click on a unit in the Barracks to spend the supplies to create that unit

values.label: SCRIPT:TrainingPilots
values.text: You have freed several Pilots. USA pilots are often veterans of many battles and they can enter your vehicles to provide their skills and experience to the crew of the vehicle. Vehicles with golden chevrons near them have experienced crews and are more effective in combat

values.label: SCRIPT:TrainingSupply
values.text: You have liberated a USA Supply Center. Supply Centers collect supplies, providing you with the resources to build new buildings and units. Each Supply Center automatically generates a single Chinook helicopter that will gather supplies for you

values.label: SCRIPT:TrainingDozer
values.text: You have liberated a USA Construction Dozer. Left click on your new Construction Dozer to see what buildings it can create. Select the War Factory and choose a location for it to be built. Once done creating the War Factory, the Dozer will be available for other construction projects

values.label: SCRIPT:TrainingUnits
values.text: Your new War Factory can be used to build vehicles like Crusader Tanks. Left click on a Crusader Tank to order it to be built. You can left click multiple times to order multiple tanks to be constructed

values.label: SCRIPT:TrainingPower
values.text: You have liberated a USA Cold Fusion Reactor. Reactors are used by American and Chinese forces to power their base. Your power bar indicates how much power your base has. If your base runs low on power base defenses may go off-line and your radar will go out

values.label: SCRIPT:TrainingAbilities
values.text: Some units have special abilities. Select a unit to see what special powers it has. Left click on the power to activate it. In the case of the USA Crusader Tank, each tank can build a single Battle Drone. Battle Drones are small robotic helpers that automatically engage enemies and repair their Crusader Tank in case it is damaged by enemy fire

values.label: SCRIPT:TrainingObjective
values.text: You have liberated an entire USA base and are now ready to carry the fight to the enemy. Each mission has mission objectives that you must follow in order to win the mission and to progress in your war against your enemies. Follow the mission objective to win the mission

values.label: SCRIPT:TrainingUrban
values.text: Civilian buildings can be occupied by soldiers. Order your soldiers to enter civilian buildings to get a defensive bonus. Civilian buildings occupied in this way are powerful strong-points for your troops and can be used to defend important routes into and out of your base

values.label: SCRIPT:TrainingTech
values.text: Civilian Objective Buildings can be captured by your Rangers. Holding these buildings will give you advantages against your enemies. Capture the Oil Derricks by selecting a Ranger, left clicking the capture button and then left clicking on the Oil Derrick itself. Oil Derricks provide you with additional resources as they pump oil

values.label: SCRIPT:TrainingCrate
values.text: Crates contain bonus items for your soldiers that will increase their abilities. Additional ammunition, armor and other items can be found in crates. Order your soldiers or vehicles to move onto a crate to open it and collect the contents

values.label: ACADEMY:Eva
values.text: Tactical Analysis

values.label: ACADEMY:BuildAllStructures
values.text: When you're on the battlefield it's important to utilize all the tools available to you, General. Make sure you build all the structures. You must maintain a strong military force

values.label: ACADEMY:BuildSupplyCenterEarlier
values.text: General, one of the most important functions of a strong leader is making sure that the soldiers have plenty of supplies. We suggest that you make sure to build a Supply Center or Stash whenever you begin a mission. Supplies bring you cash and cash brings you victory

values.label: ACADEMY:TryBuildingRadar
values.text: The Fog of War surrounds us all. One helpful way to see through the pea soup is via radar. Each faction is unique in how it obtains the eye in the sky. The USA Command Center automatically comes with radar, the Chinese Command Center must be upgraded and the GLA must build a Radar Van from its Arms Dealer

values.label: ACADEMY:BuildMorePeons
values.text: If you ask any other Generals they'll confirm a simple rule: The grunts make the army. In order to build your base you'll need to put your Dozers or Workers to work. These guys are key to your future success so don't forget them!

values.label: ACADEMY:TryCapturingStructures
values.text: General, sometimes it's easier to take what you want rather than work for it. If you build the "Capture" upgrade from your Barracks you'll be able to steal enemy structures. There are also Tech Buildings littered around the battlefield that can enhance your army even further

values.label: ACADEMY:SpendGeneralsPoints
values.text: With war come the spoils. Every time you destroy an enemy you'll earn your way toward more Generals Points. These can be spent by pressing the "star" button on the right side of the Command Bar. Simply open the Generals Points menu and spend your hard earned points on some new war toys

values.label: ACADEMY:TryUsingSuperweapons
values.text: What's the use of collecting Generals points if you don't use them? If you've purchased Generals Powers by using your points an icon will pop up on the right side of the screen. Simply press it and watch the fireworks begin. The more points you spend, the more powerful the power

values.label: ACADEMY:TryGarrisoningAStructure
values.text: Soldiers can be effective in the open, but are deadlier when garrisoned inside civilian buildings. Select your soldiers and send them into an empty structure. They'll be protected by the walls - unless a Flash Bang, Toxin Tractor or Dragon Tank comes their way

values.label: ACADEMY:IdleBuildingUnits
values.text: General, fielding and leading a great army should be your highest goal. Make sure you're building your fighting units by clicking on a Barracks, War Factory, Airfield, etc. and then clicking a respective picture in the bottom Command Bar. It will be money well spent and will help you achieve victory

values.label: ACADEMY:TryDragSelectingUnits
values.text: Manipulating your army is one of the trickiest things a General must learn. While you can click on each individual unit, it's usually faster to "lasso" a group of units. Simply click and drag the box around the units. They will now be in your control. If you click on another area the units will move to this spot

values.label: ACADEMY:ResearchUpgrades
values.text: A great General can make a lot of tanks, but a greater General can make a lot of better tanks. Almost every unit has some form of upgrade. It's often best to spend your money on improving what you already have

values.label: ACADEMY:RanOutOfPower
values.text: While the GLA has no need for power, China and the USA eat it up like popcorn. To keep a base running strong a General needs to spend money on plenty of power to supply the war machine. Make sure to build a Cold Fusion Reactor or a Nuclear Reactor for maximum output. Low power can mean a low success rate

values.label: ACADEMY:BuildMoreGatherers
values.text: General, make sure you're building plenty of Workers, Supply Trucks or Chinooks to keep your income flowing. You can make extra gatherers by clicking on rescource gatherer's picture in the Supply Center or Stash. Don't be shy about maximizing your resource potential

values.label: ACADEMY:BuildAHero
values.text: Jarmen Kell, Col. Burton and Black Lotus can be invaluable to your strategy. These heroes can turn the tide of a battle and are invisible to the enemy. To locate your hero on the radar, look for the cross hair icon. Though you can only build one at a time don't underestimate their importance

values.label: ACADEMY:PickStrategyCenterPlan
values.text: The US Strategy Center is a very helpful structure. You should remember to choose the strategy that best fits your gameplan. Search & Destroy, Bombardment and Hold the Line are all excellent ways to give you the edge you need. Along with these overall strategies you can purchase many upgrades from this building

values.label: ACADEMY:UseTunnelNetwork
values.text: When it comes to the GLA sneaking around the battlefield is their calling card. Tunnel Networks offer defense capabilities but they also allow the player to move around quickly. Simply build a few Tunnel Networks and send your units inside. Click on the structure and you can expel them from any other Tunnel Network anywhere on the map. They are key to the overall GLA strategy

values.label: ACADEMY:UseControlGroups
values.text: Managing a large army can be a bit unruly sometimes. One way to manage lots of units easily is by creating a "control group". Simply select the group of units in question and press "Ctrl" & a number at the same time. Now anytime you press this number, the group of units will be selected. Tap the number twice quickly and the camera view will center over the group

values.label: ACADEMY:UseSecondaryIncomeMethods
values.text: General, acquiring supplies later in a mission can be difficult. Each faction has a unique way to gain funds during long battles. China can build Hackers and an Internet Center. You can direct the Hackers to hack the internet for funds anywhere or just send them inside Internet Center to gain money even quicker. The GLA depends on the Black Market and the USA relies on the Supply Drop. If you don't plan ahead you may have shortages

values.label: ACADEMY:ClearBuildings
values.text: Garrisoned buildings can be tough to handle - unless you know some tricks. Upgrade your USA Rangers with Flash Bangs, build GLA Toxin Tractors or Chinese Dragon Tanks to quickly clear out these strong points. The USA also can upgrade to the Bunker Buster to even clear out Tunnel Networks!

values.label: ACADEMY:PickUpSalvage
values.text: The GLA is a sneaky bunch but they're also resourceful. Whenever the GLA units destroy another vehicle a salvage bonus is left behind. Roll over the salvaged parts to upgrade your units, gain veterancy or get some extra cash. Salvage can make a big difference in a long fight so don't leave it just lying around

values.label: ACADEMY:UseGuardAbility
values.text: Sometimes it's important that units stay put and guard a particular area. Simply select the unit and press the "shield" button or "G" key and then select the area to be guarded. The unit will attack any enemies that enter its guard radius

values.label: ACADEMY:MultipleSupplyCenters
values.text: Supplies are the name on the game, General. They can be gathered at Supply Docks littered around the battlefield. While one dock may be enough early on it's usually best to branch out and find a few more during a mission. You'll need to build a Supply Center or Stash close to the Supply Dock to ensure efficient collection

values.label: ACADEMY:GarrionVehicle
values.text: Some units may enter or steal other vehicles. Stealing vehicles with Hijackers or Terrorists can allow you to sneak into enemy territory

values.label: ACADEMY:UseSelectionHotkeys
values.text: General, hotkeys are a great way to enhance your control of your forces. "E" will select all of the same unit types on the view screen. If you tap "E" twice quickly it will select all the same type across the entire battlefield. "Q" will select all your combat units on the map. "W" will select all your air units on the map. Give them a try, they'll help you out

values.label: ACADEMY:AlternateMouseInterface
values.text: One new addition is the "Alternate Mouse Interface" option located in the Options Menu. If you are used to commanding armies using right click as your action button then this may help you get a better handle on your army

values.label: ACADEMY:DoubleClickAttackMoveGuard
values.text: General, we have created a new way to direct your army. Simply select your units and double click the destination area. Your units will attack-move to the spot and then guard it. You may enable this through the options menu

values.label: ACADEMY:BuildBarracksSooner
values.text: In order to create a well balanced force you must build a Barracks earlier in the mission. Infantry can make or break your gameplan so it's best not to forget them

values.label: ACADEMY:BuildWarFactorySooner
values.text: While infantry and airpower can be great assets nothing quite beats a good tank. Be sure to build a War Factory or Arms Dealer earlier in the mission

values.label: ACADEMY:BuildTechStructureSooner
values.text: For the advanced weaponry there is no replacement for a Strategy Center, Propaganda Center or Palace. Don't forget to build one a bit earlier in missions to ensure success

values.label: ACADEMY:NoIncome
values.text: General, it's vital to your success that your income flow continues throughout the mission. Too many gaps lead to losing your edge. Make sure you're keeping the supplies rolling in consistently

values.label: ACADEMY:ClearMines
values.text: Demo Traps and mines can really be the start of a bad day. These sneaky tactics can be combated by using Dozers or Workers to clear these dangerous areas out

values.label: ACADEMY:UnmannedVehicles
values.text: General, some units can snipe or remove enemy drivers of a vehicles. When this occurs the vehicles become neutral and can be "borrowed" from the enemy. Feel free to go for a ride at your enemy's expense

values.label: ACADEMY:DisguisedUnits
values.text: Some units can disguise themselves as other units. There is nothing quite as satisfying as rolling a GLA Bomb Truck into an enemy base undetected and causing lots of havoc. Make sure to use this key tactic to further your battle plan

values.label: ACADEMY:StealthUpgrade
values.text: Some structures can be upgraded to camouflage, like the GLA Tunnel Network or Stinger Sites. These will be invisible to the enemy until its too late. Surprise!

values.label: ACADEMY:Firestorm
values.text: China has the unique ability to create a Firestorm when multiple MiGs or Inferno Cannons target a single enemy or area. Make sure to coordinate your attacks for maximum effect

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI01xBrf01Subtitle
values.text: *General, the GLA managed to defeat the US forces in this area. We launched a devastating counter attack, but like roaches they are still alive

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI01xBrf02Subtitle
values.text: *Even now the GLA survivors are rebuilding

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI01xBrf03Subtitle
values.text: *To finally eliminate the GLA we must send in our forces and root them out of every dark corner in which they hide

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI01xBrf04Subtitle
values.text: *General, our new Listening Outposts are stationed in the area. They are at your disposal

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI01xBrf05Subtitle
values.text: *The Listening Outpost itself is unarmed, however its passengers can fire on enemies that venture too close. You will find its long sight range and stealth ability greatly enhances battlefield awareness

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI01xChat01Subtitle
values.text: *No GLA will slip past our garrison

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI01xChat02Subtitle
values.text: *Toxin Tractors! They're trying to poison us allwe need support!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI01xChat03Subtitle
values.text: *LookOil Derricksshould we capture them?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI01xChat04Subtitle
values.text: *GLA in your home? Apply a little fireno more GLA

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI01xChat05Subtitle
values.text: *The GLA are rebuilding over therestand ready to attack

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI01xChat06Subtitle
values.text: *We will win this dayeveryone advance

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI01xCin01aSubtitle
values.text: *I did not think the United States would be defeated so easily

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI01xCin01bSubtitle
values.text: *I do not understand why the United States has allowed this to happen

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI01xCin01cSubtitle
values.text: *This can not be allowed to stand. China will make things right

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI01xCin01dSubtitle
values.text: *The GLA's treacherous use of our resources against the Americans has caused great embarrassment to China. They must pay for their insolence

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI01xCin02Subtitle
values.text: *The missiles are prepared and ready for launchfinal countdown started

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI01xCin03Subtitle
values.text: *321 Missiles are away

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI01xCin04Subtitle
values.text: *They believe they have won the day, but they celebrate too soon

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI01xCin05Subtitle
values.text: *It is pretty when used for the right reasons

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI01xCin06Subtitle
values.text: *GLA survivors are running to town for coverthey must be stopped!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI01xCin07Subtitle
values.text: *We are in positionbomb bay doors open

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI01xCin08Subtitle
values.text: *We have spotted survivors. Ground assault will be necessary

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI01xXO01Subtitle
values.text: *General, our former base in the region was overrun by the GLA. You will need to construct a new base before you can engage the enemy

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI01xXO02Subtitle
values.text: *May I suggest that you garrison several of the nearby buildings to defend our base

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI01xXO03Subtitle
values.text: *General, the GLA has garrisoned several buildings throughout the town. Perhaps you could use a Dragon tank to clear out those garrisons

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI01xXO04Subtitle
values.text: *General, the GLA is moving Toxin Tractors towards our garrisoned buildings. If those tractors attack those buildings, everyone inside will be eliminated

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI01xXO05Subtitle
values.text: *The GLA are using these Oil Derricks to fund their forces. One of our Red Guard could capture those derricks. The proceeds would help defeat the GLA

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI01xXO06Subtitle
values.text: *General, is it wise to destroy these Oil Derricks? They would provide valuable resources for us. One of our Red Guard could capture them

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI01xXO07Subtitle
values.text: *You have caught them off-guard, General. One of your Red Guard could capture their buildings before they are able to respond

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI01xXO08Subtitle
values.text: *Now that you have re-established our base of operations, it is time to root out all remaining GLA forces in the area

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI01xXO09Subtitle
values.text: *Congratulations, General. You have freed the town of all GLA forces. Once you have wiped out their final base, your mission will be complete

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisChi02Lin13Subtitle
values.text: *The Terrorist threat is finished. Good work, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xBrf01Subtitle
values.text: *General, the GLA are attempting to steal the nuclear warheads stored at this facility

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xBrf01aSubtitle
values.text: *General, the GLA are attempting to destroy our main nuclear power plant

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xBrf02Subtitle
values.text: *Our brave soldiers held off their attack but at great cost and the GLA is still out there

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xBrf03Subtitle
values.text: *You must hold off the GLA and insure that every one of our Bunkers is protected

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xBrf03aSubtitle
values.text: *You must hold off the GLA to insure that the facility is not destroyed

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xBrf04Subtitle
values.text: *We have several new technologies that should be of great benefit to your mission, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xBrf05Subtitle
values.text: *Our Nuclear Cannons are now upgraded to fire neutron shells. These new shells effectively eliminate soldiers and vehicle drivers. Once the radiation has cleared, one of our infantrymen can then capture the surviving vehicles

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xBrf06Subtitle
values.text: *Our buildings can now upgrade to Neutron mines. While still effective against infantry, they will also temporarily incapacitate enemy vehicles

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xBrf07aSubtitle
values.text: *General, your reinforcements will arrive in 15 minutes

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xBrf07bSubtitle
values.text: *General, your reinforcements will arrive in 10 minutes

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xBrf07cSubtitle
values.text: *General, your reinforcements will arrive in 5 minutes

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xBrf07dSubtitle
values.text: *General, your reinforcements will arrive soon

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xChat01Subtitle
values.text: *Enemy forces sighted. We will hold them back

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xChat02Subtitle
values.text: *We're taking fire on the right flanksupport is needed here

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xChat03Subtitle
values.text: *They are behind usdirect all fire to the south!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xChat04Subtitle
values.text: *GLA base in rangeall teams ready to attack, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xChat05Subtitle
values.text: *Enemy buildings on that ridge. Give the word, General, and we will roll over them

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xChat06Subtitle
values.text: *Watch those RPG Troopers! We need help!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xChat07Subtitle
values.text: *General, we are over the target area now and have commenced bombing

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xChat08Subtitle
values.text: *Rolling out the carpetof bombs. Heheh

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xChat09Subtitle
values.text: *Enemy air defenses are thick herewe are taking heavy damage

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xChat10Subtitle
values.text: *Stinger sites have locked onto uswe are in trouble!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xChat11Subtitle
values.text: *Stop that Rebel, he's trying to capture our bunker!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xChat12Subtitle
values.text: *It isn't a Battlemaster, but it will have to do

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xChat13Subtitle
values.text: *I prefer my Gattling Tank

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xChat14Subtitle
values.text: *Another GLA wave!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xChat15Subtitle
values.text: *We must protect our bunkers!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xChat15aSubtitle
values.text: *We must protect the nuclear reactor!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xChat16Subtitle
values.text: *Now we will show them how to attack a base!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xChat17Subtitle
values.text: *Reinforcements! We are glad to see you!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xChat18Subtitle
values.text: *We are ready for your orders, General. Where do you need us?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xCin01Subtitle
values.text: *We must be on our guard. Reports say the GLA might attack as revenge for our entering the war

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xCin01aSubtitle
values.text: *I don't feel safe guarding this nuclear plant

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xCin01bSubtitle
values.text: *Yah. I wish I had joined up with the air force instead

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xCin01dSubtitle
values.text: *Surely after our recent victory they would not dare to attack us here

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xCin01cSubtitle
values.text: *Their food is much better. And they get to wear those fancy helmets

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xCin02Subtitle
values.text: *GLA forces! We're under attack!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xCin03Subtitle
values.text: *They're everywhere! We're being overrun

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xCin04Subtitle
values.text: *Another wave! We need reinforcements!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xCin04aSubtitle
values.text: *Another wave! They've got bomb trucks and terrorists! We need reinforcements!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xCin04bSubtitle
values.text: *Another wave! They're using suicide tactics! Where are those reinforcements?!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xCin05Subtitle
values.text: *We've lost the airfield!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xCin06Subtitle
values.text: *They're trying to get to the storage bunkers! Protect them at all costs!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xCin06aSubtitle
values.text: *They're trying to get to the main reactor! Protect it at all costs!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xCin07Subtitle
values.text: *The Command Centerthey got the Command Center

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xCin08Subtitle
values.text: *We held remaining forces report in

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xCin09Subtitle
values.text: *Not much left. We're going to need reinforcements

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xCin10Subtitle
values.text: *The message got through, but we'll have to hold until they get here

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xXO01Subtitle
values.text: *General, our reinforcements have arrived!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xXO02Subtitle
values.text: *General, GLA forces are attacking the bunkers

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xXO02aSubtitle
values.text: *General, GLA forces are attacking the nuclear plant!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xXO03Subtitle
values.text: *The GLA is attempting to capture one of our bunkers

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xXO04Subtitle
values.text: *General, this bunker is badly damaged. May I suggest it be repaired before another GLA attack

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xXO04aSubtitle
values.text: *General, our nuclear plant is badly damaged. May I suggest it be repaired before another GLA attack

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xXO05Subtitle
values.text: *General, that last attack severely weakened several bunkers. If one of them is destroyed, the GLA will win this encounter

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xXO05aSubtitle
values.text: *General, that last attack severely weakened the nuclear plant. If it is destroyed, we will fail our mission!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xXO06Subtitle
values.text: *WarningGLA forces moving towards the bunkers

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xXO06aSubtitle
values.text: *WarningGLA forces are moving towards the power plant!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xXO07Subtitle
values.text: *General, I've made contact with one of our spy outposts. They are under GLA attack. If we can rescue them, I can patch into their system and we will be able to call in carpet bombers

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xXO08Subtitle
values.text: *General, if you can secure that spy outpost, it will allow you to direct carpet bombing runs on the GLA forces

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI02xXO09Subtitle
values.text: *General, now that our reinforcements have arrived it is time to eliminate the GLA from this area

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisChi03RedChat12Subtitle
values.text: *To battle!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisChi03RedChat19Subtitle
values.text: *Bring in the tanks! Level them!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xBrf01Subtitle
values.text: *Greetings, Commander. Now that we have thwarted the GLA's counterattack, it is time to press our advantage!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xBrf02Subtitle
values.text: *We must liberate this town from the GLA's clutches

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xBrf03Subtitle
values.text: *There is a very heavily defended GLA base north of the river. We must destroy it, but it will not be an easy task

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xBrf04Subtitle
values.text: *Our operations have attracted much attention from the rest of the world, and we will be watched closely. The longer this battle goes on, the lower our International Opinion will fall

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xBrf05Subtitle
values.text: *Damage to civilian property must be avoided. Our operation must be precise, and swift. Destruction of GLA forces will cause International Opinion to rise, in our favor

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xBrf09Subtitle
values.text: *If our International Opinion becomes high enough, the people of the town might join our cause

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xBrf10Subtitle
values.text: *It will then be easy to annihilate the GLA's defenses

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xChat01Subtitle
values.text: *They must have a camouflaged Tunnel Network near here

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xChat02Subtitle
values.text: *They've ambushed us!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xChat03Subtitle
values.text: *They've ambushed our base!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xChat04Subtitle
values.text: *We have found their secret base!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xChat05Subtitle
values.text: *They are coming from the far side of the lake

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xChat06Subtitle
values.text: *Their troops must be hidden in the forest

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xChat07Subtitle
values.text: *I wonder what's across the river

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xChat08Subtitle
values.text: *Their hit-and-run attacks are proving inconvenient

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xChat09Subtitle
values.text: *The buggies are back!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xChat10Subtitle
values.text: *Sneak attack!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xChat11Subtitle
values.text: *Crush that Inferno Cannon!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xChat12Subtitle
values.text: *The people are too afraid to come out from their homes

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xChat13Subtitle
values.text: *We must free them from this oppression!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xXO01Subtitle
values.text: *The people rise to support us!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xXO10Subtitle
values.text: *General. Destroying the GLA statues will be critical to increasing our International Opinion and will boost support of our efforts amongst the population

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xXO11Subtitle
values.text: *They have dispatched a Toxic Tractor to clear our garrisonned structures!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xXO12Subtitle
values.text: *Our Dragon Tanks will be a high priority targetguard them well

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xXO13Subtitle
values.text: *Well done, sir. The destruction of the statue has caused world opinion to rise

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xXO16Subtitle
values.text: *Do not let them destroy the buildings!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xXO17Subtitle
values.text: *Use the Neutron Shell to clear buildings without damaging them

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xXO18Subtitle
values.text: *Beware! Their defensive structures are hidden with camo-netting

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xXO19Subtitle
values.text: *General, the GLA have the city well-defended. We need to clear them out

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xXO20Subtitle
values.text: *You're making good progress, Commander. Much of the city is now free of GLA control

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xXO21Subtitle
values.text: *Sir! The city is rising up against our foes!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xXO22Subtitle
values.text: *General, we must clear the GLA from this area!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xXO23Subtitle
values.text: *Our International Opinion is high. Great work!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xChat01Subtitle
values.text: *They have almost escaped! We must stop them!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xChat010Subtitle
values.text: *They are skirting the lake. Intercept them!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xChat011Subtitle
values.text: *They're coming for our base!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xChat012Subtitle
values.text: *We have stopped the first wave of GLA!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xChat013Subtitle
values.text: *Again we have put them in their place!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xChat014Subtitle
values.text: *No one can stand to the might of China!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xChat015Subtitle
values.text: *Sun Tzu would be proud

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xChat016Subtitle
values.text: *Victory is ours!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xChat017Subtitle
values.text: *None shall pass

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xChat018Subtitle
values.text: *We will banish them from the skies!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xChat019Subtitle
values.text: *Our power is unsurpassed!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xChat02Subtitle
values.text: *Cut them off at the village!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xChat020Subtitle
values.text: *The Helix isn't the only powerhouse

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xChat03Subtitle
values.text: *We cannot let them get past that hill

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xChat04Subtitle
values.text: *They will surely pass by here. We should defend this area

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xChat05Subtitle
values.text: *Here is another choke point

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xChat06Subtitle
values.text: *We should secure these buildings

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xChat07Subtitle
values.text: *What are they doing?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xChat08Subtitle
values.text: *Watch out for the toxin!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xChat09Subtitle
values.text: *We've been ambushed!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xChat15Subtitle
values.text: *Our forces are in position. We are ready for anything

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xChat16Subtitle
values.text: *They are stronger than we thought. We need air support. Send in the Helix now!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO01Subtitle
values.text: *The GLA is sending forth another wave!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO02Subtitle
values.text: *This wave is retreating towards the north

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO03Subtitle
values.text: *They are retreating to the northeast

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO04Subtitle
values.text: *This wave is retreating to the east

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO05Subtitle
values.text: *The European Union is extremely pleased with our performance, General. We need to stay aggressive and eliminate the GLA

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO06Subtitle
values.text: *This force was only a diversion!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO07Subtitle
values.text: *General, they have a scud storm! We must spread out our troops to deny them a target!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO08Subtitle
values.text: *Waitthey're not targeting us

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO09Subtitle
values.text: *The GLA have no honor! They have decimated the village to clear a path!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO10Subtitle
values.text: *We should assemble a base to secure this region

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO11Subtitle
values.text: *Our Helix is the Overlord of the skies. Build more to help us control the area

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO12Subtitle
values.text: *Sir, I recommend placing Listening Outposts at key locations

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO13Subtitle
values.text: *Current Intel reports that the GLA are retreating towards this location. We will make our stand here. Do not permit any GLA units to leave this area. Our new Helix Helicopter should assure your success. The appearance of our forces from the south will signal the completion of your main objective

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO14Subtitle
values.text: *Current Intel reports that the GLA are retreating towards this location. We will make our stand here. Do not permit any GLA units to leave this area. If too many of them escape, our mission will be a failure. Our new Helix Helicopter should assure your success. The appearance of our forces from the south will signal the completion of your main objective

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO15Subtitle
values.text: *A wave of GLA is approaching from the west

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO16Subtitle
values.text: *There is a wave of GLA approaching from the south

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO17Subtitle
values.text: *GLA forces have been spotted approaching from the southwest

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO18Subtitle
values.text: *GLA forces incoming from the southeast

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO19Subtitle
values.text: *A wave of GLA forces are approaching from the southwest

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO20Subtitle
values.text: *Another GLA wave is approaching

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO21Subtitle
values.text: *Excellent work, sir. Intel confirms that you have destroyed the entire wave

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO22Subtitle
values.text: *The enemy is about to breach our defenses

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO23Subtitle
values.text: *Multiple Scud Storm launches detected

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO24Subtitle
values.text: *Our defenses have been breached commander, we have failed the mission

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO25Subtitle
values.text: *Commander, our forces from the south have arrived. Out mission was a success

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO26Subtitle
values.text: *General, enemy forces are dangerously close to making their escape. We must deal with them quickly!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO27Subtitle
values.text: *GLA forces have been detected fleeing through this location. Move into defensive positions and await enemy contact

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO28Subtitle
values.text: *General, Wave 1 of the enemies retreat has been detected entering the area and intel has them moving along the path shown on the your radar

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO29Subtitle
values.text: *General, Wave 2 of the enemies retreat has been detected entering the area and intel has them moving along the path shown on the your radar

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO30Subtitle
values.text: *General, Wave 3 of the enemies retreat has been detected entering the area and intel has them moving along the path shown on the your radar

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO31Subtitle
values.text: *General, Wave 4 of the enemies retreat has been detected entering the area and intel has them moving along the path shown on the your radar

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO32Subtitle
values.text: *General, Wave 5 of the enemies retreat has been detected entering the area and intel has them moving along the path shown on the your radar

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO33Subtitle
values.text: *Our forces have arrived from the south. You have been successful in preventing the enemy retreat. Good job General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO34Subtitle
values.text: *General, the enemy forces have escaped to the North. We have failed the mission

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisChi05OfficerC01Subtitle
values.text: *It's time we corrected our mistake. Kill them all!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisChi05OfficerC02Subtitle
values.text: *Let us flush these rats from their holes. Death to the cowards!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xBrf01Subtitle
values.text: *Thanks to your remarkable efforts in Halberstadt the GLA are all but finished. US intel has located the last GLA stronghold outside of Hamburg. Unfortunately we were too late to help the Americans in this area and the GLA captured their base. Build your forces and destroy both the GLA and US bases

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xBrf02Subtitle
values.text: *The GLA have captured an old US base in the region and are building up. Your Final Objective is to Destroy both the US and GLA bases

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xBrf03Subtitle
values.text: *The GLA have increased their stealth abilities, General. They can now stealth just about anything. We'll need to stay alert

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xBrf04Subtitle
values.text: *Use your Listening Outposts to detect stealthed units

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xBrf05Subtitle
values.text: *General, I suggest you first concentrate your attack on the US base. We need to take out their Particle Cannons

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xChat01Subtitle
values.text: *It feels like we are on an Easter Egg hunt, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xCin01Subtitle
values.text: *Corporal! Any sign of the Chinese yet?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xCin02Subtitle
values.text: *No sir, the last message received was at 02:00nothing since

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xCin03Subtitle
values.text: *Well, I hope they get here soon. Our intel points to a full-scale GLA attack

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xCin04Subtitle
values.text: *Yes, sir

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xCin06Subtitle
values.text: *What the...!? Enemy contact!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xCin07Subtitle
values.text: *Our base has been breached.all units to your stations! Where are those Chinese we were promised!?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xCin08Subtitle
values.text: *Fox in the hole! Fox in the hole!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xCin09Subtitle
values.text: *Where'd they come from?!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xCin10Subtitle
values.text: *They're capturing our buildings! We can't hold! All units, fall back! Repeat, fall back!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xXO01Subtitle
values.text: *That's it! Power to the US base is down! Finish them quickly before they can rebuild!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xXO02Subtitle
values.text: *Well done, General. The enemy can no longer produce US units

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xXO03Subtitle
values.text: *Well done, General. The enemy can no longer produce GLA units

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xXO04Subtitle
values.text: *Well done, General. The US base has been neutralized. Destroy the GLA base to finish this battle

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xXO05Subtitle
values.text: *Well done, General. The GLA base has been neutralized. Destroy the US base to finish this battle

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xXO06Subtitle
values.text: *We must finish what the US was not able to do. The GLA must fall and the world will be at peace

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xXO07Subtitle
values.text: *If we are able to defeat the GLA and save Europe from its clutches then there are great rewards to be had

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xXO08Subtitle
values.text: *General, you will take your place among China's finest heroes. The GLA has fallen and China is the shining beacon in a new world. Take you place of honor and bask in the glory that is China

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xXO09Subtitle
values.text: *General, the enemy has improved their stealth ability, but they do not appear to be using tanks

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xXO10Subtitle
values.text: *General, the GLA commander is lacking tanks. Perhaps we can overwhelm him with our forces

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xXO11Subtitle
values.text: *General, we are losing vehicles to Jarmen Kell. You must track him down if we are to stand a chance

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xXO12Subtitle
values.text: *General, the enemy is using HIJACKERS! We need to stop them!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xXO13Subtitle
values.text: *General, the enemy has positioned SNIPERs in the local villages. We must clear them out

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xXO14Subtitle
values.text: *General, we are losing troops to the enemy's Quad Cannons, we need heavy armor out here

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xXO15Subtitle
values.text: *General, current intel suggests Jarmen Kell may be holed up in this small village

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xXO16Subtitle
values.text: *General, the enemy's base seems to be on the other side of this river. Perhaps we can lock him in by positioning forces near the bridges

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xXO17Subtitle
values.text: *General, we have many driverless vehicles in the fieldsend units to recapture them

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xXO18Subtitle
values.text: *Sir! We have detected Battle buses in sector C. We should deal with them before they can reach our base

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xXO19Subtitle
values.text: *General, the enemy has slipped units into our base! We should improve our defenses!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xXO20Subtitle
values.text: *General, the enemy has infiltrated our base!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xXO21Subtitle
values.text: *General! Taking out the American Command Center will put a stop to his heavy Air support

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xXO22Subtitle
values.text: *General, we need to get our INTERNET CENTER built as quickly as possible. It will help us locate enemy positions

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xXO23Subtitle
values.text: *General, the enemy has left his Flank unguarded! Now is our chance to counter attack!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xXO24Subtitle
values.text: *General, the Americans have superior stealth detection technology. Perhaps you should capture this base instead of destroying it

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisChi07RedGuard108Subtitle
values.text: *Ambush!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01Scorpion105Subtitle
values.text: *The Chinese are close

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01Scorpion108Subtitle
values.text: *We have found a secret way. It's poorly guarded

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01Scorpion109Subtitle
values.text: *We're under fire!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xChat01Subtitle
values.text: *Enemy defense structures sighted, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xChat02Subtitle
values.text: *Enemy position spotted! We must find a way past them!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xChat03Subtitle
values.text: *Enemy patrol! All units, open fire!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xChat04Subtitle
values.text: *American Sentry Drones! We must destroy them quickly before they sound the alarm!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xChat05Subtitle
values.text: *Look at them scramble! Our attack was a complete surprise!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xChat06Subtitle
values.text: *American attackers closing in! We must hold our position, General!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xChat07Subtitle
values.text: *Our surprise was complete! All units, concentrate on their power plants!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xChat08Subtitle
values.text: *General! We are taking heavy losses!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xCin01Subtitle
values.text: *Patrol to base: Target has been located and we are in pursuit

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xCin02Subtitle
values.text: *Be advised, the bombing campaign has already begun. Be careful, Patrol

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xCin03Subtitle
values.text: *Roger that, base. I'm on the right

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xCin04Subtitle
values.text: *I'll take the left

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xCin05Subtitle
values.text: *I'm taking fire!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xCin06Subtitle
values.text: *Stay on them!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xCin07Subtitle
values.text: *Look out!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xCin08Subtitle
values.text: *Base! Charlie three is down! Repeat: Charlie three is down!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xCin09Subtitle
values.text: *Continue pursuit, Charlie two! This is our best shot at him!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xCin10Subtitle
values.text: *Escorts eliminated! I've got him!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xCin11Subtitle
values.text: *Nooooo!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xCin12Subtitle
values.text: *Heh heh. General, we've made our escape.and are headed for the rendevouz point. The GLA shall rise again

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xCin13Subtitle
values.text: *Affirmative. Scout team moving out

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xCin14Subtitle
values.text: *This is scout team. We detect no enemy presence. Wait

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xCin15Subtitle
values.text: *American ambush! They have us surrounded!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xCin16Subtitle
values.text: *Sentry Drones! These Americans are most clever. Their drones are hidden when they are still. You must proceed with caution, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xKen01Subtitle
values.text: *The Americans have surrounded our stronghold with military checkpoints. You must clear the way

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xKen02Subtitle
values.text: *General, you must help our true leader escape, so that the GLA can live on

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xKen03Subtitle
values.text: *Dr. Thrax may have died for the cause but he was inconsequential. If our brother escapes the US will not have seen the last of the GLA

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xKen04Subtitle
values.text: *General. The Fire Base defenses around this American position are too strong. We should avoid a direct confrontation and find another way into the base

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xKen05Subtitle
values.text: *Hold you forces back, General. We are sending in a team to scout the other side of the bridge. They will report back on enemy positions

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xKen06Subtitle
values.text: *My General. One of our Quick Strike teams has managed to elude their American pursuers, and have agreed to aid us in our mission. Their rocket pods should prove most useful against enemy armor

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xKen07Subtitle
values.text: *We have discovered one of our demolitions teams. They will help us to clear a path by destroying the outlying US support bases

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xKen08Subtitle
values.text: *General. We must secure the airfield before the transport plane arrives. The survival of the GLA depends on your success

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xKen09Subtitle
values.text: *Our Combat Cycles are very versatile. They enhance the abilities of our loyal infantry, and are able to travel over rough terrain. They are even able to survive a jump off cliffs. Use them to bypass American strong-points and attack their vulnerable sides

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xKen10Subtitle
values.text: *General! The Americans have sent a second group of pursuers to capture our leader. Protect him at all costs!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xKen11Subtitle
values.text: *General, this hidden base can provide us with the resources we need to push past the American siege and reach the airfield

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xKen12Subtitle
values.text: *General, our leader is under attack! He must not fall to the Americans!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xKen13Subtitle
values.text: *General, your forces are moving too far ahead of our leader. Remember that he must reach the airfield if our cause is to survive

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xKen14Subtitle
values.text: *Another American base. It must be eliminated. Be wary of their Fire Bases, sir

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xKen15Subtitle
values.text: *We are within reach of the airfield, General. Destroy the American forces and secure the area that we may fly our leader to safety

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xKen16Subtitle
values.text: *Well done, General. With you in command, we can not fail

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xKen17Subtitle
values.text: *We have reached the airfield, sir. Make sure our leader is ready and waiting at the air strip when his plane arrives

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xKen18Subtitle
values.text: *Our plane is on approach, General! Just hold your position for a little longer. Our leader must survive to board that plane!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xKen19Subtitle
values.text: *The plane has arrived. Load our leader in so that we may fly him to safety and regroup

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xKen20Subtitle
values.text: *The plane is waiting for our leader to board. Make haste and bring him in, General. Our forces cannot hold out indefinitely against the Americans

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xKen21Subtitle
values.text: *Our operative, Jarmen Kell, has been harassing the American supply lines. He will be of great help to our mission, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xKen22Subtitle
values.text: *Excellent work, General. We will show the Americans that we still have the power to resist them

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xKen23Subtitle
values.text: *We have discovered an advance scout force, General. They have offered to aid us with our mission

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xKen24Subtitle
values.text: *General! Take out the American power plants to shut down their base defenses!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xKen25Subtitle
values.text: *Our forces have been weakened, General. We must choose our battles more wisely

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02Chatter04Subtitle
values.text: *We are here and ready for your command

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02Chatter18Subtitle
values.text: *So much for American

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02General07Subtitle
values.text: *American forces are coming. Get ready!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xChat01Subtitle
values.text: *The enemy, they are attacking!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xChat02Subtitle
values.text: *The resistance is too strong, there must be another way

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xChat03Subtitle
values.text: *The Prince must be stopped. The GLA must not fall to him!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xChat04Subtitle
values.text: *Our base is under attack!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xChat05Subtitle
values.text: *Our Palace is destroyed!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xChat06Subtitle
values.text: *We have lost our Barracks

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xChat07Subtitle
values.text: *We must rebuild our Arms Dealer quickly

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xCin01Subtitle
values.text: *This is Recon 1 to base. I am finishing my patrol. Sector is clear

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xCin02Subtitle
values.text: *This is base. Are you certain, Recon 1? We've had reports of troop movements linked to Prince Kassad

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xCin03Subtitle
values.text: *I am most certain. I haven't seen anything but dust and shrubs for hours now. Returning to base after this

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xCin04Subtitle
values.text: *What the?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xCin05Subtitle
values.text: *Recon 1 to base! Enemy contact! Repeat, enemy contact!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xCin06Subtitle
values.text: *Recon 1! What is your position?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xCin07Subtitle
values.text: *He's preparing to fire!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xCin08Subtitle
values.text: *Recon 1, what is your status? Recon 1! Report!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xCin09Subtitle
values.text: *Once Prince Kassad is removed the GLA will be under our control. Then vengeance will be ours and the American infidels will burn

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xCin10Subtitle
values.text: *Prince Kassad is beginning to take control wherever he can. We must put an end to his vie for power

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen01Subtitle
values.text: *General, our resources are running low -- we must find a new source of supplies!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen02Subtitle
values.text: *Kassad is attempting to capture nearby resources! We must not let him take what is rightfully ours!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen03Subtitle
values.text: *We must reunite the GLA under one leader!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen04Subtitle
values.text: *Beware! Kassad has launched a sneak attack against us!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen05Subtitle
values.text: *We have much bigger plans than that rat Kassad. The world will quake as we unleash the fury of the GLA

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen06Subtitle
values.text: *We have acquired GPS Scramble technology! Now we can use Kassad's tricks against him!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen07Subtitle
values.text: *Excellent, General! We have secured the Sneak Attack ability!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen08Subtitle
values.text: *Capture the enemy Command Centers

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen09Subtitle
values.text: *If we can capture the enemy Command Center we can use their technology against them

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen10Subtitle
values.text: *General, we must capture their Command Center and use their knowledge to progress towards our goal of uniting the GLA under one flag

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen11Subtitle
values.text: *We are running low on resources. We must capture some oil derricks

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen12Subtitle
values.text: *Our enemy is attacking our Oil Supply! They must be stopped!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen13Subtitle
values.text: *Use the GPS scramble to sneak past the enemy defenses!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen14Subtitle
values.text: *The GPS Scramble will not work here, there are too many Stinger Sites.We will need to use a different tactic

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen15Subtitle
values.text: *Perhaps we can find an unguarded area to use our new Sneak Attack ability

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen16Subtitle
values.text: *Do not destroy the Command Center. We need to capture the structure and keep it intact

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen17Subtitle
values.text: *Their knowledge must be stolen. We need to use their advanced tactics to defeat them!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen18Subtitle
values.text: *General, be wary of snipers -- Kassad loves to use them

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen19Subtitle
values.text: *This bridge is heavily defended. We will need assistance in getting across it

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen20Subtitle
values.text: *Capture the enemy Command Center to the North!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen21Subtitle
values.text: *Capture the enemy Command Center to the West!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen22Subtitle
values.text: *General, if we capture this cannon, we can use it against Kassad's forces!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen23Subtitle
values.text: *If we capture the Command Center, we can use their abilities to turn the tide of this battle

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen24Subtitle
values.text: *Prince Kassad is no more. The GLA are once again united against our enemies!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen25Subtitle
values.text: *Now that we have GPS scramble, we can move unseen past Kassad's bridge defenses!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen26Subtitle
values.text: *The traitor has fortified himself on this hilltop and cut all other means of access. Sneak Attack is the only way we have to strike at his main base

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen27Subtitle
values.text: *General, this area is being controlled by Prince Kassad. He has turned his back on his brethren and will not aid us in our cause against the infidels

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen28Subtitle
values.text: *Kassad is a master of stealth, hiding his forces in plain sight. He refuses to share his knowledge with us, so we will take it from him

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen29Subtitle
values.text: *A GLA splinter cell commanded by Prince Kassad is controlling this area. Kassad refuses to let us use his abilities for the good of the GLA

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen30Subtitle
values.text: *Kassad is a master of stealth, relying on several techniques to surprise and attack his enemies

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen31Subtitle
values.text: *GPS scramble gives him the power to have any unit strike unseen against an enemy

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen32Subtitle
values.text: *Tunnel sneak attacks offer further tactical advantages

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen33Subtitle
values.text: *We must have these technologies. If Kassad will not share, we will take them from him. Capture his command centers and turn his own abilities against him!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03Kenwar03Subtitle
values.text: *Free our imprisoned brothers

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03Kenwar15Subtitle
values.text: *We have spotted a Prison Camp, our brothers are held inside

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xBrf01Subtitle
values.text: *Welcome, Commander!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xBrf02Subtitle
values.text: *Kassad was too cowardly to make an attempt against the US such as this. General, you are truly a master mind

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xBrf03Subtitle
values.text: *Once the US Mediterranean naval force is shattered all of Europe will be in our grasp

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xBrf04Subtitle
values.text: *Now that we are again united, it is time to make our strength felt!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xBrf05Subtitle
values.text: *The USA has attacked our secret base in the Mediterranean

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xBrf06Subtitle
values.text: *But before it was wiped out, we learned of the location of their Particle Cannon and naval fleet in the region

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xBrf07Subtitle
values.text: *Most of their ships are in port and helpless. We will steal their Particle Cannon and use it to take out their Aircraft Carrier!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xBrf08Subtitle
values.text: *Look for an opportunity to reclaim and rebuild our secret base

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xChat01Subtitle
values.text: *We'll die for you!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xChat02Subtitle
values.text: *Another one bites the dust

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xChat03Subtitle
values.text: *More victims for me

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xChat04Subtitle
values.text: *Mow them down!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xChat05Subtitle
values.text: *They cannot escape our wrath!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xChat06Subtitle
values.text: *We have them where we want them!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xChat07Subtitle
values.text: *Victory will be ours!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xChat08Subtitle
values.text: *That made a big splash!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xCin01Subtitle
values.text: *We will avenge this cowardly attack!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xCin02Subtitle
values.text: *Their carrier will be turned into scrap!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xCin03Subtitle
values.text: *We have proven the might of the GLA!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen01Subtitle
values.text: *Our Hijackers could take that tank easily

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen02Subtitle
values.text: *That Ranger is running for help! We must not let him get away

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen03Subtitle
values.text: *We'll need this Particle Cannon to sink the enemy Carrier. Defend it well!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen04Subtitle
values.text: *Our rebels can use their Capture Building ability to take control of the Particle Cannon

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen05Subtitle
values.text: *We can use our Sneak Attack to create Tunnel Networks on nearby islands

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen06Subtitle
values.text: *We must not let the pilot reach his Tomahawk!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen07Subtitle
values.text: *They're coming after the Tomahawk!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen08Subtitle
values.text: *This Barracks is now ours

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen09Subtitle
values.text: *We have liberated this Palace

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen10Subtitle
values.text: *This Arms Dealer will serve us well

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen11Subtitle
values.text: *We have reclaimed our Command Center!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen12Subtitle
values.text: *General, do you see those enemy supply planes? If we could destroy their drop zones, we would cripple their production!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen13Subtitle
values.text: *Ah, this toxic tractor will come in handy

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen14Subtitle
values.text: *These Quad Cannons will defend us from enemy aircraft

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen15Subtitle
values.text: *These Marauders will boost our firepower

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen16Subtitle
values.text: *Destroy these tanks and we can liberate the Barracks!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen17Subtitle
values.text: *If we clear this area, we can safely occupy the Command Center

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen18Subtitle
values.text: *Kill those troops and the Arms Dealer will be ours!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen19Subtitle
values.text: *They may be launching an attack against us! Defend our buildings!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen20Subtitle
values.text: *Comanches! Rally our air defenses!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen21Subtitle
values.text: *We must defend against those Comanches!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen22Subtitle
values.text: *They are trying to retake the Particle Cannon!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen23Subtitle
values.text: *Their aircraft have destroyed our Tunnel Network!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen24Subtitle
values.text: *Those clever villains! They are targeting our Power Plants. We need power to use the Particle Cannon

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen25Subtitle
values.text: *Almost all of the power plants have been destroyed. We must have power to use the Particle Cannon!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen26Subtitle
values.text: *If we could capture some power plants, we could use the Particle Cannon against them

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen27Subtitle
values.text: *Ahh.. We have found some hidden goodies

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen28Subtitle
values.text: *This pass is well defended. We should use the Particle Cannon to blast through

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen29Subtitle
values.text: *Be careful! This pass is heavily guarded!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen30Subtitle
values.text: *They've dispatched infantry onto the islands!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen31Subtitle
values.text: *They're choppers are bringing reinforcements!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen32Subtitle
values.text: *They have launched an A10 Strike against us!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen33Subtitle
values.text: *They've paradropped onto the Particle Cannon!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen34Subtitle
values.text: *We have disabled their Supply Drop Zones! Their production will be crippled!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen35Subtitle
values.text: *Your mission is to destroy the enemy Aircraft Carrier with the Particle Cannon. You will have to penetrate their base on the mainland to get a visual lock on the Carrier so that you can destroy it

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen36Subtitle
values.text: *Great work! Now we must secure some Power Plants

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen37Subtitle
values.text: *The Tunnel Network will bring us to the next island

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen38Subtitle
values.text: *The Particle Cannon is now online. We should defend it and the Power Plants

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen39Subtitle
values.text: *All of our units and buildings have been destroyed!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen40Subtitle
values.text: *Without the Particle Cannon, it will be impossible to sink the Carrier

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen41Subtitle
values.text: *Now the Americans shall taste bitter defeat!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen42Subtitle
values.text: *They destroyed our Tunnel Network! Use the sneak attack to reclaim the Particle Cannon!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen43Subtitle
values.text: *We are closing in on the Aircraft Carrier. It is just south of here

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen44Subtitle
values.text: *There's the Aircraft Carrier! Destroy it using the Particle Cannon!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen45Subtitle
values.text: *Jarmen Kell is here to serve us

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen46Subtitle
values.text: *His snipe ability can disable enemy vehicles, allowing our infantry to then capture them

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen47Subtitle
values.text: *These docked Battleships are harmless

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen48Subtitle
values.text: *The Battleship is bombarding us! Destroy it!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen49Subtitle
values.text: *This must be the enemy's main base

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen50Subtitle
values.text: *These fake buildings will fool our foes

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen51Subtitle
values.text: *Build more fake structures to trick the enemy!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04Dispatcher06Subtitle
values.text: *American forces are on their way

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xChat01Subtitle
values.text: *We've got to clear out those bunkers!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xChat02Subtitle
values.text: *Their power is down! No Patriots to deal with!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xChat03Subtitle
values.text: *Break down the fences and rescue our brethren!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xChat04Subtitle
values.text: *Now our brothers may be free!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xChat05Subtitle
values.text: *An american chinook would help to transport our troops. Capture this supply depot if you can

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xChat06Subtitle
values.text: *Get some anti air over here, general! Their Comanches are tearing us to bits!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xChat07Subtitle
values.text: *General, we must find some way to take out these bridge defenses!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xChat08Subtitle
values.text: *General, we are using our cell phones to call in a surprise tunnel network!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xChat09Subtitle
values.text: *We'll need these tractors if we want to clear any bunkers

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xChat10Subtitle
values.text: *This ferry is under our control now! You will take us where we want to go!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xChat11Subtitle
values.text: *Yes, yes. I will do what you say!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xChat12Subtitle
values.text: *Our brothers have been freed

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xChat13Subtitle
values.text: *There sure are a lot of sports utility vehicles in this strange land

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xChat14Subtitle
values.text: *We have a GLA sympathizer in this area. He and his brothers have agreed to help us

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xChat15Subtitle
values.text: *Tanks! Take off! Go, Go, Go!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xCin01Subtitle
values.text: *This is team one. We are in position

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xCin02Subtitle
values.text: *My brethren, be careful, as we tread on enemy soil. Our main objective is to obtain chemical samples from the nearby American toxin facility

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xCin03Subtitle
values.text: *The remains of the American naval force have moved to the Mediterranean, in response to the loss of their command fleet. This has allowed us to slip in

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xCin04Subtitle
values.text: *We defeated them there, and we shall be victorious here

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xCin05Subtitle
values.text: *Brothers rejoice! Once we have the toxins from this facility, our scientists will be able to forge a weapon of mass infection

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xCin06Subtitle
values.text: *The Americans have meddled for too long. With this new weapon, we shall be able to strike fear into the hearts of our oppressors!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xCin07Subtitle
values.text: *(Very evil laugh)

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xCin08Subtitle
values.text: *Team one, are toxins secured and on board?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xCin09Subtitle
values.text: *We have the samples

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xCin10Subtitle
values.text: *We are ready for takeoff

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xCin11Subtitle
values.text: *Check. Package is secure

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xCin12Subtitle
values.text: *You are clear to proceed. We will defend your escape!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xCin13Subtitle
values.text: *General the Patriots are online!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xCin14Subtitle
values.text: *Hold them back until we clear the landing strip!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xCin15Subtitle
values.text: *Keep them off our tail!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xCin16Subtitle
values.text: *Get away you stupid Americans!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xCin17Subtitle
values.text: *We'll meet again when we reach the toxin facility

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xCin18Subtitle
values.text: *The Americans think they have driven us out

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xCin19Subtitle
values.text: *We will divide and conquer

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xCin20Subtitle
values.text: *We are nothing against this air power!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xCin21Subtitle
values.text: *You have not seen the last of us!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xCin22Subtitle
values.text: *We will get our revenge, you filthy Americans!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xCin23Subtitle
values.text: *Let's do our part to take down these capitalist pigs!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xCin24Subtitle
values.text: *These Americans will pay for the lives of our brethren

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xCin25Subtitle
values.text: *Let's light up these GLA intruders! Fox 1!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xCin26Subtitle
values.text: *GLA spotted offshore! All units to defense positions

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xCin27Subtitle
values.text: *We got GLA infiltration at coordinated 77BetaGamma! All available units move to respond!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xCin28Subtitle
values.text: *There's more of them on the beach!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xCin29Subtitle
values.text: *GLA infiltrators spotted on the ledge!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xCin30Subtitle
values.text: *We've got GLA inside city limits! All units converge on coordinates 34AlphaAlpha

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xKen01Subtitle
values.text: *Good job, General! Only 15 more toxin samples to be retrieved

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xKen02Subtitle
