values.text: *Good job, General! Only 10 more toxin samples to be retrieved

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xKen03Subtitle
values.text: *Good job, General! Only 5 more toxin samples to be retrieved

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xKen04Subtitle
values.text: *General, we have a plan to attack America's Central Command in Europe. But we do not yet have the power to strike at them directly. We need a new toxin weapon

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xKen05Subtitle
values.text: *Both of our forces are in place. The two groups must work together if we are to retrieve the toxins

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xKen06Subtitle
values.text: *Our hijackers can capture vehicles and they are stealthed unless they are moving

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xKen07Subtitle
values.text: *Jarmen Kell can snipe pilots from vehicles and also take out infantry at long range

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xKen08Subtitle
values.text: *Our Saboteurs can perform a number of secret operations like shutting down power plants

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xKen09Subtitle
values.text: *Our rebels are camouflaged, and can capture buildings to aid us in our cause

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xKen10Subtitle
values.text: *Good luck, General. May stealth and cunning be with you in your quest

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xKen11Subtitle
values.text: *Good morning, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xKen12Subtitle
values.text: *General, we must capture that ferry

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xKen13Subtitle
values.text: *General, there are mines here, but we cannot detect them! We need a Radar Van!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xKen14Subtitle
values.text: *General, get someone into that Valve station by the river. Draining the coolant reservoir will allow our brothers to continue further

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xKen15Subtitle
values.text: *Excellent

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xKen16Subtitle
values.text: *Good work

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xKen17Subtitle
values.text: *General! Destroy that airfield before we are wiped out!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xKen18Subtitle
values.text: *General. We must destroy their power! Then the Americans will be sitting ducks for sure!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xKen19Subtitle
values.text: *General, we must capture that toxin facility

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xKen20Subtitle
values.text: *Excellent work, General. Now we must protect these trucks as they transport the toxins to the cargo plane

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xKen21Subtitle
values.text: *Use the trucks to begin gathering toxins from the facility

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xKen22Subtitle
values.text: *General, the Americans have sent reinforcements!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xKen23Subtitle
values.text: *Another cell of hijackers has arrived to support our cause

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xKen24Subtitle
values.text: *Another cell of rebels has arrived to support our cause

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xKen25Subtitle
values.text: *JarmenKell has been found and he has returned to help our cause

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xKen26Subtitle
values.text: *Our brothers have broken through and provided us with reinforcements

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xKen27Subtitle
values.text: *The US will not suspect an attack on their soil after our victory in Greece

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xKen28Subtitle
values.text: *Kassad would never have had the courage to attack the US homeland

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xKen29Subtitle
values.text: *Once we've stolen the secret toxin agent from the US Bio Center, we will be unstoppable

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05Buggy104Subtitle
values.text: *Beware Patriot Batteries, they are dangerous

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05Buggy108Subtitle
values.text: *Go to your graves, American scum!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05Kenwar02bSubtitle
values.text: *Destroy the American airbase and they will lose much of their ability to project power in this region

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05Kenwar05Subtitle
values.text: *The Americans will use their airpower to stop us

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05Quad201Subtitle
values.text: *Die American!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05Rebel02Subtitle
values.text: *We are defenseless against American air attacks!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05Scorpion105Subtitle
values.text: *American cowards! Fight on the ground, like men!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05xChat01Subtitle
values.text: *This region is under the control of the United States Air Force General Granger. We can and will use force to remove you from this area. You are hereby under order to clear out immediately

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05xCin01Subtitle
values.text: *Our forces are few, but we can use what we have to come out on top

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05xCin02Subtitle
values.text: *Since we do not have a base in this region we must take one!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05xCin03Subtitle
values.text: *The Chinese base We must strike now! Their Base will soon be ours!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05xJarmen01Subtitle
values.text: *If you rescue our fellow comrades from the Southern US base, our elite warriors will fight alongside you!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05xJarmen02Subtitle
values.text: *Thank you for rescuing our brothers! In return we will open up an area of the US base for you to begin your assault

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05xJarmen03Subtitle
values.text: *Heh heh heh heh heh (Sinister Laugh) That will teach them

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05xJarmen04Subtitle
values.text: *Do not let our deaths go unpunished!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05xJarmen05Subtitle
values.text: *Together we have beaten the enemy! Victory is ours!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05xJarmen06Subtitle
values.text: *Thank you for your help in rescuing my soldiers. We shall repay the favor and help you to take out the U.S. Central Command Base

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05xKen01Subtitle
values.text: *Once this base is destroyed the US will scurry home like cowardly dogs. All of Europe will be ours

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05xKen02Subtitle
values.text: *The Americans have our brethren held hostage in their base. We must rescue them

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05xKen03Subtitle
values.text: *It is in our best interest to rescue the POW's from the clutches of the Americans

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05xKen04Subtitle
values.text: *Good work! Capture or eliminate this base to ensure the POW's safety

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05xKen05Subtitle
values.text: *We must transport them safely back home to their base in the North. No harm must come to them

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05xKen06Subtitle
values.text: *We are running low on supplies. We must spread out and capture new resources

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05xKen07Subtitle
values.text: *More attacks from the air! We must build more air defenses

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05xKen08Subtitle
values.text: *Rebuild our defenses quickly, we haven't long before the next attack

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05xKen09Subtitle
values.text: *The new toxin agent we borrowed from the US will be especially effective against their own forces

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05xKen10Subtitle
values.text: *First the Mediterranean fleet, then an attack upon US soiland now begins our European domination

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05xKen11Subtitle
values.text: *We are being attacked from the east. End the attacks now, we must eliminate them so we can focus on the main base to the north

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05xKen12Subtitle
values.text: *Almost there The U.S. will pay dearly for their transgressions against our people

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05xKen13Subtitle
values.text: *We are running low on funds. Scout the area for resources, we must not be stopped

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05xKen14Subtitle
values.text: *With this area secure we must now build up and launch an assault on the U.S. European Central Command Base

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05xKen15Subtitle
values.text: *The Americans are relying heavily on air units. Build more Stinger sites and Quad Cannons

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05xKen16Subtitle
values.text: *They are targeting our defenses, we must camouflage the stinger sites

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05xKen17Subtitle
values.text: *My General, we need to build a Scud Storm

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05xKen18Subtitle
values.text: *The American General is using a Particle Cannon against us

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05xKen19Subtitle
values.text: *We have to try a different tactic. Use a sneak attack to get units into the base

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05xKen20Subtitle
values.text: *Capture the U.S. base and build it up. We can use their weapons against them

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05xKen21Subtitle
values.text: *You must take out the Particle Cannon!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05xKen22Subtitle
values.text: *They are attacking from the ground now. Defend our base!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05xKen23Subtitle
values.text: *Rebuild the base quicklyWe must prepare for more attacks!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05xKen24Subtitle
values.text: *Well done, General. Thanks to your superior tactics we now control all three super weapons. The Americans will never know what hit them!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05xKen25Subtitle
values.text: *Finish the Americans, General. They cannot hold for much longer

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05xKen26Subtitle
values.text: *General, we can target their chemical bunkers and create havoc in their own base

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05xKen27Subtitle
values.text: *Their Particle Cannon is no more

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05xKen28Subtitle
values.text: *The Americans have built another Particle Cannon. They must not be allowed to use it against us

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05xKen29Subtitle
values.text: *We must eliminate the enemy's Southern support base now! The longer we wait, the more their attacks grow in strength

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05xKen30Subtitle
values.text: *Reports indicate that the POW's held captive in the U.S. Base will be moved soon. We must rescue them quickly!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05xKen31Subtitle
values.text: *You will need to completely clear the U.S. base area to free the POW's

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05xKen32Subtitle
values.text: *Hurry, the POW's need to be rescued now!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05xKen33Subtitle
values.text: *We need to bring Radar online by upgrading it from the China Command Center

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05xKen34Subtitle
values.text: *It is imperative that you build a GLA Command Center

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05xKen35Subtitle
values.text: *With the small southern base gone we can focus on the U.S. European Central Command base

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05xKen36Subtitle
values.text: *The U.S. Central Command Base is massive, we have to find a way in! Perhaps sneak attacks would work

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05xKen37Subtitle
values.text: *We need to deliver the POW's to their village so that they will reawaken their Terror Cell

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05xKen38Subtitle
values.text: *Our brothers are being attacked! We must help them!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05xKen39Subtitle
values.text: *Return the POW's to their village, follow the river North until you reach it

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05xKen40Subtitle
values.text: *The POW's are safe! We must help them return to their village so that they may aid us in our fight against the US!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05xKen41Subtitle
values.text: *Take these tanks and we will use them as our own!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05xKen42Subtitle
values.text: *Secure the supplies and we will hold the perfect area from which to launch our assaults on the Americans!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05xKen43Subtitle
values.text: *The soldiers are safe and their families are full of joy! They will fight with us and we have been given more supplies as well

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05xKen44Subtitle
values.text: *We have let our brothers down but they will still fight alongside us

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05xKen45Subtitle
values.text: *Our brothers will fight on our side to avenge the death of the POW's!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05xKen46Subtitle
values.text: *The Americans have moved the POW's, but our brothers will still fight alongside us against our enemy!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05xKen47Subtitle
values.text: *Europe will soon be ours!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05xPOW01Subtitle
values.text: *Free us from our captors. Protect us from all US attacks and we will assist you!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05xPOW02Subtitle
values.text: *We are ready to travel home when you are

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05xPOW03Subtitle
values.text: *Hurry, there is little time!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05xPOW04Subtitle
values.text: *Our time is running out!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05xPOW05Subtitle
values.text: *Please save us!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05xPOW06Subtitle
values.text: *We need your help!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA06Chatter01Subtitle
values.text: *Bridge up ahead. Looks heavily defended

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA06Chatter02Subtitle
values.text: *We're coming up on a bridge. No Americans

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA06Chatter07Subtitle
values.text: *Die Americans!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA06Cin01Subtitle
values.text: *Die Americans!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA06General05Subtitle
values.text: *We have been discovered by the American scouts. Be ready to fight

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA06General20Subtitle
values.text: *You must push them back so you can take control of the bunkers

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA07Convoy13Subtitle
values.text: *We have found some supplies, could be useful

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA08Buggy101Subtitle
values.text: *To glory!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA08Kenwar10Subtitle
values.text: *We will have to hit them with everything we have

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA08Kenwar39Subtitle
values.text: *Our forces are prepared to begin the assault

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA01Commander03Subtitle
values.text: *Fast movers in-bound

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA01Commander09Subtitle
values.text: *Echo company, bomber in-bound, you're too close, pull back!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA01Echo108Subtitle
values.text: *More contacts, range 300

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA01Echo201Subtitle
values.text: *I'm hit!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA01Eva02Subtitle
values.text: *General, capture enemy oil derricks to secure more supplies for the war effort

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA01Raptor201Subtitle
values.text: *Light 'em up

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA01xBrf01Subtitle
values.text: *Welcome back, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA01xBrf02Subtitle
values.text: *The GLA launched their missile from the Baikonur Facility early this morning. Intel reports that they are preparing a second launch

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA01xBrf03Subtitle
values.text: *Use of this missile will severely weaken our foothold in Europe. It is vital that we remove this threat

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA01xBrf04Subtitle
values.text: *Our sources indicate that the next missile is being transported to the launch facility by train. These tracks are the only way into the facility

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA01xBrf05Subtitle
values.text: *If we can intercept that train in time, we can use it as cover to infiltrate the base

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA01xBrf06Subtitle
values.text: *The first step in completing our mission is to secure and hold this Train Depot

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA01xBrf07Subtitle
values.text: *Good luck, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA01xC+A39hat11Subtitle
values.text: *More GLA structures to the east!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA01xChat01Subtitle
values.text: *Scorpions at 9 o clock!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA01xChat02Subtitle
values.text: *All aboard!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA01xChat03Subtitle
values.text: *Everybody got their tickets?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA01xChat04Subtitle
values.text: *Honey, I'm home! Ha ha ha

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA01xChat05Subtitle
values.text: *Get some infantry into these vehicles! We can use them to help defeat the GLA!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA01xChat06Subtitle
values.text: *Somebody garrison that Radio Station! We need air support now!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA01xChat07Subtitle
values.text: *Aim for those barrels! They're explosive!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA01xChat08Subtitle
values.text: *Ok boys. Let's load 'em up, and mooove 'em out!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA01xChat09Subtitle
values.text: *Stinger sites are down! Repeat Stingers down! All units converge on GLA structures! Let's tear this place up!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA01xChat10Subtitle
values.text: *More GLA structures to the west!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA01xChat12Subtitle
values.text: *Will do, HQ! Got 'em in my sights

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA01xChat13Subtitle
values.text: *Delivering payload

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA01xChat14Subtitle
values.text: *Love that fresh smell of MOAB in the morning

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA01xCin01Subtitle
values.text: *All units clear the launch area. Launch is scheduled in t-minus

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA01xCin08Subtitle
values.text: *We have launch

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA01xCin09Subtitle
values.text: *Launch is a go

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA01xCin10Subtitle
values.text: *Filthy Americans. We will torch your presence here

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA01xCin11Subtitle
values.text: *Stupid American cowboys!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA01xEva01Subtitle
values.text: *Good work, General. The depot is secured

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA01xEva02Subtitle
values.text: *Now we need to build an attack force large enough to destroy the GLA base

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA01xEva03Subtitle
values.text: *Load your best units onto the train

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA01xEva04Subtitle
values.text: *The train will depart when it is completely full

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA01xEva05Subtitle
values.text: *Good work, General the train is full

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA01xEva06Subtitle
values.text: *Get that Dragon Tank up there to clear out those buildings

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA01xEva07Subtitle
values.text: *Build more units. We don't want to fail in our surprise attack

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA01xEva08Subtitle
values.text: *General! Get your men out of the pit! We've got MOABS on the way that are gonna blow this place to bits

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA01xEva09Subtitle
values.text: *We need to finish destroying this base!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA01xEva10Subtitle
values.text: *The MOABs will be here any minute!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA01xEva11Subtitle
values.text: *Alpha Wing! Area is clear. You may proceed

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA01xEva12Subtitle
values.text: *Good work, General. It looks like the GLA threat has finally been removed. It's time to put all this behind us and get looking for those WMDs

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02Comanche101Subtitle
values.text: *Thanks for getting me out, sir! Things were getting a little dicey for me

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02Comanche204Subtitle
values.text: *They're swarming us, sir!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xBrf01Subtitle
values.text: *The docks have been cleared, General. Our first task will be to hold them while the supply trucks are brought in. Until the Dozers arrive, we will have to defend this position with our troops as they filter in

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xBrf02Subtitle
values.text: *Most of our fleet survived the GLA Baikonur Attack. Our Aircraft Carrier and Battleship escorts are at your disposal to aid with this operation

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xChat01Subtitle
values.text: *Air-strike Launched

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xChat02Subtitle
values.text: *Battleship commencing bombardment

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xChat03Subtitle
values.text: *Docks are all clear. No GLA in sight

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xChat04Subtitle
values.text: *Roger that

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xChat05Subtitle
values.text: *Commencing Attack

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xChat06Subtitle
values.text: *Launching Air-strike

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xChat07Subtitle
values.text: *Guns a blazing

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xChat08Subtitle
values.text: *We'll give them some red glare alright

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xCin01Subtitle
values.text: *Carrier Command to fleet. Keep up the fire, boys. The GLA are bringing in reinforcements

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xCin02Subtitle
values.text: *Roger that, Carrier command. Maintaining suppression fire on the docks

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xCin03Subtitle
values.text: *Be careful what you hit. We just want to clear it out, not destroy it

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xEva01Subtitle
values.text: *Good work, sir! Our next objective is to provide safe passage for the supply trucks as they travel through the city. The trucks must reach the city's supply warehouse. We must also retain control of the docks. Good luck, sir

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xEva02Subtitle
values.text: *Supply Trucks are beginning to move, General. We must provide protection as they make their way to the drop off point

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xEva03Subtitle
values.text: *I'm sending you some new prototype sentry drones. The enemy can't detect them if they stay still. The drones are also capable of spotting stealthed units as well as GLA demo traps. They should prove to be very useful

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xEva04Subtitle
values.text: *Our dozer has arrived sir! Begin building up your base. The GLA are preparing a new wave of attacks against us!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xEva05Subtitle
values.text: *Great job, sir! The people of this city have expressed their gratitude for the relief supplies. Our final objective is to drive the GLA from the area. Destroy their main base overlooking the city and the area will be secured

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xEva06Subtitle
values.text: *Reinforcements incoming, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xEva07Subtitle
values.text: *General, our Sentry Drones can help spot GLA Demo Traps

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xEva08Subtitle
values.text: *Sir, there are still GLA near the warehouse. We need to clear them out immediately

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xEva09Subtitle
values.text: *Supply Trucks are under attack!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xEva10Subtitle
values.text: *Good job, all trucks are safely to the docks, now lets get them to the city

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xEva11Subtitle
values.text: *Try to minimize civilian casualties

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xEva12Subtitle
values.text: *You've discovered a GLA training camp, sir. Intelligence believes that members of this camp were partially responsible for the Baikonur Launch. We have been ordered to take it out

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xEva13Subtitle
values.text: *Secure the warehouse so the supply trucks can proceed safely

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xEva14Subtitle
values.text: *Once the warehouse is secure the supply trucks will proceed

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xEva15Subtitle
values.text: *Dozers have arrived general. You are cleared to eliminate the GLA at your discretion

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xEva16Subtitle
values.text: *Get the food to the city before the GLA can steal or destroy it

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xEva17Subtitle
values.text: *General, we've done it. The city is free from the GLA tyranny. It looks like they've got some Intel that will lead us straight to those hidden WMDs

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xEva18Subtitle
values.text: *Full naval support is available for this operation

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xEva19Subtitle
values.text: *Use the battleships and aircraft carrier at your discretion

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xEva20Subtitle
values.text: *The battleships are in range and awaiting targets, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xEva21Subtitle
values.text: *The CVN Daedalus is standing by with aircraft at the ready

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xEva22Subtitle
values.text: *The warehouse needs to be secured, but the safety of the docks must not be compromised

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xEva23Subtitle
values.text: *Our forces are limited in this area. You will receive reinforcements as they become available

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xEva24Subtitle
values.text: *Secure the warehouse without compromising the safety of the docks

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xEva25Subtitle
values.text: *The convoy has resupplied the warehouse

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xEva26Subtitle
values.text: *The GLA Base is the next objective, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xSupply01Subtitle
values.text: *As soon as that warehouse is safe, we will roll out

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xSupply02Subtitle
values.text: *Thanks for the cover fire, General! All trucks loaded and ready to move out. Just clear out that city for us, sir!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xSupply03Subtitle
values.text: *The streets are lined with Demo Traps, sir! We'll need them swept clear!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xSupply04Subtitle
values.text: *We've reached the warehouse, General. Thanks for the escort!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xSupply05Subtitle
values.text: *Convoy's arrived safely, sir. Thanks for the cover

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xVillager01Subtitle
values.text: *Oh thank you

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xVillager02Subtitle
values.text: *Bless You

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xVillager03Subtitle
values.text: *I haven't eaten in so long

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA02xVillager04Subtitle
values.text: *Will there be any more?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03Comanche102Subtitle
values.text: *Quad Cannons are picking us apart, sir

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03Crusader105Subtitle
values.text: *We need more support! They're chewing us up!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03Crusader108Subtitle
values.text: *Someone get those buggies off us!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03Crusader304Subtitle
values.text: *Enemy contacts confirmed! They're moving in fast!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03Crusader307Subtitle
values.text: *All units! Keep up the fire!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xBrf01Subtitle
values.text: *General, Col Burton and Black Lotus are in position and ready for your orders

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xBrf02Subtitle
values.text: *Their primary objective is this secret laboratory. It's location was revealed by the documents captured during your last mission

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xBrf03Subtitle
values.text: *The GLA are working on a new weapon of mass destruction. Black Lotus must download this data so we know how far along their research has come

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xBrf04Subtitle
values.text: *Once she has completed her download, Col Burton must bring the mountainside down on the lab and bury it forever

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xBurton01Subtitle
values.text: *We're at the bridge. Lotus, take care of that Scorpion, I'll deal with the other guards

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xBurton02Subtitle
values.text: *That wasn't part of the plan, Lotus

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xBurton03Subtitle
values.text: *You'll wait for me? All right, Lotus, let's race

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xBurton04Subtitle
values.text: *I'm on my way

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xBurton05Subtitle
values.text: *All right, I see the POW camplooks like they have a Tunnel Network that passes under the river

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xBurton06Subtitle
values.text: *Nice work, LotusTunnels down herejust take care of a couple guards and I'll have everyone freed

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xBurton07Subtitle
values.text: *Those vehicles would come in handy if the intel about the defenses around the mountains are correct. General, we ought to rescue them, too

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xBurton08Subtitle
values.text: *General, I'm in position near the second POW Campthere's a Tunnel Network and guards out front. I could slip past them into the compound if I climbed down the cliffs on the south end of the camp

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xBurton09Subtitle
values.text: *Don't get cocky, Lotus, you haven't won this race yet

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xBurton10Subtitle
values.text: *That's the last of themsecond POW Camp is securedsomeone should tell Lotus to hurry upI don't want to be kept waiting at the Lab

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xBurton11Subtitle
values.text: *That's some new toy. General, if you focus it at those Tunnel Networks and Stinger Sites guarding the mountain, I'll slip right by them

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xBurton12Subtitle
values.text: *Looks like a whole GLA base. Intel never said anything about this being here

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xBurton13Subtitle
values.text: *Doesn't look like they were expecting mea little C4 here and there and I'll make short work of this placejust say the word, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xBurton14Subtitle
values.text: *I should be safe moving through the villagejust need to watch out for any Radar Vans monitoring the area. Wish I had a couple Flash Bangs

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xBurton15Subtitle
values.text: *This is it! I'm moving into position above the Labdon't keep me waiting Lotus, its cold up here

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xBurton16Subtitle
values.text: *Charges setsay when, Lotus

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xBurton17Subtitle
values.text: *Well, Lotus, you're fastI'll give you that. I'll be there as soon as I can

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xBurton18Subtitle
values.text: *AlrightI'm at the mountainTell me when your download finishes, Lotus, and I'll bury that lab where no one will ever find it again

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xChat01Subtitle
values.text: *Garrisoneat Flash Bang

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xChat02Subtitle
values.text: *There they areremember, short controlled bursts

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xChat03Subtitle
values.text: *Infantry? No problem

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xChat04Subtitle
values.text: *We're taking firewe need some support here!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xCin01Subtitle
values.text: *This is Spirit, I am rolling in over the target area

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xCin02Subtitle
values.text: *Roger, Spirit, mission is go. You ready to do this?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xCin03Subtitle
values.text: *Yes, Colonel, let us begin

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xCin04Subtitle
values.text: *This is Spirit, bomb bay doors open bombs are away

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xCin05Subtitle
values.text: *Spirit to Infiltrator, your LZ is clearGood Luck

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xCin06Subtitle
values.text: *Roger, Spirit, nice shooting

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xCin07Subtitle
values.text: *On stationeverybody out who's staying

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xCin08Subtitle
values.text: *Thanks for the lift boyssee you soon

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xCin09Subtitle
values.text: *Your small Chinooks are efficientbut I prefer the strength of our Helixes...

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xDrvr01Subtitle
values.text: *We're free! Everyone to your vehicles!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xDrvr02Subtitle
values.text: *Thanks, General. We're at your command

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xEva01Subtitle
values.text: *General, your first objective is the destruction of this bridge. Its destruction will cut off GLA reinforcements from the other side of the river

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xEva02Subtitle
values.text: *General, GLA reinforcements have been sighted crossing the bridge

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xEva03Subtitle
values.text: *Another GLA squad has entered the area, General. Perhaps we should take care of that bridge now?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xEva04Subtitle
values.text: *General, it appears that there are several GLA Radar Vans in the area, if your forces get to close, they will be detected

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xEva05Subtitle
values.text: *Excellent job, General. Now you only need to worry about GLA forces on this side of the river

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xEva06Subtitle
values.text: *The GLA have a POW camp along the route Col Burton must take to the GLA Lab. If you free the men held there, Col Burton will have an easier time getting to the Lab

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xEva07Subtitle
values.text: *General, intel suggests you free the men at the POW camp before you send Col Burton too far away

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xEva08Subtitle
values.text: *Congratulations, General, I'm sure the families of those men will be happy to hear they've been rescued

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xEva09Subtitle
values.text: *General, the GLA's Lab is directly north of your current position. There are a number of GLA defenses still along your routebe careful

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xEva10Subtitle
values.text: *It appears that those Oil Derricks are the only source of income for the GLA base. If you can destroy them you will cripple the GLA here

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xEva11Subtitle
values.text: *General, I'm patching through Black Lotus

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xEva12Subtitle
values.text: *General, the men you just rescued are driving our newest vehicle, the Microwave Tank

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xEva13Subtitle
values.text: *This vehicle has two modes: The first generates a continuous microwave field in front of the vehicle - very lethal to all infantry. The second allows it to disrupt the functions of any targeted building

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xEva14Subtitle
values.text: *General, the GLA know we are here and appear to be on heightened alert. Be careful when moving Col Burton into position above their Secret Lab

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xEva15Subtitle
values.text: *General, the GLA have upgraded their tank shells to contain poisons. Be careful.

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xEva16Subtitle
values.text: *I'm showing a GLA patrol in that village, Generalas well as a number of enemy forces garrisoned throughout the village

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xEva17Subtitle
values.text: *Maybe Black Lotus can find out more Intel about who is behind the GLA WMD program

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xEva18Subtitle
values.text: *That was incredible General. Looks like the GLA won't be using that facility anymoreand it seems Black Lotus downloaded some vital info about the source of this lab. For now, let's regroup and see what she was able to find out. Great work

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xLotus01Subtitle
values.text: *The scorpion is disabledI will take care of matters across the river. Wait until I am across and then destroy the bridge

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xLotus02Subtitle
values.text: *It is now. Don't worry, I'll wait for you at the labdo hurry

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xLotus03Subtitle
values.text: *General, I am in a position to help free your forces held prisoner. Perhaps Col. Burton would like to help?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xLotus04Subtitle
values.text: *General, could you ask Col Burton to please hurry to the POW campI'm tired of waiting on him

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xLotus05Subtitle
values.text: *I will draw the camp guards attention to this side of the river. That should let you and your pet robots handle the Tunnel and free your captured men

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xLotus06Subtitle
values.text: *Generalmy forces are moving on the final GLA positions this side of the river. Please inform Col Burton that he should hurryI would prefer not to wait too long for him to catch up

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xLotus07Subtitle
values.text: *Please inform Col Burton that I shall be waiting for HIM at the Lab

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xLotus08Subtitle
values.text: *I'm here, Colonelyou win. The GLA put up a stronger fight than I had anticipated. Beginning download

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xLotus09Subtitle
values.text: *I have the data! Now, Colonel!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xLotus10Subtitle
values.text: *General. I am ready and waiting at the Labwhenever the Colonel would like to arrive and finish this mission

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xLotus11Subtitle
values.text: *It is cold out here. You are coming aren't you Burton?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xLotus12Subtitle
values.text: *Downloading the information now

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xRngr01Subtitle
values.text: *Thanks for the rescue, Sir

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xRngr02Subtitle
values.text: *A couple of our men broke off to check out the village east of here before we were captured. They may still be over there

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xRngr03Subtitle
values.text: *Good to see you, General, we thought we were going to end up captured

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xRngr04Subtitle
values.text: *The rest of our team was captured just after we got to the village. General, we'd like to volunteer to rescue them

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA03xRngr05Subtitle
values.text: *General, a squad of vehicles was captured just after we were taken. The GLA are holding them in a camp just north of here

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04Eva02Subtitle
values.text: *Reinforcements arrived

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04Eva07Subtitle
values.text: *We need to clear out these Stinger Sites before we can bring in our bombers to clear the GLA from the area

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04Eva08Subtitle
values.text: *Construction crews have arrived sir. You'll need to get our base setup before we're overrun by the GLA

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04Eva09Subtitle
values.text: *Our final objective is this GLA base here, in the hills. Take it out, and the operation is complete

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04Officer03Subtitle
values.text: *Terrorists detected. All units be on the alert

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04Ranger01Subtitle
values.text: *Calling in GLA bunker location at grid square Beta Charlie 6-8-9er-4-4

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04Transport01Subtitle
values.text: *Transport teams 1 and 2 approaching the landing zone

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04Transport03Subtitle
values.text: *Transport Team 1 reporting! Mission completed! I'm pulling out!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xBrf01Subtitle
values.text: *General, intelligence reports that the rogue forces behind this GLA splinter cell are commanded by Dr. Thrax

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xBrf02Subtitle
values.text: *Dr. Thrax is a wanted criminalresponsible for notorious terror crimes against the US military. He must be brought to justice

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xBrf03Subtitle
values.text: *Dr. Thrax was developing a brand new toxin at his secret mountain lab. Thank goodness Lotus and Burton were there to stop him

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xBrf04Subtitle
values.text: *Dr. Thrax is receiving his funding from his oil fields. We must cut off his flow of oil

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xBrf05Subtitle
values.text: *The Intel we retrieved from the Secret Lab proves the GLA have seized these oil fields to help fund the nefarious Dr. Thrax. They may destroy them, rather then let you recapture them. Beware General, the GLA have started using Booby Trapsuse Dozers to remove BOOBY TRAPS safely

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xChat01Subtitle
values.text: *Sir! Toxin Tractors are eating us up! Send help!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xChat02Subtitle
values.text: *Toxin Tractors! Pull your infantry back!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xChat03Subtitle
values.text: *Quad Cannons spotted sir!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xChat04Subtitle
values.text: *We're losing units to Quad Cannons, sir! Send armor!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xChat05Subtitle
values.text: * NO! Bravo Three was killed by a Quad Cannon, Sir!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xChat06Subtitle
values.text: *The enemy has started sending tanks, sir! Send Missile defenders!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xChat07Subtitle
values.text: *Ha! GLA tanks are no match for us!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xChat08Subtitle
values.text: *Sir, we're losing units to enemy Tanks!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xChat09Subtitle
values.text: *What's the enemy doing with those radar vans?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xChat10Subtitle
values.text: *Was that a car bomb?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xChat11Subtitle
values.text: *Where are those car bombs coming from?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xChat12Subtitle
values.text: *Sir, we need more defenses out here! Car Bombs are tearing us up!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xChat13Subtitle
values.text: *Bomb trucks?! That's not fair!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xChat14Subtitle
values.text: *Sir, we need better defenses against these Bomb Trucks!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xChat15Subtitle
values.text: *Sir, we've engaged angry mobs! Send anti-personnel units!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xChat16Subtitle
values.text: *Angry mobs are destroying us! Send some snipers out here!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xChat17Subtitle
values.text: *Sir, we need to do something about these ANGRY MOBS!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xChat18Subtitle
values.text: *Sir, we're losing units to Terrorists, can we get a sniper out here?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xChat19Subtitle
values.text: *Sir, these Terrorists are chewing us up! Send support!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xChat20Subtitle
values.text: *Geez! What's with all these demo traps!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xChat21Subtitle
values.text: *Sir, this field is littered with Demo Traps! We need to clear them out!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xChat22Subtitle
values.text: *What?! We've lost a structure to a CAR BOMBER!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xChat23Subtitle
values.text: *Car Bombers are attacking us! The appear to be coming from the local town

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xChat24Subtitle
values.text: *Whoa! Those bomb trucks pack a punch!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xChat25Subtitle
values.text: *Ouch! That one hurt!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xChat26Subtitle
values.text: *Sir, build more defenses to protect against the BOMB TRUCKS!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xChat27Subtitle
values.text: *Whoa! Those mobs are ANGRY!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xChat28Subtitle
values.text: *Sir, we need a Pathfinder to deal with those ANGRY MOBS!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xChat29Subtitle
values.text: *Sir, we need anti-personnel out here NOW! These angry mobs are chewing us up!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xChat30Subtitle
values.text: *Sir, we've lost a building to a car bomb

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xChat31Subtitle
values.text: *Terrorists are destroying our buildings! Call in snipers!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xChat32Subtitle
values.text: *Sir! Their Bomb Trucks are destroying our base!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xCIA01Subtitle
values.text: *Good to see some friendlies! Let's rock!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xCIA02Subtitle
values.text: *Following your lead, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xCIA03Subtitle
values.text: *Here I am, lead on

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xCin01Subtitle
values.text: *Satcom, this is Charlie 5. Approaching TARGET, no hostiles sightedwaitTARGET is in sight, Satcomover

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xCin02Subtitle
values.text: *Roger that 5You are a go, over

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xCin03Subtitle
values.text: *Roger Satcompayload is awayleaving hotzone! Over

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xCin04Subtitle
values.text: *Roger that 5, out. Victor 3 you are go for IMMEDIATE dropover

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xCin05Subtitle
values.text: *Roger Satcomapproaching target area

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xCin06Subtitle
values.text: *Lock and Load!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xCin07Subtitle
values.text: *Jump! Jump!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xCin08Subtitle
values.text: *Careful not to get slimed, boyschem weapons sighted

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xCin09Subtitle
values.text: *This is no MILK RUN, boys! Keep your heads!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xCin10Subtitle
values.text: *Stay in formation!! No Cowboys!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xCin11Subtitle
values.text: *Goats are away. Retuning to barn. Out

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xCin12Subtitle
values.text: *Bravo team, your primary objective is the small airstrip to your South. Secure it for incoming reinforcements. Out

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xCin13Subtitle
values.text: *Roger Satcom, moving out. Listen up kids! This is a FREE FIRE ZONE! Watch for ROACHES! If it moves kill it

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xCin14Subtitle
values.text: *Airstrip secured, GeneralReinforcements en route

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xEva01Subtitle
values.text: *The GLA has started using BOOBY-TRAPS on structures in this area. They will explode if you try to capture or garrison them. Use Dozers to remove them

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xEva02Subtitle
values.text: *The GLA has seized the nearby oil fields. Protect the derricks and destroy the GLA base

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xEva03Subtitle
values.text: *BE CAREFUL, General; the enemy may have set up traps in the oil field

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xEva04Subtitle
values.text: *Good news, General. Colonel Burton knows several covert operatives in this area. Lead Burton to the ops to solicit their help

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xEva05Subtitle
values.text: *Good news, General. There are several covert operatives in this area. Find them to solicit their help

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xEva06Subtitle
values.text: *Well done General, this region is now free of GLA troublemakers

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xEva07Subtitle
values.text: *Well done, General. This area has been secured

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xEva08Subtitle
values.text: *General, Your ultimate objective is to destroy the GLA base in this area. Your main source of funding will be the oil derricks. You must secure and protect them!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xEva09Subtitle
values.text: *Well done, General. Your mission is a success

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xEva10Subtitle
values.text: *General, the local town is being poisoned by GLA propaganda and are launching attacks against us. Destroy the GLA radio station to quell the uprising

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xEva11Subtitle
values.text: *Destroy the GLA radio-station in the city to quell the uprising

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xEva12Subtitle
values.text: *Well done, General. The GLA propaganda machine has been destroyed

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xEva13Subtitle
values.text: *Destroy the GLA RADIO STATION in the city to stop the car-bomb attacks

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xEva14Subtitle
values.text: *Destroy the GLA RADIO STATION in the city to stop the bomb-truck attacks

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xEva15Subtitle
values.text: *Destroy the GLA RADIO STATION in the city to stop the suicide attacks

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xEva16Subtitle
values.text: *General, there are several ARTILLERY PLATFORMS in the area. Capture them for suppression fire

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xEva17Subtitle
values.text: *General, There is a REPAIR PAD in the area. Capture it to help heal our vehicles

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xEva18Subtitle
values.text: *Sir, please build more defenses to protect against the car bombers

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xEva19Subtitle
values.text: *Sir, the enemy has started deploying Radar Vans, they can spot our pathfinders!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xEva20Subtitle
values.text: *Sir, the enemy's Radar Vans are sweeping for our pathfindersbe careful

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xEva21Subtitle
values.text: *Sir, we should build Patriots to counter the bomb trucks

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xEva22Subtitle
values.text: *Sir, Enemy Terrorists are proving highly effective. I suggest you send Pathfinders

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xEva23Subtitle
values.text: *Sir! We're losing units to Demo Traps, please be more careful!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xEva24Subtitle
values.text: *General, There is an OIL REFINERY in the area. Capture it to reduce vehicle cost

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xEva25Subtitle
values.text: *Sir, the enemy has begun attacking the OIL FIELDS

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xEva26Subtitle
values.text:
*WARNING: OIL derrick DESTROYED! 
 Only 1 derrick remains!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xEva27Subtitle
values.text:
*WARNING: OIL derrick DESTROYED! 
 Only 5 derricks remain

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xEva28Subtitle
values.text:
*WARNING: OIL derrick DESTROYED! 
 Only 10 derricks remain

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xEva29Subtitle
values.text:
*WARNING: OIL derrick DESTROYED! 
 15 derricks remain

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xEva30Subtitle
values.text: *General, our cash reserves are running low -- capture oil derricks for needed cash

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xEva31Subtitle
values.text: *WARNING: SCUDSTORM DETECTED!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xEva32Subtitle
values.text: *General! Colonel Burton is down!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xEva33Subtitle
values.text: *All the oil derricks have been DESTROYED! Your mission is a failure

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xEva34Subtitle
values.text: *Your base has been destroyed! Your mission is a failure

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA04xEva35Subtitle
values.text: *Good luck, sir

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xChat01Subtitle
values.text: *Our base is being attacked sir. They built a tunnel network inside our base without us knowing

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xChat02Subtitle
values.text: *Those buses are loaded with hostiles sir! Watch out!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xChat03Subtitle
values.text: *Our base is being attacked sir. They built a tunnel network inside our base without us knowing

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xChat04Subtitle
values.text: *We offer you our assistance to rid us of this Toxin Monger. His obsession will kill us all and that we cannot allow

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xChat05Subtitle
values.text: *Death to the Devil of Disease!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xChat06Subtitle
values.text: *Help! Over here, please release me

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xChat07Subtitle
values.text: *Thank you for releasing me. Transport me to my base in the East and I can help you

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xCin01Subtitle
values.text: *Sat-Com A4 has confirmation on base location. Visuals are uploading now

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xCin02Subtitle
values.text: *Field, please verify status of Toxin Production facilities

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xCin03Subtitle
values.text: *Then we have a go upon presentation of final clearance code

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xCin04Subtitle
values.text: *Roger that, Alpha Whiskey Echo, the birds are in the air

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xCin05Subtitle
values.text: *Toxin Production Facilities confirmed sir

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xCin06Subtitle
values.text: *Clearance code is Sierra, Hotel, Oscar, Charlie Kilo

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xEva01Subtitle
values.text: *Phase one of our operation has been completed General. Our Tomahawk Missile strike was successful in destroying all of GLA's Toxin production facilities. Only their main base and Toxin Missile silo's remain to be eliminated

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xEva02Subtitle
values.text: *General, we've tracked Dr. Thrax to this remote location. He is in possession of chemical tipped missiles, and has them prepped for launch. Destroying his toxin storage tanks has slowed him down, but we must move in and secure those missiles before they can be launched

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xEva03Subtitle
values.text: *General, Dr. Thrax was able to develop small quantities of his new toxin. Make sure your forces are on high alert

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xEva04Subtitle
values.text: *General, due to the civilian presence in this location you will need to use ground forces to assault the final base and capture the 4 toxin missile sites in the area. Our successful liberation of the oil sites in Amisbad has provided us with additional resources for this operation

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xEva05Subtitle
values.text: *Dr. Thrax must be defeated so he can't inflict further terror on the world. General, you must stop him

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xEva06Subtitle
values.text: *Our Intel indicates that this is the best area to build your base. Local unrest may be in your favor. Good luck

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xEva07Subtitle
values.text: *General, the local GLA have responded to your rescue and have given us control of their base. You may now use their forces in your attack

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xEva08Subtitle
values.text: *General, your main objective is to capture the 4 Toxin Missile Silo's targeted on US major metropolitan areas before they launch

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xEva09Subtitle
values.text: *General, infrared scans of the area indicate that they are preparing to launch the Toxin Missiles

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xEva10Subtitle
values.text: *Missile launch in 5 minutes Your final offensive should commence now

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xEva11Subtitle
values.text: *Missile launch in 4 minutes

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xEva12Subtitle
values.text: *Missile launch in 3 minutes

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xEva13Subtitle
values.text: *Missile launch in 2 minutes

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xEva14Subtitle
values.text: *Missile launch in 1 minute We must move in now!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xEva15Subtitle
values.text: *30 seconds until missile launch It's almost too late General!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xEva16Subtitle
values.text: *10 seconds until missile launch

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xEva17Subtitle
values.text: *5 4 3 2 1 (gasp) Toxin Missile Launch detected General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xEva18Subtitle
values.text: *Toxin Missile Impact has been detected and Hot Zone is now confirmed. The casualties are incalculable General, we have failed

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xEva19Subtitle
values.text: *The first Missile Silo has been captured and the HazMat decontamination team is en-route. One to go Commander

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xEva20Subtitle
values.text: *Good job, sir. The second Missile Silo has been captured. Two to go

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xEva21Subtitle
values.text: *Good job, sir. The third Missile Silo has been captured. One to go

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xEva22Subtitle
values.text: *Great work, General. We now have control of all 4 Toxin Missile silo's. The operation is a success

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xEva23Subtitle
values.text: *Toxin breach, you have 2 minutes to guide the Bio-engineer to the hot zone to neutralize the threat

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xEva24Subtitle
values.text: *We have a green light for the operation. Launch the attack on GLA's perimeter base

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xEva25Subtitle
values.text: *Intel says that the Missile Sites we are looking for are in this region. Use caution and make sure those toxins aren't released

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xEva26Subtitle
values.text: *Infantry won't work well here, General. Our enemy is using toxins in almost every weapon that they throw at us

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xEva27Subtitle
values.text: *General, your objective is to capture this structure, not destroy it! If those toxins are released then the region will be contaminated for 100 square miles!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xEva28Subtitle
values.text: *General, our intel indicates that if we can leak the napalm in those tanks into those nearby tunnels exits we can flood their whole system

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xEva29Subtitle
values.text: *Congratulations General. Dr. Thrax won't be poisoning the world with his creations any longer

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xEva30Subtitle
values.text: *Now that Dr. Thrax is defeated we can finally bring our boys home. Good work, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xEva31Subtitle
values.text: *We have a green light on Operation: Eagle's Strike. Launch the attack on Toxin Production facilities

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xEva32Subtitle
values.text: *General, your orders are to build a base to attack the Toxin General. As your forces are ready then capture the enemies 4 Toxin Missile sites before they can launch

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xEva33Subtitle
values.text: *General, the GLA base to the east has decided to Rebel against the Toxin General and his mass use of toxins. They wish to aid us in our attack against the General by giving us use of their base

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xEva34Subtitle
values.text: *General, the enemy has detected our presence in their main base and have begun launch preparations for the Toxin Missiles. The should have launch capability in approximately 30 minutes. Intel has located and revealed the 4 missile sites on your radar screen

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xEva35Subtitle
values.text: *General, Intel puts some of the Missiles in this region. Take care not to release the toxin!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xThrax01Subtitle
values.text: *You are too late infidel, the launch is commencing to cleanse your lands in pestilence. Hahahaha

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xThrax02Subtitle
values.text: *Your betrayal has not gone unnoticed. You will burn with the infidels you now assist. May your sons camels swell with virulence!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA05xThrax03Subtitle
values.text: *My reach is long and now you will feel my wrath! Die infidel dogs, die!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA06Crusader101Subtitle
values.text: *Enemy sighted!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA06Crusader102Subtitle
values.text: *More GLA. Lock and load

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA06Crusader202Subtitle
values.text: *They're too well dug in! We need reinforcements!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA06Crusader206Subtitle
values.text: *Stop those Tractors!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA06Officer05Subtitle
values.text: *Concentrate your fire, men!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA07Crusader204Subtitle
values.text: *We've broken through to the north! Send reinforcements

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA07Crusader205Subtitle
values.text: *They're everywhere!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA07Crusader301Subtitle
values.text: *Be advised, car bombs in the area

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA07Crusader303Subtitle
values.text: *We've crossed the bridge. Sweep and clear

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA07Crusader306Subtitle
values.text: *Heeelp!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA07Officer01Subtitle
values.text: *We've got to clear the area! Destroy everything!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA07Officer02Subtitle
values.text: *Destroy everything not American. Leave nothing behind!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA07Officer03Subtitle
values.text: *Copy that Delta two. Your orders are to fall back. Over

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA08Chatter06Subtitle
values.text: *This is Echo one rolling into hot zone. Everyone keep your eyes open

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA08Chatter10Subtitle
values.text: *Car Bomb! Car Bomb!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA08Chatter12Subtitle
values.text: *Car bomb! Open fire!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA08Chatter14Subtitle
values.text: *Alright boyslet's go!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSA08Cin03Subtitle
values.text: *Looks like the whole GLA is lining up for us today

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:MisUSAChatter01Subtitle
values.text: *Get in formation, right now!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi001Subtitle
values.text: *So, I see you have decided to stay and stand against me. You will regret that decision, General. Prepare to meet your end!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi002Subtitle
values.text: *The tiger stands poised to strike, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi003Subtitle
values.text: *For China! Charge!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi004Subtitle
values.text: *My forces are ready to engage your defenses, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi005Subtitle
values.text: *Feel the stomping feet of my iron dragon!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi006Subtitle
values.text: *Your defenses are worthless against my forces

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi007Subtitle
values.text: *Now we meet in the field of honor, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi008Subtitle
values.text: *This we do for the good of China

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi009Subtitle
values.text: *It is time to test your steel, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi010Subtitle
values.text: *You have attacked me for the last time, General. This wave will break your defenses and crush your pitiful army to dust!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi011Subtitle
values.text: *The might of China falls upon you

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi012Subtitle
values.text: *Your inferior forces will provide no challenge for my warriors

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi013Subtitle
values.text: *You began this fight, General. No I will finish it

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi014Subtitle
values.text: *Attack the fool! Take no prisoners!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi015Subtitle
values.text: *Two warriors meet on the battlefield. Who is to say who will win? I do, that's who. Me. You will fall, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi016Subtitle
values.text: *A fight that cannot be won is not worth fighting. So why are you here, General?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi017Subtitle
values.text: *Rage will only get you so far, General. Now, rage and a column of tanks...that will get you somewhere

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi018Subtitle
values.text: *You find yourself at the end of your rope, General. And only now have you discovered that the end of that rope is on fire

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi019Subtitle
values.text: *The dance of battle is strange and briefand this battle with you has been strangely brief

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi020Subtitle
values.text: *I see you haven't thought your strategy through. Pity

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi021Subtitle
values.text: *That is a losing strategy, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi022Subtitle
values.text: *You are not acting for the good of you people, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi023Subtitle
values.text: *I will give you a moments pause to consider your next move

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi024Subtitle
values.text: *A wise man knows when to retreat. Obviously you are not such a man

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi025Subtitle
values.text: *In the end, all fall before me

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi026Subtitle
values.text: *You cannot stand against my might

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi027Subtitle
values.text: *China cannot be defeated by one man

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi028Subtitle
values.text: *We shall mediate and consider our next move

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi029Subtitle
values.text: *Do not commit to a tactic you cannot support

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi030Subtitle
values.text: *Suicide is not a tactic, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi031Subtitle
values.text: *We sweep away your buildings like bamboo before a hurricane

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi032Subtitle
values.text: *Your men ran from the Barracks as we knocked it to the ground

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi033Subtitle
values.text: *A factory cannot produce war, General--and now your War Factory produces nothing

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi034Subtitle
values.text: *Your Air Field has been grounded, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi035Subtitle
values.text: *Your base defenses fall before us like blades of grass

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi036Subtitle
values.text: *We've destroyed your Command Center, so where are you hiding now, General?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi037Subtitle
values.text: *So many of your buildings have fallen that I would have expected you to surrender by now

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi038Subtitle
values.text: *Don't think you can destroy my Barracks without feeling my wraith, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi039Subtitle
values.text: *I'll have to rebuild that War Factory now. You would be wise to exploit my momentary weaknessit won't last

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi040Subtitle
values.text: *Dozers: Rebuild the Air Field before our MiGs return!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi041Subtitle
values.text: *Our defenses are cracking! Repel the invaders!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi042Subtitle
values.text: *That is quite enough destruction, General. Now it is my turn

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi043Subtitle
values.text: *You can claim my Command Center, but this battle isn't over, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi044Subtitle
values.text: *We will avenge all those MiGs you've destroyed, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi045Subtitle
values.text: *The price of this war is too high, General. Now it is time for you to pay

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi046Subtitle
values.text: *China's infantry is plentiful, but too many have been sacrificed. Now I will return your cruelty ten-fold

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi047Subtitle
values.text: *Capture all the oil you wish--you will not have time to reap the rewards

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi048Subtitle
values.text: *That Artillery Platform can easily be avoided, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi049Subtitle
values.text: *Seeking to increase your efficiency with that Oil Refinery, General? A solid strategy would have served you better

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi050Subtitle
values.text: *Something stirs at the edge of my base

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi051Subtitle
values.text: *I see you approaching my base, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi052Subtitle
values.text: *You will not live to regret entering my base, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi053Subtitle
values.text: *You forces may enter my base, but they will never leave again

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi054Subtitle
values.text: *Those resources are under my protection, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi055Subtitle
values.text: *Why do you insist on attacking from the flanks?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi056Subtitle
values.text: *Interesting attack, General, but it will not succeed against me

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi057Subtitle
values.text: *A brave attack, General, but bravery alone will not defeat me

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi058Subtitle
values.text: *That is a fools tactic, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi059Subtitle
values.text: *Leave this place before you anger me

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi060Subtitle
values.text: *I can see what you are doing, General. I will not allow it

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi061Subtitle
values.text: *Run away from here, General, before I unleash the horde on you

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi062Subtitle
values.text: *We are approaching your base, General. What is your defense?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi063Subtitle
values.text: *Are you prepared for our attack, General? We shall see

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi064Subtitle
values.text: *Your defenses are inadequate, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi065Subtitle
values.text: *Now we will begin leveling your base, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi066Subtitle
values.text: *Your resources will soon be mine

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi067Subtitle
values.text: *I claim this Oil Derrick for China

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi068Subtitle
values.text: *Your flanks are exposed, General. Fatal mistake

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi069Subtitle
values.text: *You have allowed my forces to subvert your defenses. Now we will finish you

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi070Subtitle
values.text: *You have allowed your power to drop, General. Pray that isn't a fatal mistake

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi071Subtitle
values.text: *Without power you won't be able to defend your base, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi072Subtitle
values.text: *You have exhausted your resources, General. It is time to admit defeat

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi073Subtitle
values.text: *You have taxed my resources, General. Now I will come and take yours

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi074Subtitle
values.text: *The Scud Strom is a cowardly weapon, General. I thought more of you

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi075Subtitle
values.text: *You are forcing me to answer with a Nuclear Silo of my own, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi076Subtitle
values.text: *That Particle Cannon is a formidable weapon, but it cannot stop China

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi077Subtitle
values.text: *So many defensesI see you have proper respect for your enemy

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi078Subtitle
values.text: *You cannot build more tanks than China, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi079Subtitle
values.text: *We will match you planes in the air, General. Your superiority will be only in your mind

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi080Subtitle
values.text: *Your men are outnumbered, General. Do not try to make a greater horde than China

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi081Subtitle
values.text: *Your base grows large, Generalripe for a nuclear strike

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi082Subtitle
values.text: *Red Guard, scatter! Scud missiles inbound!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi083Subtitle
values.text: *We are immune to your nuclear missiles, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi084Subtitle
values.text: *No! Your particle beam will only injure us--we will not forget this, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi085Subtitle
values.text: *Hide in those buildings, General. Perhaps a Dragon Tank will come to visit you

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi086Subtitle
values.text: *Colonel Burton's exploits are legendary, but he is only one man, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi087Subtitle
values.text: *I see you have corrupted one of our Black Lotus agents. Her training will not turn the battle to your favor, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi088Subtitle
values.text: *The sniper Kell enters our battle. Do not count on his stealth to save you, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi089Subtitle
values.text: *You are foolish to build an Air Field, General. Only tanks can save you from me

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi090Subtitle
values.text: *You are wise to build a War Factory, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi091Subtitle
values.text: *That Barracks is only the beginning of what you will need to defeat me, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi092Subtitle
values.text: *If you are going to sell your buildings, why do you bother constructing them?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi093Subtitle
values.text: *You will not defeat me this easily, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi094Subtitle
values.text: *Your advantage will not hold

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi095Subtitle
values.text: *I will not be beaten by the likes of you, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi096Subtitle
values.text: *This is not the end, General. I will recover from this

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi097Subtitle
values.text: *I must acknowledge this defeat. You have shown superior tactics, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi098Subtitle
values.text: *My superior tactics are leading to your defeat, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi099Subtitle
values.text: *You are losing this battle, General. Better to accept defeat honorably than to fight on

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi100Subtitle
values.text: *The end is drawing near for you, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi101Subtitle
values.text: *Why do you resist the inevitable, General?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi102Subtitle
values.text: *The shadow of the dragon signals the beginning of your defeat, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi103Subtitle
values.text: *It is time to accept your defeat, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi104Subtitle
values.text: *It is time for the dragon to rise again

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi105Subtitle
values.text: *There is no shame in accepting your weakness

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi106Subtitle
values.text: *You are not ready to face me. Return when your training is complete

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi107Subtitle
values.text: *Why do you run towards your own demise?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi108Subtitle
values.text: *This has been an interesting contest. Perhaps you will challenge me again

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi109Subtitle
values.text: *Improve your skills and challenge me again

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi110Subtitle
values.text: *Welcome, General. I hope you are prepared to face me

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi111Subtitle
values.text: *Your victories speak well of your ability, but my generals did not have my cunning or experience

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossChi112Subtitle
values.text: *Soon you will see what it is to face the dragon

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA001Subtitle
values.text: *Most enemies would have flee from the sight of my armies. Perhaps this will be worthwhile after all

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA002Subtitle
values.text: *My forces descend on you like the wind, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA003Subtitle
values.text: *Your men are like sheep before my warriors

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA004Subtitle
values.text: *Look at all the wonderful toys you have brought to me. I broke all my toys as a child, General, and now I will break yours

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA005Subtitle
values.text: *Your forces fall like wheat before my sword

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA006Subtitle
values.text: *You have done well against my Generals, but I have all of their power combined. What will you do against that, General?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA007Subtitle
values.text: *You will never even see my forces, Generaluntil it is too late

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA008Subtitle
values.text: *We will sweep you from our lands, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA009Subtitle
values.text: *Now you will see what your useless invasion has brought you, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA010Subtitle
values.text: *You have dared to challenge me--now you will reap the terrible reward

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA011Subtitle
values.text: *How do you feel, General, as the horsemen ride to your doorstep?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA012Subtitle
values.text: *You've had your chance to retreat, now we will annihilate you

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA013Subtitle
values.text: *Bear witness to the power of my will, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA014Subtitle
values.text: *My rage will tear your war-machine to dust

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA015Subtitle
values.text: *ToxinexplosivesstealthAny one of these you have defeated, but all three? All is lost, General. You should surrenderfor the good of your men

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA016Subtitle
values.text: *Your world has made you soft, General. Mine has made me strong

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA017Subtitle
values.text: *You will learn to respect my power, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA018Subtitle
values.text: *You will pause while I build my next attack, then the battle will resume

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA019Subtitle
values.text: *Have you grown tired dying against my defenses, General?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA020Subtitle
values.text: *The battlefield is quiet, General. Are you waiting for me to finish this?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA021Subtitle
values.text: *We await your next pathetic attack with great anticipation

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA022Subtitle
values.text: *Has this been the extent of your power, General? Truly pathetic

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA023Subtitle
values.text: *Your attacks have been like pathetic screams amidst the howl of a raging storm

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA024Subtitle
values.text: *This battle is beginning to bore me, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA025Subtitle
values.text: *How much longer should I let you live, General?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA026Subtitle
values.text: *General, my subject require my attentionhow much longer do you intend to dance around like a clown?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA027Subtitle
values.text: *General, your tactics remind me of a child learning to play chess

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA028Subtitle
values.text: *Are you done, General? Have you exhausted your pathetic resources?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA029Subtitle
values.text: *General, I was bored minutes ago--now I'm beginning to fall asleep

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA030Subtitle
values.text: *How does it feel to challenge a true military genius?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA031Subtitle
values.text: *Anything you gain I will destroy

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA032Subtitle
values.text: *Now your Barracks falls--soon all shall fall

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA033Subtitle
values.text: *Your War Factory is lost--rebuild it and I'll destroy it again
