values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA034Subtitle
values.text: *I have relieved you of your Air Field, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA035Subtitle
values.text: *Your base defenses cannot stop my forces, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA036Subtitle
values.text: * General, if you cannot even hold on to your Command Center, how do you hope to defeat me?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA037Subtitle
values.text: *So many of your structures have fallen, General--why not retreat the field and spare yourself any further embarrassment?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA038Subtitle
values.text: *Do not test my patience further by destroying any more of my Oil Derricks, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA039Subtitle
values.text: *You dare to destroy my Barracks, General?!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA040Subtitle
values.text: *General, I require an Arms Dealer to do my business. Do not destroy another one

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA041Subtitle
values.text: *You think to crush my defenses, General? More will rise in their place

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA042Subtitle
values.text: *That is the last building you will destroy, General. My patience has limits

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA043Subtitle
values.text: *My Command Center! You have forced me to retreat underground, but this isn't over yet, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA044Subtitle
values.text: *You have destroyed many of my machine, General. Perhaps I underestimated you

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA045Subtitle
values.text: *My men are not targets for your practice, General. Their blood is on your hands

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA046Subtitle
values.text: *Release my Oil Derrick or I will burn it down

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA047Subtitle
values.text: *I see you've captured that derelict Artillery Platform. Best of luck making it work

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA048Subtitle
values.text: *That Oil Refinery will not turn the tide to your favor, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA049Subtitle
values.text: *Impudent fool! You have invaded into my home far enough

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA050Subtitle
values.text: *You are like a stinging insect, General, and it is time to squash your annoying presence

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA051Subtitle
values.text: *The enemy is in our presence! Destroy him! Destroy them all!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA052Subtitle
values.text: *Fool! You have crossed the line! Your forces are forfeit!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA053Subtitle
values.text: *Ah, a flanking attackcrude, but at least it is a strategy

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA054Subtitle
values.text: *Attempting to attack my back-door, General?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA055Subtitle
values.text: *A frontal attack? You should have brought more forces

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA056Subtitle
values.text: *I see you've found my extra suppliesand I stress, my extra supplies. Leave them now

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA057Subtitle
values.text: *Approaching my base from that path will only lead you to death

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA058Subtitle
values.text: *Stay out of that village, General. I protect those under my care

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA059Subtitle
values.text: *Those resources are for my people, General. They are not your for the taking

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA060Subtitle
values.text: *Those buildings were not placed here for your use, General. Do not disrupt my infrastructure

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA061Subtitle
values.text: *It seems you appetite has overstretched your resources, General. I hope you get your power back up before we reach your base

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA062Subtitle
values.text: *Our land is without powertoo bad your base cannot run without its dependence

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA063Subtitle
values.text: *Out of funds, General?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA064Subtitle
values.text: *General, you are taxing my resources. Your little war will cause my people to go hungry

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA065Subtitle
values.text: *A Scud Storm?! You have stolen our technology! You will pay for this, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA066Subtitle
values.text: *Building nuclear weapons, General? I figured you would resort to such cowardice

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA067Subtitle
values.text: *Particle Cannon? Your beams from space cannot reach us beneath the earth

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA068Subtitle
values.text: *So many base defenses. You must truly fear my power, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA069Subtitle
values.text: *How many tanks do you require, General?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA070Subtitle
values.text: *You fill the air with those annoying gnats. Now we will swat them down

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA071Subtitle
values.text: *Train all the men you wish, General, but the loss of life will only grow greater by the minute

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA072Subtitle
values.text: *Your base has grown large, Generalperhaps too large

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA073Subtitle
values.text: *Launch your toxins at us, General; we have prepared for much worse

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA074Subtitle
values.text: *Everyone, underground! Their nuclear missiles approach

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA075Subtitle
values.text: *Yes, use your particle beam--show the world your cowardice

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA076Subtitle
values.text: *Garrison the building, General--hide like rats in a wall

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA077Subtitle
values.text: *Colonel Burton will not save you, General. You'll have to fight this war yourself

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA078Subtitle
values.text: *Ah, the beautiful Black Lotus. Join me, Lotus, and you could like as a queen

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA079Subtitle
values.text: *Jarmen Kell? He dares to stand against me?! My vengeance will be mostunpleasant

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA080Subtitle
values.text: *Your Air Field will not stand against my assault, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA081Subtitle
values.text: *Finally built a War Factory, eh General? What took you so long?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA082Subtitle
values.text: *Your pathetic Barracks will be of no use to you, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA083Subtitle
values.text: *Selling off your buildings to fund your army? Hardly seems logical, does it, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA084Subtitle
values.text: *This is impossible! You cannot defeat me!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA085Subtitle
values.text: *You may think you have the upper-hand, but this battle will turn like the wind

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA086Subtitle
values.text: *Your soldiers may outnumber mine now, but battles are won by more than numbers, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA087Subtitle
values.text: *I can't believe that I'm being beaten by such a weak-minded fool. The shame will mark me forever

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA088Subtitle
values.text: *Defeated by a foolthe humiliation is too great to bearplease leave me to my torment

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA089Subtitle
values.text: *General, I smell the stench of fear and desperation coming from you base

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA090Subtitle
values.text: * I sense the time of your demise growing near, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA091Subtitle
values.text: *Your forces are beginning to be overrun, General. Soon they will be my prisoners

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA092Subtitle
values.text: *We are kicking you like a wounded goat, General. Admit defeat to spare your agony

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA093Subtitle
values.text: *You are defeated. This is what happens to all who stand against me , General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA094Subtitle
values.text: *You are a fool to challenge me, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA095Subtitle
values.text: *All the powers of the GLA are at my disposal

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA096Subtitle
values.text: *I am more dangerous than all my three Generals combined

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA097Subtitle
values.text: *You have won, General. Why do you continue to torture me by examining these statistics?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA098Subtitle
values.text: *Yes, you can now see why you have lostthe numbers speak for themselves

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA099Subtitle
values.text: *You have traveled far and faced many opponents to reach me General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA100Subtitle
values.text: *I commend your efforts, but they have wholly unprepared you for what you are about to face

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA101Subtitle
values.text: *You have faced Dr. Thrax's toxic warriors; Kassad's stealth legions and Juhziz's demolitions, but I taught them all in the art of war

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA102Subtitle
values.text: *This will be your final battle, General. May whatever gods you pray to have mercy on youbecause I will not

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA103Subtitle
values.text: *This will be your final battle, General. Make your peace and prepare for the end

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA001Subtitle
values.text: *Well, there you are. Too late to run now, Boy

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA002Subtitle
values.text: *I hope you're ready, cause we're coming for ya

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA003Subtitle
values.text: *Set the table, Kid, cause we're coming for dinner

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA004Subtitle
values.text: *I've got three things to teach you, Kid: How to lose; how to cry; and how to die

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA005Subtitle
values.text: *We're coming to attack soon, so get out all your white flags

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA006Subtitle
values.text: *Here we come, Kidtry not to wet yourself, okay?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA007Subtitle
values.text: *What part of "die" didn't you understand?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA008Subtitle
values.text: *Ooh, you're going to get it now, Kid

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA009Subtitle
values.text: *You ready? Cause here comes a tactic you may have learned in school. You ready to go back to school?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA010Subtitle
values.text: *It's time for me to teach you a thing or two about the back of my hand

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA011Subtitle
values.text: *You should have run when you had the chance. Now I'm going to teach you the meaning of respect

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA012Subtitle
values.text: *So, about your funeralopen casket or closed?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA013Subtitle
values.text: *I'm gonna march into your base and plant my foot in your butt, <sarcastic> "General."

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA014Subtitle
values.text: *Here we come, Punk--step aside or get stepped on

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA015Subtitle
values.text: *You call yourself a "General"? I call you a pain in the butt, is what I call you

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA016Subtitle
values.text: *This is your idea of strategy? Of tactics? "Tank blob" is the best you can come up with? Patheticjust pathetic

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA017Subtitle
values.text: *Yeah, I've read Sun Tzu too, Sport: "Greater enemy--retreat. Smaller enemy--attack." Is that all you got for me?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA018Subtitle
values.text: *So, where's your army, Boy? Or did you just want to bare-knuckle it? Cause I'll slap you down with my bare hands if you want. You want a piece of that, Boy?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA019Subtitle
values.text: *You got me out of bed for this? I aught to take you over my knee right now

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA020Subtitle
values.text: *I got more medals than you've got teeth, Boywhich won't be saying much after I get done knocking them out for you

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA021Subtitle
values.text: *Are you putting all of your defenses at the front of your base? You don't think we can go around that? Well, do you?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA022Subtitle
values.text: *Boy, you think I'm playing with you? You better think again

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA023Subtitle
values.text: *Better check your flanks there, Partner; I think some of my troops just snuck into your base

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA024Subtitle
values.text: *Do you think this is a game? Well do you? Wait, don't answer that

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA025Subtitle
values.text: *Kid, who taught you military tactics? Huh? Cause you should go slap him square in the mouth, I tell you

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA026Subtitle
values.text: *I have the whole United States military behind me, Son, and I've just decided that we don't like you

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA027Subtitle
values.text: *Is this tactic of yours supposed to be some kind of joke I'm not aware of?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA028Subtitle
values.text: *So, you're not a real general, are you? You're like the Surgeon General or something like that, right?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA029Subtitle
values.text: *Does your mommy know you're out by yourself?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA030Subtitle
values.text: *You can tell me.. We're just Generals here Do your men know you're incompetent?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA031Subtitle
values.text: *Did you know you just lost a Tech Building, Sport?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA032Subtitle
values.text: *Just blew-up your Barracks, Skippy. What you gonna do about it?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA033Subtitle
values.text: *There goes your War Factory. You mad yet, Boy?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA034Subtitle
values.text: *I don't know why you bothered to build that Air Field if you aren't going to protect it

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA035Subtitle
values.text: *Who put these base defenses down like this? They can't defend anything like that

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA036Subtitle
values.text: *I should let you build another Command Center just so I could knock it down again

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA037Subtitle
values.text: *I feel like I'm kicking over sand castles. How many of your buildings you gonna let me destroy there, Sport?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA038Subtitle
values.text: *I let you have that Tech Building, Boy. I don't need it to beat you

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA039Subtitle
values.text: *Kid, that Barracks was not a military target. Do that again and this will get ugly

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA040Subtitle
values.text: *You better stand down, Son--I'm not going to stand for you blowing-up my War Factories, you hear?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA041Subtitle
values.text: *Do you know how much those jets cost? I coulda fed the whole world with what you just destroyed

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA042Subtitle
values.text: *Cracking my defenses, huh? Well, go on--it should be me just enough time to overrun your base

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA043Subtitle
values.text: *That's enough buildings, Son. Why don't you try attacking my forces now

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA044Subtitle
values.text: *My Command Center?! You think I'm just going to sit here and take that?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA045Subtitle
values.text: *You had best leave my pilots alone, Boy. Planes are one thing, but you let my pilots return safe, you hear?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA046Subtitle
values.text: *You're a sneaky little 'cuss, aren't you? But I think that's enough of my vehicles destroyed, don't you?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA047Subtitle
values.text: *Let's get armor and air support out there--our grunts are getting torn apart!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA048Subtitle
values.text: *Let that Oil Derrick go, Boy. This war ain't about the price of gas you know

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA049Subtitle
values.text: *Think you know how to use that Artillery Platform, Son?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA050Subtitle
values.text: *That Oil Refinery is not a viable target, Son. And it don't belong to you, so we're coming to get it back

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA051Subtitle
values.text: *Well, you managed to get to my side of the map. Didn't think you had it in ya

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA052Subtitle
values.text: *You planning to attack, or you just going to stand out there all day?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA053Subtitle
values.text: *You'll get out of my base if you know what's good for you, Boy

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA054Subtitle
values.text: *Enemy's in our perimeter--all forces repel the invaders

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA055Subtitle
values.text: *Those ain't your supplies, Sport. Best to step-off now, before you get hurt

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA056Subtitle
values.text: *A flanking attack?! Don't make me laugh, Boy

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA057Subtitle
values.text: *Trying to attack from my back-door? Good luck with that

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA058Subtitle
values.text: *You coming to attack me, Boy? Nice to see you have some guts

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA059Subtitle
values.text: *Get away from my Tech buildings, if you know what's good for you

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA060Subtitle
values.text: *My forces have your base in sight, Kid. What you gonna do now?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA061Subtitle
values.text: *Here comes the hammer, Punk, and you don't want to be the nail

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA062Subtitle
values.text: *Knock-knock, we're coming in!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA063Subtitle
values.text: *Things are about to get real bad for you, Sport. Don't say I didn't warn you

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA064Subtitle
values.text: *So, here's where you're hiding your resources. Mind if I take a few?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA065Subtitle
values.text: *You're flank's wide open, Sport

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA066Subtitle
values.text: *Maybe we'll come in your back-door. Whadda you think about that?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA067Subtitle
values.text: *Look out, we're coming through the front-door!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA068Subtitle
values.text: *What do we have here?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA069Subtitle
values.text: *Well, look at this

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA070Subtitle
values.text: *What did you plan to do without power? I can't wait to see this strategy

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA071Subtitle
values.text: *You better pay you power bill or we're going to have to postpone this fight

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA072Subtitle
values.text: *You're out of resources? Boy, you don't start the dance if you can't pay the bill

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA073Subtitle
values.text: *Uh-oh, looks like we're going to have to do some deficit spending

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA074Subtitle
values.text: *Built yourself a Scud Storm there? You can't hit the side of a barn with a scud, don't you know that?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA075Subtitle
values.text: *Bringing out your nukes, huh? If Washington hadn't tied my hands, I'd show you some nukes, I tell you

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA076Subtitle
values.text: *How'd you get a Particle Cannon, Son? That's supposed to me top-secret

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA077Subtitle
values.text: *So many base defenses. I can just smell the fear coming off you, Boy

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA078Subtitle
values.text: *Oh, look at thishere comes the tank blob. Not gonna work against me, Son

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA079Subtitle
values.text: *That's a lot of expensive planes you're putting in the air, Kid. Sure you wanna spend that money?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA080Subtitle
values.text: *Hope all those grunts know what you're getting them into

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA081Subtitle
values.text: *That's a lot of buildings, Son. You know that buildings can't fight for you, right?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA082Subtitle
values.text: *Bring the scuds, Punk--I'll show you the storm

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA083Subtitle
values.text: *You're going to regret nuking me, Kid. I don't take kindly to that

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA084Subtitle
values.text: *Using a particle beam, eh? You better put me away with that cause you won't like my counter-attack

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA085Subtitle
values.text: *You know, only a coward fights from inside buildings. You know that, right?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA086Subtitle
values.text: *Welcome, Colonel Burton. Sorry you had to get tied up in this thing. No hard feelings

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA087Subtitle
values.text: *Black Lotus ain't your salvation, Boy. She ain't gonna get anywhere near my base

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA088Subtitle
values.text: *Jarmen Kell's just another sniper, Punk. I've got dozens of snipers

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA089Subtitle
values.text: *Yeah, build your Air Field--get some birds in the air. May be your only shot a stopping me

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA090Subtitle
values.text: *Only one War Factory? It's gonna take at least half-a-dozen to stop me, Kid

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA091Subtitle
values.text: *Is that Barracks a little close to the front-lines, Kid? Hard to sleep with bullets in your barracks

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA092Subtitle
values.text: *Don't just sell one building, Boy--sell them all and hope that I don't come for you anyway

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA093Subtitle
values.text: *Don't get cocky, Boy--this ain't over yet

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA094Subtitle
values.text: *You may think you have the upper-hand, but I've got a few tricks left in me. You'll see

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA095Subtitle
values.text: *I've dug myself outta worse holes than this, Punk. You ain't gonna win that easily

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA096Subtitle
values.text: *You think you're beating me? You best think again

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA097Subtitle
values.text: *HuhI guess it's over. Nice work, Kid. I guess you took me down a peg or two

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA098Subtitle
values.text: *Can you feel my fist starting to close around your neck, Punk?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA099Subtitle
values.text: *Don't take losing to me so hard--everyone loses to me, Kid

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA100Subtitle
values.text: *Give me a sec to get some tanks together and I'll end this little skirmish

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA101Subtitle
values.text: *Why don't you just give up now, <sarcastic> "General."

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA102Subtitle
values.text: *Boy, I beat you like an old drum. Who gave you a command? Cause I've got some word for them

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA103Subtitle
values.text: *Don't click that button unless you're serious, Boy

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA104Subtitle
values.text: *You wanna tangle with me? I think you better think again, Kid

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA105Subtitle
values.text: *Don't bring that attitude in here unless you can back it up, Punk

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA106Subtitle
values.text: *Show me what you got

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA107Subtitle
values.text: *Maybe you could make a few extra bucks polishing my boots, cause you sure ain't no general

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA108Subtitle
values.text: *Good work, General. I salute you

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA109Subtitle
values.text: *I ain't gonna give no speeches, so let's just get this on

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo001Subtitle
values.text: *I have some surprises for you, General. Why don't you come out and play?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo002Subtitle
values.text: *Now that the field is covered with explosives, I suppose we'll attack

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo003Subtitle
values.text: *General, I have a delivery for yousign for it, won't you?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo004Subtitle
values.text: *Careful, who knows when Jarmen Kell will sneak into your base

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo005Subtitle
values.text: *Did your building just blow up? HmmI wonder how that happened?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo006Subtitle
values.text: *All of my forces are packed with explosives, General. I wouldn't shoot at them if I were you

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo007Subtitle
values.text: *My Terrorists have learned to disguise themselves asoops, have I said too much?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo008Subtitle
values.text: *You might notice that my explosives pack a bit more punchI hope you appreciate our attention to quality

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo009Subtitle
values.text: *Look how quickly the Scud Launcher destroys a building nowjust wait, it's amazing

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo010Subtitle
values.text: *First, all is silencethen "boom!"ahhdon't you just love it, General?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo011Subtitle
values.text: *I rarely attack, you should feel honored

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo012Subtitle
values.text: *Here comes another attack, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo013Subtitle
values.text: *My troops are coming to assault your basemake them feel welcome

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo014Subtitle
values.text: *Please ignore my workers, General; they're just burying someummgarbage for me

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo015Subtitle
values.text: *Oh, General, you must see thisit's the bomb. <childish laugh>

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo016Subtitle
values.text: *We're going out for more explosives, General. Be right back

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo017Subtitle
values.text: *It's quiet out there, General. You know what quiet means, right? BOOM!!!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo018Subtitle
values.text: *I am the master of explosives, General. You have no defense against me

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo019Subtitle
values.text: *Your base has been targeted for demolition

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo020Subtitle
values.text: *Do you fear my next attack, General? You should

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo021Subtitle
values.text: *As we speak my agents are sneaking into your base and planting explosives

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo022Subtitle
values.text: *Your building could be wired to explode right now. You'll never know until it's too late

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo023Subtitle
values.text: *There are few units that can detect my demolitionsdo you know which ones they are?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo024Subtitle
values.text: *Demo Traps are difficult to construct, General. To appreciate their beauty you have to see one up close

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo025Subtitle
values.text: *How are you enjoying my tricks and traps so far?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo026Subtitle
values.text: *Awwyour Tech Building went boom

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo027Subtitle
values.text: *We've destroyed your BarracksI hope no one was in there

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo028Subtitle
values.text: *Your War Factory has fallen, General. Build another one so we can knock it down again

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo029Subtitle
values.text: *Air Fields are so fragile--it's hardly even fun to destroy them

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo030Subtitle
values.text: *Your base defenses cannot take my explosives, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo031Subtitle
values.text: *Ah, there's nothing quite like destroying a Command Center

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo032Subtitle
values.text: *We've destroyed so many of your buildings, GeneralI appreciate you building more for our ammusement

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo033Subtitle
values.text: *You've destroyed our Oil Derrick. Now you're getting into the spirit of things

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo034Subtitle
values.text: *My Barracks! Many of my demolitions were in there, General. I'll make you pay for this

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo035Subtitle
values.text: *Not my War Factory! General, this annoy habit you've developed cannot continue

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo036Subtitle
values.text: *Not to worry, my base defenses are only an early-warning signal. Now you must walk through my true defenses

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo037Subtitle
values.text: *Too many! You've destroy too many of my structures, General. Now the fighting gets dirty

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo038Subtitle
values.text: *We will rebuild that Command Center, General, and you will play for this transgression

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo039Subtitle
values.text: *General, how do you expect me to defeat you if you keep destroying my vehicles?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo040Subtitle
values.text: *You're cutting my men down before they can place their demolitionsthat doesn't seem right, does it, General?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo041Subtitle
values.text: *Ah yes, capture that Oil Derrick, General. Then we'll have more to destroy

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo042Subtitle
values.text: *General, why do you want that Artillery Platform?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo043Subtitle
values.text: *Good, General, capture the Oil Refinerythey blow-up so dramatically

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo044Subtitle
values.text: *Be careful, General--your men have just enter the danger zone around my base. Even I don't remember where all the traps are set out there

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo045Subtitle
values.text: *General, your men are coming dangerously close to my base. I'd turn back if I were you

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo046Subtitle
values.text: *Get out of my base, General. This whole area is wired with explosives, and I'm not afraid to use them

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo047Subtitle
values.text: *You fool! Do you know how many explosives are surrounding your men right now?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo048Subtitle
values.text: *Attacking from the flank, General? There might be few defenses there, but what about traps?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo049Subtitle
values.text: *The back of my base is particularly nasty, General. I wouldn't recommend an assault from there

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo050Subtitle
values.text: *A frontal assault?! You are more of a fool than I thought, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo051Subtitle
values.text: *There is nothing in this valley for you except death

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo052Subtitle
values.text: *Careful, General; this looks like a good place for an ambushoops, too late

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo053Subtitle
values.text: *You think I didn't prepare for you coming here, General? Fool

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo054Subtitle
values.text: *Those are my resources, General. Go find your own

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo055Subtitle
values.text: *General, you've entered my demolitions storage facility. One false move and we all die

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo056Subtitle
values.text: *Ah, I see we hit one of your power lines. I hope your power isn't out for too long

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo057Subtitle
values.text: *Your dependency on electricity will be you undoing, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo058Subtitle
values.text: *Your resources are exhausted, General. My forces are circling for the kill

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo059Subtitle
values.text: *My resources are low, General. Mind if we come take some of yours?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo060Subtitle
values.text: *A Scud StormI seeWell, perhaps it is time to build one of my own

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo061Subtitle
values.text: *I wonder how many explosives it will take to destroy that Nuclear Silo?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo062Subtitle
values.text: *Now why do you want to build a Particle Cannon? We were just beginning to have fun, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo063Subtitle
values.text: *So many base defenses, General. How do you expect my bombers to enter your base now?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo064Subtitle
values.text: *Tanksso many tanks. I'll enjoy watching your tanks hit my traps, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo065Subtitle
values.text: *Stop building planes, Generalyou'll miss the genius of my traps

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo066Subtitle
values.text: *With that many infantry you're sure to set-off my Demo Traps. I'd tell them to spread out when crossing the field, Generalor not

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo067Subtitle
values.text: *So many buildings Your base is a perfect target for my explosives, General. Thank you

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo068Subtitle
values.text: *Foolish move, General. Your Scud Storm won't stop me

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo069Subtitle
values.text: *Nuclear missile! You will pay for this, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo070Subtitle
values.text: *No! That particle beam will set off my explosives!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo071Subtitle
values.text: *Yes, garrison that building, General--it probably doesn't have explosives attached to it

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo072Subtitle
values.text: *Hello, Colonel Burton. Try not to step on any traps

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo073Subtitle
values.text: *Black Lotusjust because you can detect my traps do not think I am now vulnerable

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo074Subtitle
values.text: *Why would you send Jarmen Kell against me, General?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo075Subtitle
values.text: *Do not build any more Air Fields, GeneralI don't like them

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo076Subtitle
values.text: *The War Factory builds vehiclesvehicles that will set-off my Demo Traps

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo077Subtitle
values.text: *Do you think it is wise to build a Barracks, General?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo078Subtitle
values.text: *Please, General, don't sell-off what I could destroy for you

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo079Subtitle
values.text: *General, you're not playing fair. Now go step on some traps

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo080Subtitle
values.text: *You're exceptionally lucky, General, but you can't avoid my Demo Traps forever

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo081Subtitle
values.text: *No one has beaten my traps, General, and you won't be the firstyou'll see

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo082Subtitle
values.text: *Do you think you're beating me, General? This could change in an instant--I don't fight fair

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo083Subtitle
values.text: *You may have defeated me, General, but Deathstrike will avenge me

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo084Subtitle
values.text: *Ha ha! Your troops are falling to my traps, General. Soon they'll all be gone

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo085Subtitle
values.text: *You're losing, General. My tactics elude you

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo086Subtitle
values.text: *You'll never defeat me, General. You should leave before you get hurt

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo087Subtitle
values.text: *I have so many explosives leftmore explosives than you have forces I'm afraid

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo088Subtitle
values.text: *You lose, General. Too bad

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo089Subtitle
values.text: *I have just the thing. Let's go make war

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo090Subtitle
values.text: *Demolitions expert: How can I help you?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo091Subtitle
values.text: *I wonder if I could wire that button to explode?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo092Subtitle
values.text: *Please, General--enter my battlefieldbut watch where to step

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo093Subtitle
values.text: *You were lucky this time, General. You could never beat me again

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo094Subtitle
values.text: *You were not prepared for this kind of war. Try again, if you dare

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo095Subtitle
values.text: *Here we see the battlefield--openuntouched by battlea blank slate for our little...

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo096Subtitle
values.text: *Now where did those Demo Traps come from?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo097Subtitle
values.text: *Perhaps I have a few cards hidden up my sleeve, but did you except any less from me, General?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger001Subtitle
values.text: *Hey, General, you ever seen a Raptor up close?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger002Subtitle
values.text: *Hey, General, did you see that Stealth Fighter?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger003Subtitle
values.text: *Birds' away! Let's go hunt some dozers!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger004Subtitle
values.text: *I'm done playing with you, General. (Announcing to his own forces) Everyone attack!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger005Subtitle
values.text: *Will you look at thatUS military spending at its best

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger006Subtitle
values.text: *(Singingbadly)and the rockets' red glare, the bombs bursting in air

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger007Subtitle
values.text: *Here comes the rain of terror, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger008Subtitle
values.text: *How are you enjoying the Shock-and-Awe, General?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger009Subtitle
values.text: *Death from above!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger010Subtitle
values.text: *It doesn't seem fair, does it, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger011Subtitle
values.text: *It's time to pull the goalies. Everyone attack!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger012Subtitle
values.text: *Bombs away!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger013Subtitle
values.text: *It's awfully quiet out thereyou didn't leave did you, General?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger014Subtitle
values.text: *Don't worry, General, this is just the quiet before the storm

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger015Subtitle
values.text: *I'd take this break to rebuild your defenses, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger016Subtitle
values.text: *Shhdid you hear that? I wouldn't worry, it's probably nothing

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger017Subtitle
values.text: *Sorry, General, we're just taking a lunch-break-be with you in a minute

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger018Subtitle
values.text: *You've forced me to use tanksI hate using tanks

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger019Subtitle
values.text: *Having trouble crossing the river, General? Wanna lift?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger020Subtitle
values.text: *Cowards! Stop hiding and fight!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger021Subtitle
values.text: *Stealth won't save you, General; we'll find you

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger022Subtitle
values.text: *Ouch, that must have been expensive

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger023Subtitle
values.text: *Huh, where are you going to train your troops now?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger024Subtitle
values.text: *Having trouble keeping up those defenses, General?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger025Subtitle
values.text: *You've lost a lot of buildings, General; were you planning on using harsh language now?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger026Subtitle
values.text: *Dozers, start repairing our buildings!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger027Subtitle
values.text: *I'll get you for this, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger028Subtitle
values.text: *You'll regret destroying that airfield, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger029Subtitle
values.text: *Dozers, rebuild our defenses!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger030Subtitle
values.text: *This is General Granger to Aircraft Carrier Olympia: Send reinforcementsrepeat: send reinforcements

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger031Subtitle
values.text: *They're attacking the Command Center! All forces, regroup!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger032Subtitle
values.text: *I don't appreciate you shooting down my planes, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger033Subtitle
values.text: *They're taking over our Oil Derricks! Rangers, get out there and take them back!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger034Subtitle
values.text: *Get out of our base!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger035Subtitle
values.text: *Get out of my airspace, General!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger036Subtitle
values.text: *The enemy's in our perimeter! All planes return to base!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger037Subtitle
values.text: *Ground forces, defend the airfields!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger038Subtitle
values.text: *You're not stealing my supplies, are you, General?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger039Subtitle
values.text: *They're coming in the back-door!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger040Subtitle
values.text: *Hiding in the village, huh. That's a coward's tactic, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger041Subtitle
values.text: *Stop hiding, General. Don't make me come and get you

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger042Subtitle
values.text: *They're at the East gate!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger043Subtitle
values.text: *Defend the East side!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger044Subtitle
values.text: *Enemy forces approaching the West gate!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger045Subtitle
values.text: *All forces to the West gate!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger046Subtitle
values.text: *Having trouble keeping your power up, General?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger047Subtitle
values.text: *Oops, your power's down - here come the bombs!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger048Subtitle
values.text: *Out of resources, General? Want to borrow some?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger049Subtitle
values.text: *Hey, General, how 'bout we call this one a draw?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger050Subtitle
values.text: *You may have won the battle, General, but the war is far from over

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger051Subtitle
values.text: *So, you built a Scud Storm. Think you can defend it?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger052Subtitle
values.text: *Hmm, that's a lot of anti-air, General Think it will be enough to calm the fear?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger053Subtitle
values.text: *Your tanks are no match for my planes, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger054Subtitle
values.text: *Anthrax! Everyone find cover!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger055Subtitle
values.text: *Garrison all the buildings you want, General-it won't help

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger056Subtitle
values.text: *How much more of this can you take, General?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger057Subtitle
values.text: *Ready to surrender yet?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger058Subtitle
values.text: *Haven't you lost enough troops, General?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger059Subtitle
values.text: *This battle is over, General-surrender or prepare to die!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger060Subtitle
values.text: *Not going to surrender, huh? Too bad

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger061Subtitle
values.text: *Bombs away, punk

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger062Subtitle
values.text: *Come on, General--I'll show you the meaning of "Death from Above."

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger063Subtitle
values.text: *Sonic-boom, baby. Let's do this thing

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger064Subtitle
values.text: *I guess it's time for me to go find a good airline job

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger065Subtitle
values.text: *I win--you lose. What more is there to say?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger066Subtitle
values.text: *Be advised: This area is under the control of Air Force General Malcolm Granger. Withdraw now or prepare to be bombed back to the stone-age

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger067Subtitle
values.text: *General, you're no match for me--I own the skies!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger068Subtitle
values.text: *Watch the skies, General; we're going to put on an air-show

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger069Subtitle
values.text: *Wanna see it again?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger070Subtitle
values.text: *Ready-or-not, here I come!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger071Subtitle
values.text: *You don't mind if we drop-in, do ya General?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger072Subtitle
values.text: *That's two of my airfields you've hit, General. I'm starting to get annoyed

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger073Subtitle
values.text: *Curse you, General. If you hit another airfield I'll come for you personally

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger074Subtitle
values.text: *That's the last airfield you destroy today. (Announcing to his own troops) Forces, target their Command Center

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger075Subtitle
values.text: *I can't believe you beat me, General. I salute your superior tactics

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger076Subtitle
values.text: *It looks like you defeated me this time, General, but we'll meet again someday and I won't be so merciful because-

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger077Subtitle
values.text: *I thought he'd never shut up

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger078Subtitle
values.text: *You don't think I'm going to let you keep that Scud Storm, do you?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger079Subtitle
values.text: *Another Scud Storm? I guess it's time to take the up a notch

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger080Subtitle
values.text: *Pilots, watch-out for those Stinger Sites

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger081Subtitle
values.text: *So many Rangers-so few buildings to capture

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger082Subtitle
values.text: *General, do ya know how a Fuel-Air Bomb works? How 'bout a demonstration?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger083Subtitle
values.text: *Welcome to the party, Colonel Burton. You're in for it now, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger084Subtitle
values.text: *Do you know how to stop an A-10, General? Me neither

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger085Subtitle
values.text: *Hey, wanna see our new Bunker Buster?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger086Subtitle
values.text: *Artillery! You think you can attack me with artillery?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger087Subtitle
values.text: *You know that Scud Launcher is never going to make it to my base, right?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger088Subtitle
values.text: *Wait, that's a Bomb Truck! Everyone look out!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger089Subtitle
values.text: *You've forced me to use tanksI hate using tanks

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger090Subtitle
values.text: *Having trouble crossing the river, General? Wanna lift?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger091Subtitle
values.text: *Cowards! Stop hiding and fight!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger092Subtitle
values.text: *Stealth won't save you, General; we'll find you

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger093Subtitle
values.text: *Hmm, that's a lot of anti-air, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry001Subtitle
values.text: *So, this is where you're hiding, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry002Subtitle
values.text: *<sarcastic>Feeling overwhelmed General?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry003Subtitle
values.text: *(Chinese infantry troops die) <angry voice> 1 billion more where that came from

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry004Subtitle
values.text: *(Paradrop)Like a swarm of locusts they descend from the sky to devour all those who stand against China

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry005Subtitle
values.text: *Ever been hacked General?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry006Subtitle
values.text: *<shouting>March!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry007Subtitle
values.text: *They make good shields too

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry008Subtitle
values.text: *Here's a tip General, Surrender!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry009Subtitle
values.text: *Don't worry General, we don't take prisoners

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry010Subtitle
values.text: *Unleash Horde!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry011Subtitle
values.text: *It's ok General, we've brought our own flag for your base

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry012Subtitle
values.text: *Soon all your men will see are boots marching over them

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry013Subtitle
values.text: *Charge!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry014Subtitle
values.text: *Death to all who oppose us!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry015Subtitle
values.text: *Do you know how hard it is to feed a horde, General?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry016Subtitle
values.text: *I have enough men to hold a parade. Can we have it in your base?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry017Subtitle
values.text: *Are you still here, General?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry018Subtitle
values.text: *Are you just going to sit there and wait to be overrun?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry019Subtitle
values.text: *Are your resources getting low, General?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry020Subtitle
values.text: *How long does it take for you to build your little tank force?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry021Subtitle
values.text: *<sarcastic> What tactic will you amaze me with now, General?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry022Subtitle
values.text: *This can't be the best you can do, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry023Subtitle
values.text: *So far I'm not impressed, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry024Subtitle
values.text: *You were not prepared for this challenge, were you, General?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry025Subtitle
values.text: *I have enough men to crush you without firing a shot

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry026Subtitle
values.text: *We are coming for you, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry027Subtitle
values.text: *Awwwe've knocked over your little Tech Building. Boo-hoo

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry028Subtitle
values.text: *Now your Barracks is gone. How will you fight without men?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry029Subtitle
values.text: *Without a War Factory you'll have to fight me man-to-man, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry030Subtitle
values.text: *No more planes for you. Get on the ground and fight like a man

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry031Subtitle
values.text: *My men are marching right through you base defenses, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry032Subtitle
values.text: *There is only empty ground where your Command Center once stood, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry033Subtitle
values.text: *I have lost many men, General, but the cost to your buildings has been worth it

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry034Subtitle
values.text: *Leave my Tech Buildings alone, General!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry035Subtitle
values.text: *NO! Not my Barracks! We will build another, Generalthen you will pay

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry036Subtitle
values.text: *My War Factory is not essential to my victory, but do not destroy another

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry037Subtitle
values.text: *You have destroyed my Air Field! This is getting annoying, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry038Subtitle
values.text: *Destroy all the base defenses you want--they're only there to slow you down anyway

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry039Subtitle
values.text: *You have cost me many buildings, General. My men are coming to collect repayment

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry040Subtitle
values.text: *Nooo! They destroyed my Command Center! Go get them! Keep them away from me!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry041Subtitle
values.text: *Swat all the planes you like, General--we'll make more

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry042Subtitle
values.text: *My vehicles are not for your target practice, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry043Subtitle
values.text: *There are many more in my army ready to sacrifice for China, General. You won't stop us

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry044Subtitle
values.text: *I see you've captured my Oil Derrick, General. We are coming to take back China's oil now

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry045Subtitle
values.text: *That old Artillery Platform is destroyed, General; you'll never get it to work

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry046Subtitle
values.text: *Do you think that Oil Refinery is just there for anyone to use? Return the refinery to me now

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry047Subtitle
values.text: *Get any closer to my base and I'll set the horde out on you

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry048Subtitle
values.text: *I warn you, General, get away from my base. Do you know what a hundred men can do to a tank?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry049Subtitle
values.text: *They're in our base! Kill them! Get them out of here!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry050Subtitle
values.text: *They're getting too close! Protect me!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry051Subtitle
values.text: *General, get away from my resources--my men need those

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry052Subtitle
values.text: *General, do not try to flank my base

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry053Subtitle
values.text: *A back-door attack will not help you, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry054Subtitle
values.text: *Attacking the front of my base is foolish, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry055Subtitle
values.text: *Those are my Tech Buildings, General. Stay away

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry056Subtitle
values.text: *Get out of my buildings, General!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry057Subtitle
values.text: *Crossing that bridge is a mistake, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry058Subtitle
values.text: *You've run out of power, General--your defenses are down and my men will invade soon

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry059Subtitle
values.text: *Without power you'll never stop my horde, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry060Subtitle
values.text: *You've wasted all your resources fighting my menbut I still have more men

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry061Subtitle
values.text: *We are out of resources! How did this happen?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry062Subtitle
values.text: *Build your Scud Storm--it will only hit a few of my menthe rest will destroy you

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry063Subtitle
values.text: *I thought nuclear missile were not allowed! This is hardly fair, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry064Subtitle
values.text: *That Particle Cannon is useless against my horde!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry065Subtitle
values.text: *Yes, you should build more base defenses--at least then you can stop the first wave of the charging horde

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry066Subtitle
values.text: *Coward! You know that your tanks cannot crush my men, don't you?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry067Subtitle
values.text: *So many planesno matter, my horde and bring down your planes too

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry068Subtitle
values.text: *You're mobilizing a horde of your own?! You will need many more men to match my strength, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry069Subtitle
values.text: *You base has grown too large, General. It is time for my men to drop in and capture a few for China

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry070Subtitle
values.text: *Scud Storm! Scatter!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry071Subtitle
values.text: *Nuclear missile approaching! Flee! Get me out of here!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry072Subtitle
values.text: *Ooh, look at the pretty light show. What do you hope to accomplish with that petty weapon, General?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry073Subtitle
values.text: *Get out of that building, General. We have ways of bringing you out by force if necessary

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry074Subtitle
values.text: *You've brought Colonel Burton to our little war, General. Even he will fall when faced with the horde

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry075Subtitle
values.text: *Black Lotus? How will she help you survive my horde, General?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry076Subtitle
values.text: *All forces beware: Jarmen Kell is hiding in the field

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry077Subtitle
values.text: *I see that Air Field, General. Run to the air! Fear my horde!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry078Subtitle
values.text: *My men will tear your tanks apart as fast as you can make them, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry079Subtitle
values.text: *My men are trained in groups of threehow fast can you train your men?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry080Subtitle
values.text: *Selling your buildings? Foolish! What will you buy with the money to stop my horde?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry081Subtitle
values.text: *I have so many forces, how can you be winning this battle?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry082Subtitle
values.text: *I have underestimated your tactics, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry083Subtitle
values.text: *You've caught me off guard, General, but now I am ready for you

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry084Subtitle
values.text: *You will not defeat my horde, General! Your current advantage will soon be lost

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry085Subtitle
values.text: *I do not accept this defeat, General. My men will cover my escape and we will fight another day

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry086Subtitle
values.text: *My men outnumber you now, General. I would be wise to surrender

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry087Subtitle
values.text: *This looks like the end for you, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry088Subtitle
values.text: *If you do not retreat now I will unleash the horde to scrape you from our land

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry089Subtitle
values.text: *Do you feel the end drawing near, General?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry090Subtitle
values.text: *Haha! I have defeated you. Now you must choose to join my horde or die

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry091Subtitle
values.text: *It is time to unleash the horde!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry092Subtitle
values.text: *Face me and fall like the rest

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry093Subtitle
values.text: *My men will crush you

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry094Subtitle
values.text: *We will tear through you like locusts

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry095Subtitle
values.text: *Men? Where are my men? You wouldn't consider letting me go would you? Please don't hurt me

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry096Subtitle
values.text: *We have nice uniforms in the hordeit won't be so badyou might even like it. But I doubt it

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry097Subtitle
values.text: *Are you ready to face my horde, General?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry098Subtitle
values.text: *And think, this is just the first wave

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser001Subtitle
values.text: *I have you in my sights now, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser002Subtitle
values.text: *Precision attack commencing

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser003Subtitle
values.text: * (player units destroyed) Interesting choice of tactics, they didn't help my last opponent either

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser004Subtitle
values.text: *I'm about to attack, I thought you could use the warning

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser005Subtitle
values.text: *Maybe you should re-evaluate your strategies, they obviously don't work

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser006Subtitle
values.text: *How do you like my new toys General?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser007Subtitle
values.text: *Prepare yourself General, you're about to be taught a lesson in war

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser008Subtitle
values.text: *Easy come, easy go

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser009Subtitle
values.text: *Maybe you're not cut out for this, try painting

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser010Subtitle
values.text: *Beautiful aren't they General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser011Subtitle
values.text: *My lasers will cut through your defenses like a hot knife through butter

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser012Subtitle
values.text: *Checkmate

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser013Subtitle
values.text: *It's a whole new age of warfare, General, and it's coming to your doorstep

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser014Subtitle
values.text: *Target is painted--all forces begin attack run

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser015Subtitle
values.text: *Originally all my weapons also had laser targeting, but my enemies got confused

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser016Subtitle
values.text: *Don't look directly at the laser--you could burn-out the back of your head

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser017Subtitle
values.text: *Charging lasersplease wait, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser018Subtitle
values.text: *Lasers must be calibrated precisely for maximum effect

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser019Subtitle
values.text: *Dozers, build more Reactors--lasers take a lot of power

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser020Subtitle
values.text: *Can you match fifty million mega-joules of lasing power, General?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser021Subtitle
values.text: *Looks like a big space battle, doesn't it

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser022Subtitle
values.text: *My lasers are going to turn your armor to vapor

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser023Subtitle
values.text: *General, you should really try to coordinate your attacks--this has been all to easy for me

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser024Subtitle
values.text: *Don't get distracted by the pretty lights, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser025Subtitle
values.text: *Would you like me to "beam you up," General?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser026Subtitle
values.text: *Your weapons can't match my pinpoint accuracy, General. Why not just surrender?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser027Subtitle
values.text: *Why don't you build another Barracks, General? I'll enjoy destroying that one too

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser028Subtitle
values.text: *If you can't protect your War Factory, how safe could your Command Center be?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser029Subtitle
values.text: *Your planes are not safe from my lasers, especially without your Air Field

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser030Subtitle
values.text: *Your base defenses are worthless against me

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser031Subtitle
values.text: *Ah, the Command Center--queen of this chessboard. This match is all but over now, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser032Subtitle
values.text: *My lasers have destroyed so many of your buildingshow do you keep fighting?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser033Subtitle
values.text: *General, don't destroy my Tech Buildings, I need those

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser034Subtitle
values.text: *Get away from my Barracks!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser035Subtitle
values.text: *My War Factory! Noooo!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser036Subtitle
values.text: *How dare you destroy my Air Field!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser037Subtitle
values.text: *They're destroying our defenses! All forces: defend the base!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser038Subtitle
values.text: *General, these losses are unacceptable. I'll repay you for destroying my buildings

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser039Subtitle
values.text: *No! Quickly, Dozers rebuild the Command Center!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser040Subtitle
values.text: *General, if you bring down any more of my planes I'll use all my Super Weapons to destroy you!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser041Subtitle
values.text: *Leave my vehicles alone, General!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser042Subtitle
values.text: *You're hunting my men on purpose, aren't you, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser043Subtitle
values.text: *Reap the rewards from that Oil Derrick while you can; we'll be there to take it soon

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser044Subtitle
values.text: *That Artillery Platform is no match for my airborne lasers

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser045Subtitle
values.text: *Did you know that that Oil Refinery will let you build vehicles faster and more efficiently? Oops, I probably shouldn't have told you that

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser046Subtitle
values.text: *You've tripped our outer perimeter warning lasers, General. We know you're there now

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser047Subtitle
values.text: *I see you approaching my base, General. I wouldn't advise coming any closer

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser048Subtitle
values.text: *The enemy is in our base! All forces return and deploy lasers!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser049Subtitle
values.text: *Get away from my Reactors, General!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser050Subtitle
values.text: *General, those resources are for me--stay away from them

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser051Subtitle
values.text: *Attacking from the flanks, eh? It will take more than tactical tricks to beat me

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser052Subtitle
values.text: *Flanking attacks?! You are devious, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser053Subtitle
values.text: *Yes, come straight through my front-door, Generalif you dare

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser054Subtitle
values.text: *Be careful, General--the back-door of my base isn't so undefended as it seems

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser055Subtitle
values.text: *You are foolish to come here, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser056Subtitle
values.text: *These resources are not enough to save your failed strategy, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser057Subtitle
values.text: *No! Stay away! I need those reactors to power my lasers!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser058Subtitle
values.text: *Out of power?! How could you let your base run out of power?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser059Subtitle
values.text: *Running out of power is a fatal mistake, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser060Subtitle
values.text: *You're out of resources, General. You'll never recover before we overrun you

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser061Subtitle
values.text: *Out of resources?! This is unacceptable! Chinooks, gather faster!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser062Subtitle
values.text: *Sell that Scud Storm, General, or I'll destroy it for you

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser063Subtitle
values.text: *That Nuke Silo won't stop me, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser064Subtitle
values.text: *If you build a Particle Cannon and I destroy it with a Particle Beamis that irony?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser065Subtitle
values.text: *That excessive amount of base defenses will only slow down my laser, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser066Subtitle
values.text: *Your conventional tanks are no match for my laser based weapons platforms, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser067Subtitle
values.text: *That's quite a lot of planes, General. Are you putting on an air show?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser068Subtitle
values.text: *Quite a few infantry you've trained there, General. I can't wait to see this crazy plan

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser069Subtitle
values.text: *Your base is starting to look like a housing tract, General. Maybe I should play some connect-the-dots with the Particle Cannon to thin your numbers a bit

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser070Subtitle
values.text: *I will shoot those scud missiles down, General. Then you will pay

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser071Subtitle
values.text: *My lasers will bring that nuke down, General. The fallout will be on your hands

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser072Subtitle
values.text: *Particle Cannon?! I wonder what would happen if we crossed the beams

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser073Subtitle
values.text: *General, don't garrison that building; come out and play

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser074Subtitle
values.text: *General, Colonel Burton is a bumbling fool

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser075Subtitle
values.text: *Black Lotus is not invisible to my lasers, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser076Subtitle
values.text: *I hope Jarmen Kell isn't using a laser scope on his rifleit wouldn't work against me

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser077Subtitle
values.text: *Building an Air Field only provides airborne targets for my lasers, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser078Subtitle
values.text: *You're going to need a lot of tanks to get to me, General. Good luck

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser079Subtitle
values.text: *Building a Barracks will only get your men hurt, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser080Subtitle
values.text: *Selling off your structures eh? That the first mistake of a desperate general

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser081Subtitle
values.text: *What?! You can't be beating me! Your lack of precision alone should ensure my victory

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser082Subtitle
values.text: *I can't lose to you--you're a bumbling buffoon!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser083Subtitle
values.text: *How can you be winning? This isn't how it played out in the simulation

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser084Subtitle
values.text: *I've calculated every variable, yet you're winninghow is this possible?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser085Subtitle
values.text: *No! This can't be the end! What trickery did you use to beat me?!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser086Subtitle
values.text: *My planning a preparation is leading me to a clear victory

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser087Subtitle
values.text: *Precision will always defeat brute force, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser088Subtitle
values.text: *This must be like a nightmare for you, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser089Subtitle
values.text: *Have you decided how you are going to accept this defeat, General?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser090Subtitle
values.text: *You are defeated, General. But then that was never really in question, was it?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser091Subtitle
values.text: *Lasers charged--tracking targets now

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser092Subtitle
values.text: *You're not in my class, General--try an easier opponent

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser093Subtitle
values.text: *I calculate that you will lose this battle, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser094Subtitle
values.text: *Lasers make superior weapons

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser095Subtitle
values.text: *You defeated me, General, but I will scan your tactics and devise a superior strategy

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser096Subtitle
values.text: *Your weaknesses became obvious when I scanned your tactics

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser097Subtitle
values.text: *There you go, General--I've drawn the line in the sand

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Laser098Subtitle
values.text: *Now I dare you to cross it. Come and get me, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke001Subtitle
values.text: *At least it's a dry heat, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke002Subtitle
values.text: *Soon your base will glow like the sun

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke003Subtitle
values.text: *How do you expect to fight this, General?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke004Subtitle
values.text: *Your weapons are no match for my power!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke005Subtitle
values.text: *Melt! Everything must melt!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke006Subtitle
values.text: * The glow! The wonderful glow! Can't you see it, General?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke007Subtitle
values.text: *It looks like a nuclear winter this year, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke008Subtitle
values.text: *The end is near, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke009Subtitle
values.text: *This is only the beginning, General. The beginning of the end

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke010Subtitle
values.text: *Don't worry, General, the warheads are on their way

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke011Subtitle
values.text: *Sorry for the delay, General; just gathering my forces

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke012Subtitle
values.text: *Is the heat getting to you, General?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke013Subtitle
values.text: *Having a meltdown, General?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke014Subtitle
values.text: *All forces, prepare for the next assault

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke015Subtitle
values.text: *Now where did I put those launch codes?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke016Subtitle
values.text: *Are you ready for more, General?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke017Subtitle
values.text: *I think this is your half-life, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke018Subtitle
values.text: *I hope your radar isn't down, General; I'd hate for you to miss what's coming next

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke019Subtitle
values.text: *I know your weaknesses now, General. The next attack will be unstoppable

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke020Subtitle
values.text: *Soon you will know the glory of my nuclear arsenal

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke021Subtitle
values.text: *I'd stock up on sun-block if I were you, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke023Subtitle
values.text: *Eventually someone must win the arms race, or what's the point of racing?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke024Subtitle
values.text: *Time to put on the lead underwear

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke025Subtitle
values.text: *Remember: Don't look directly at the blast, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke026Subtitle
values.text: *It appears you have only trained your men to die, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke027Subtitle
values.text: *Now your War Factory is a glow crater. Wonderful

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke028Subtitle
values.text: *Your defenses crack like so many eggshells, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke029Subtitle
values.text: *Oh, you weren't in that Command Center, were you, General?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke030Subtitle
values.text: *Why do you destroy my barracks, General? It isn't my men you should fear

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke031Subtitle
values.text: *My War Factory! What have you done?! My precious tanksgone...

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke032Subtitle
values.text: *Leave me alone! What have I ever done to you?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke033Subtitle
values.text: *My Command Center! No!!! I won't lose command! I won't!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke034Subtitle
values.text: *I can't believe you are beating me! Perhaps you would give me a moment to rebuild?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke035Subtitle
values.text: *We have suffered great loses at your hands, General, but this isn't over yet

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke036Subtitle
values.text: *General, you can have that oil derrick, but it won't help you stop me

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke037Subtitle
values.text: *Get out of my base, General! I won't ask twice

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke038Subtitle
values.text: *How long were you planning on stay in my base, General? Should I prepare a bunk for you?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke039Subtitle
values.text: *Leave my base, General, or I will be forced detonate my warheads

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke040Subtitle
values.text: *Do you like my village, General? Please, make yourself at home

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke041Subtitle
values.text: *Coming to inspect the nukes, General? You can look, but don't touch

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke042Subtitle
values.text: *I'd be careful, General; these nuclear depots tend to leak

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke043Subtitle
values.text: *Get away from my supplies, General!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke044Subtitle
values.text: *General, I wouldn't capture that oil derrick if I were you--I'll only destroy it

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke045Subtitle
values.text: *Get away from my silos, General!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke046Subtitle
values.text: *I see your power is down, General. Should I send you some nuclear energy?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke047Subtitle
values.text: *Out of funds already? Don't you know war is expensive, General?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke048Subtitle
values.text: *Please, build more tanks, General; even they will melteventually

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke049Subtitle
values.text: *Keep those planes away from my silos!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke050Subtitle
