values.text: *So many soldiers, General. Do they have their radiation suits on?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke051Subtitle
values.text: *How many nukes do you think it will take me to destroy that new weapon, General?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke052Subtitle
values.text: *How many nukes do you think it will take me to destroy that new weapon, General?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke053Subtitle
values.text: *Selling off buildings? General, if you wanted to clear that area I could have done it for you

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke054Subtitle
values.text: *You cannot stand against my might, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke055Subtitle
values.text: *Surrender! Or do you want the bombing will continue?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke056Subtitle
values.text: *You are losing this war, General. A few more bombs and your base will fall!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke057Subtitle
values.text: *Might makes right. Wouldn't you agree, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke058Subtitle
values.text: *And now for my final attack. Hold on, General, you're going to like thiswait, no you won't

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke059Subtitle
values.text: *None will stand against our nuclear arsenal

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke060Subtitle
values.text: *Challenge me and your base will glow like the sun

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke061Subtitle
values.text: *Soon you'll be nothing more than nuclear waste

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke062Subtitle
values.text: *Another moment and I would have reduced you to dust

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke063Subtitle
values.text: *You are lucky to have survived this battle intact. Challenge me again if you dare

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke064Subtitle
values.text: *Welcome to the party, General. Please excuse the mess

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke065Subtitle
values.text: *Now, General, I think you understand why I am known as Mao the Nuke

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke066Subtitle
values.text: *We've been waiting for you, General. Please accept our gifts

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke067Subtitle
values.text: *More gifts, General. Our generosity is limitless

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke068Subtitle
values.text: *Now the battle begins in earnest. Prepare yourself, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke069Subtitle
values.text: *Cold fusion is no way to create power, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke070Subtitle
values.text: *It pains me to destroy your reactors, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke071Subtitle
values.text: *You call that a "super weapon", General? It breaks like a toy

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke072Subtitle
values.text: *No! My warheads! My beautiful warheads! You will pay, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke073Subtitle
values.text: *That's okay, General, I have more nukes for you

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke074Subtitle
values.text: *Hey, do you know how much that nuke silo costs?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke075Subtitle
values.text: *Okay, General, that's enough--I'm running out of nukes!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke076Subtitle
values.text: *Why do you want to blow-up my nukes anyway, General?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke077Subtitle
values.text: *No! That was my last nuclear silo! Why, General..why?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke078Subtitle
values.text: *(enemy lost all silo) You have destroyed all of my siloswhy, General? Why?!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke079Subtitle
values.text: *(enemy caps player barracks) I've captured your barracks, General. Perhaps I will sell it

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke080Subtitle
values.text: *(enemy caps player war factory) My men have captured your War Factory. You really should have guarded it better

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke081Subtitle
values.text: *(player base) Your defenses are weak, General; we have entered you base

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke082Subtitle
values.text: *(combat zone) My forces are in the field, General. Soon they will roll into your base

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke083Subtitle
values.text: *(supply dock area) Ah, we've found some supplies. Soon we will control all of the resources!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke084Subtitle
values.text: *(second supply dock area) More supplies for us. How are you funding your troops, General?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke085Subtitle
values.text: *(oil derrick area) Red Guard--capture that oil derrick!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke086Subtitle
values.text: *It appears we have used all the supplies in the area. I hope you've made other arrangements, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke087Subtitle
values.text: *(enemy out of power) What?! I'm out of power? How can I be out of power? Someone get me more power! Now!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke088Subtitle
values.text: *(ambulance) That ambulance will not save your men from the radiation

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke089Subtitle
values.text: *(strat center) A Strategy Center? What strategy could you possibly devise to fight me?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke090Subtitle
values.text: *(black market) The Black Market won't sell you anything powerful enough to stop me, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke091Subtitle
values.text: *(propaganda center) Your propaganda will not turn anyone against my nuclear power, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke092Subtitle
values.text: *Oh, look--I have a nuke ready for you

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke093Subtitle
values.text: *Wow, two nukes! I am pleased

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke094Subtitle
values.text: *Three nukes?!? That's three times the fun!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke095Subtitle
values.text: *Four nukes? Incredible!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke096Subtitle
values.text: *Five nukes? Maybe you want me to send you a clean pair of shorts now?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Nuke097Subtitle
values.text: *(player sells building) General, if you sell off any more buildings I'll win by default

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth001Subtitle
values.text: *Look at what I've found

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth002Subtitle
values.text: *Here comes my next attacktry to be ready this time, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth003Subtitle
values.text: *You can't kill what you can't see

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth004Subtitle
values.text: *You didn't need those troops anyways

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth005Subtitle
values.text: *Sleeping on the job again?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth006Subtitle
values.text: *hanks for the new units. They'll prove useful in destroying you

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth007Subtitle
values.text: *Watch this! Oh wait, you can't

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth008Subtitle
values.text: *Did you bring your thermal goggles?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth009Subtitle
values.text: *I think it's time to acquire a new base

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth010Subtitle
values.text: *It was never meant to be General. Good bye!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth011Subtitle
values.text: *Closing your eyes will not make the pain of defeat any easier

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth012Subtitle
values.text: *My stealth assassins will make short work of your forces, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth013Subtitle
values.text: *We will strike like the snake--quick and invisible

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth014Subtitle
values.text: *You will not stand against this attack, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth015Subtitle
values.text: *Handsome Generals always win battles

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth016Subtitle
values.text: *You'll never see me until it is too late , General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth017Subtitle
values.text: *General, perhaps you could introduce me to Black Lotus. I'm a great admirer of heruh, work

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth018Subtitle
values.text: *When it is quiet you should fear me the most

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth019Subtitle
values.text: *I can't wait for your next attack, General. Can we expect it today?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth020Subtitle
values.text: *Don't let your senses grow dull, General--you can expect my attack any moment now

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth021Subtitle
values.text: *You can't defeat me, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth022Subtitle
values.text: *I will attack when you least expect it, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth023Subtitle
values.text: *My men are all over the battlefield, General...hidden from viewready to strike

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth024Subtitle
values.text: *Stealth is my allyand your enemy

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth025Subtitle
values.text: *You've lost your Tech Building, General. What shall you lose next?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth026Subtitle
values.text: *You could not stop me from destroying you Barracks, General. What do you value if not your men?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth027Subtitle
values.text: *Destroying you War Factory was child's-play. Your Command Center can't be far behind

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth028Subtitle
values.text: *Your planes have lost their Air Field, and you have lost your advantage, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth029Subtitle
values.text: *There is a hole in your defenses now, General. Who can say how many of my men are in your base now

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth030Subtitle
values.text: *Your Command Center is gone, General. My victory is all but assured

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth031Subtitle
values.text: *I don't relish destroying your buildings, General, but you leave me no choice

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth032Subtitle
values.text: *You are targeting my Tech Buildings because you have no hope of reaching my base

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth033Subtitle
values.text: *You have destroyed my Barracks, but we will rebuild and those men will be avenged

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth034Subtitle
values.text: *My Arms Dealer will not be pleased that you destroyed his depot, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth035Subtitle
values.text: *You have destroyed that base defense, General, but that just may have allowed my men time to out-flank you

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth036Subtitle
values.text: *You've destroyed many of my buildings, but with even one factory left I am a dangerous opponent, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth037Subtitle
values.text: *Nicely played, General; you've destroyed my Command Center. Now I will be forced to fight dirty

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth038Subtitle
values.text: *You're quite adept at discovering my camouflaged vehicles, General. I'll consider a new tactic

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth039Subtitle
values.text: *Your brutish tactics are costing me men, General. I'll reconsider my tactics now that I know you have none

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth040Subtitle
values.text: *Now that I've captured this Oil Derrick, my forces will grow even faster

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth041Subtitle
values.text: *Artillery Platforms are so brutish, but I can't let you have it, can I?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth042Subtitle
values.text: *This Oil Refinery is now mine, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth043Subtitle
values.text: *General, you are coming dangerously close to my base

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth044Subtitle
values.text: *I see forces approaching my base, General. You don't mean to invade do you?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth045Subtitle
values.text: *You are testing my patience, General. Remove you forces from my base

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth046Subtitle
values.text: *If you do not remove your forces from my base, I'll remove them permanently

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth047Subtitle
values.text: *So you're trying to enter my base from the flank. We'll put a stop to that

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth048Subtitle
values.text: *A back-door attack? I didn't realize you were so devious, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth049Subtitle
values.text: *A frontal assault? That will prove a fatal mistake, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth050Subtitle
values.text: *Those are my resources, General--go find your own

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth051Subtitle
values.text: *Why do you insist on approaching my base that way, General?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth052Subtitle
values.text: *That route is not as unguarded as it seems, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth053Subtitle
values.text: *The only thing you will find here is your own destruction, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth054Subtitle
values.text: *What is your fascination with this area, General?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth055Subtitle
values.text: *We are nearing your base, General. There may be cross-hairs on your head right now

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth056Subtitle
values.text: *Your outer defenses are weak, General. Let's hope you base is better protected

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth057Subtitle
values.text: *We have entered you base, General. Ignore us at your own peril

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth058Subtitle
values.text: *Your defenses are broken, General. How will you repel us now?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth059Subtitle
values.text: *You really should be defending these resources, General, or this battle will be very short

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth060Subtitle
values.text: *I've found your Tech Buildings, General. What should I do with them?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth061Subtitle
values.text: *I've found the back-door to your base, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth062Subtitle
values.text: *Can you defend against my flanking attack, General? Let's find out

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth063Subtitle
values.text: *Only a careless general would allow the power to fail

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth064Subtitle
values.text: *Your power is down, General. You did not plan your infrastructure properly. Let's hope it isn't a fatal mistake

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth065Subtitle
values.text: *General, you can't fight without resources. What will you do now?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth066Subtitle
values.text: *You have robbed me of my resources, General. Now I will return the favor

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth067Subtitle
values.text: *So, you have built a Scud Storm. We will have to deal with this new threat

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth068Subtitle
values.text: *Nuclear weapons have no place in this battle, General. Why do you insist on building them?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth069Subtitle
values.text: *You would strike at me from space with your cowardly Particle Cannon? I am disappointed, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth070Subtitle
values.text: *So many base defenses, General. What are you afraid of?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth071Subtitle
values.text: *You're building tanks, are you. Well, a few more sniper should take care of that

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth072Subtitle
values.text: *More planes? Why so many, General? Afraid to come down and face me?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth073Subtitle
values.text: *Let me give you some advice, General. That large group of infantry is no match for my snipers

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth074Subtitle
values.text: *Your base has grown so large, General. Do you think you can defend all your buildings from capture?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth075Subtitle
values.text: *You've launched! You'll regret using that Scud Storm, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth076Subtitle
values.text: *Nuclear missiles! I thought you were bluffing, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth077Subtitle
values.text: *Yes, look at the cowardly particle beam. Enjoy this, General--my answer will be swift and brutal

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth078Subtitle
values.text: *By all means, General, garrison that buildingmy snipers can possibly hit them in there

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth079Subtitle
values.text: *Colonel Burton, General? Perhaps you should make him the general; you'll only lead him to an early grave

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth080Subtitle
values.text: *Ah the beautiful Black Lotus. Perhaps after you're defeated, General, she'll agree to join me

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth081Subtitle
values.text: *Jarmen Kell?! All snipers beware: Jarmen Kell has entered the field

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth082Subtitle
values.text: *Wise choice, building an Air Field, but planes alone will not be enough to defeat me, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth083Subtitle
values.text: *My spies tell me you've finally built your War Factory, General. Are you ready to fight now?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth084Subtitle
values.text: *Train all the men you wish from that Barracks, General; they are no match for my snipers

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth085Subtitle
values.text: *You've sold-off one of your buildings. Such tactics lead to defeat, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth086Subtitle
values.text: *How are you defeating my forces?! It's not possible!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth087Subtitle
values.text: *You may have the upper-hand now, but your desperate tactics will not endure, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth088Subtitle
values.text: *My forces will rise up against your oppression and we will defeat you, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth089Subtitle
values.text: *Enjoy your advantage for now, Generalyou'll make a mistake soon and I'll turn the tide of this battle

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth090Subtitle
values.text: *So it endsyou've defeated me, General, but someday I'll have my revenge. Watch your back, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth091Subtitle
values.text: *Your forces are weakening, General. Accept defeat and I'll go easy on you

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth092Subtitle
values.text: *Your attacks are ineffective against me, General. Soon we'll sweep in and destroy you

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth093Subtitle
values.text: *I'm enjoying this little game, General, but your pathetic attacks are beginning to bore me

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth094Subtitle
values.text: *I thought you would provide more of a challenge, General. I guess I overestimated you

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth095Subtitle
values.text: *You have fallen to Kassad, like all have before you

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth096Subtitle
values.text: *We will strike like the snake--unseen and deadly

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth097Subtitle
values.text: *Now you see me--now you're dead

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth098Subtitle
values.text: *I am Kassad

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth099Subtitle
values.text: *This will not go well for you, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth100Subtitle
values.text: *My men will not accept this defeat from their leader, General. You have signed my death warrant with your superior tactics

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth101Subtitle
values.text: *Accept your bitter defeat and remove yourself from my sight, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth102Subtitle
values.text: *And another who stood against me falls

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth103Subtitle
values.text: *And so it will be for you, General--no warning, no mercy

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Stealth104Subtitle
values.text: *You still have time to flee with your life, General. <evil laughter trailing off to silence>

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank001Subtitle
values.text: *I see you haven't run in fear, General. Soon you'll wish you had

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank002Subtitle
values.text: *My forces are at your door, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank003Subtitle
values.text: *The iron dragon marches through your puny defenses

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank004Subtitle
values.text: *I fear this will end you, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank005Subtitle
values.text: *Mmmcan you feel the thunderous song of approaching armor, General?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank006Subtitle
values.text: *Are you protecting your flanks, General? Why don't we have a look

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank007Subtitle
values.text: *Are you impressed with the modifications to my tanks, General?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank008Subtitle
values.text: *Armor...crush them

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank009Subtitle
values.text: *Soon, the field will fill with tanksmy tanks

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank010Subtitle
values.text: *All units...attack

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank011Subtitle
values.text: *Nice base, Generalcare to surrender it?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank012Subtitle
values.text: *This spells your doom, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank013Subtitle
values.text: *We're in your base, General; your defenses were inadequate

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank014Subtitle
values.text: *You dare attack my War Factory! All forces, remove this pest!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank015Subtitle
values.text: *Tanksbuild more tanks

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank016Subtitle
values.text: *Another battalion is on its way, General, please make them feel welcome

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank017Subtitle
values.text: *Ah, this is the part of the battle I enjoy the mostthe part just before I finish off my enemy

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank018Subtitle
values.text: *Tanks: move fasterbefore our opponent considers an actual attack

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank019Subtitle
values.text: *It's quiet out there, General. There must be a lot of tanks rolling towards your base, don't you think?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank020Subtitle
values.text: *I'm going to take this time to construct more defensesno, wait, I'll build more tanks instead

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank021Subtitle
values.text: *This area was once fertile farm land. Soon your blood will make it fertile again

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank022Subtitle
values.text: *Your tactics amuse me, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank023Subtitle
values.text: *Enjoy the rest, General--soon the attacks will begin again

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank024Subtitle
values.text: *We're awaiting your assault, General, but I'm beginning to wonder if it will ever come

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank025Subtitle
values.text: *Our War Factories are working hard to make more tanks, just for you, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank026Subtitle
values.text: *How much longer can you survive such loses, General? Perhaps it is time to consider surrender

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank027Subtitle
values.text: *Tanks amass in our base, preparing for the final assault. Will your defenses hold this time?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank028Subtitle
values.text: *Soon we will remove you from our lands

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank029Subtitle
values.text: *This will be your last chance to prove yourself, General. Soon my tanks will end your pitiful army

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank030Subtitle
values.text: *You cannot believe your luck will hold out much longercan you, General?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank031Subtitle
values.text: *You didn't want that Tech Building, did you?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank032Subtitle
values.text: *Your Barracks has fallen to my tanks, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank033Subtitle
values.text: *There goes your factory, General. How will you match my armor now?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank034Subtitle
values.text: *Without your airfield you've lost your only chance against me, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank035Subtitle
values.text: *Your defenses fall like toys before my armor

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank036Subtitle
values.text: *You can't lost your Command Center and all hope to win against me, General. I await your surrender

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank037Subtitle
values.text: *You've lost a lot of buildings, Generalisn't it time to surrender?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank038Subtitle
values.text: *That tech building was mine, General; you will regret destroying it

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank039Subtitle
values.text: *So, you've destroyed my Barracks--so be it. Now I will destroy yours

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank040Subtitle
values.text: *We will rebuild that War Factory. Soon the tanks will again flow to your base like water

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank041Subtitle
values.text: *Destroying my Airfield will not stop me, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank042Subtitle
values.text: *Destroying my defenses only let's me know where you are, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank043Subtitle
values.text: *General, you are destroying an unacceptable number of my buildings. This must stop

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank044Subtitle
values.text: *You've destroyed my Command CenterI am impressed, General...few survive this long

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank045Subtitle
values.text: *You're shooting at my planes?! Do you think this is the best tactic against me, General?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank046Subtitle
values.text: *Enough! Do not destroy any more of my tanks, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank047Subtitle
values.text: *Stop targeting my infantry, you coward!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank048Subtitle
values.text: *General, I need that Oil Derrick for my tanks. Release it to me or pay

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank049Subtitle
values.text: *That Artillery Platform is no match for my armor, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank050Subtitle
values.text: *Ah, I see you captured an Oil Refinery. Perhaps I should take it from you

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank051Subtitle
values.text: *We are approaching you base, General. Prepare yourself

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank052Subtitle
values.text: *Ah, my tanks are almost in range of your base. This should be over soon

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank053Subtitle
values.text: *We've breached your defenses, General. Now your factories will begin to fall

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank054Subtitle
values.text: *Thank you for inviting us into your base, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank055Subtitle
values.text: *I see your flank is exposed, General. I expected as much

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank056Subtitle
values.text: *There are no guards at your backdoor--a fatal mistake on your part, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank057Subtitle
values.text: *I see you've built a second base, General. It will soon be removed

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank058Subtitle
values.text: *Ah, I've found your Tech Building. Now, should I destroy it or capture it?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank059Subtitle
values.text: *Your power is down--your forces are finished

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank060Subtitle
values.text: *I would suggest restoring your power, Generalbefore we turn it off permanently

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank061Subtitle
values.text: *Your supply pile looks lownow nothing can stop us

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank062Subtitle
values.text: *Supplies! I need more supplies!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank063Subtitle
values.text: *And what you plan to do with that Scud Storm, General?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank064Subtitle
values.text: *And now this war has gone nuclearexcellent

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank065Subtitle
values.text: *That Particle Cannon will never live to fire on me

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank066Subtitle
values.text: *So many base defenses, Generalall so useless

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank067Subtitle
values.text: *So, you're trying to match my tanks in the field. I question your tactics, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank068Subtitle
values.text: *I see many planes, General--like gnats waiting to be swatted out of the sky

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank069Subtitle
values.text: *You have trained too many men, General; they will all be crushed beneath my treads

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank070Subtitle
values.text: *Your base has grown too large, General--my tanks will enjoy the target practice

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank071Subtitle
values.text: *Your Scud Storm will harm us, but now you have made me angry, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank072Subtitle
values.text: *Only a failed General would resort to nuclear missiles

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank073Subtitle
values.text: *This particle beam will not defeat us, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank074Subtitle
values.text: *Yes, garrison your buildings--you only delay the inevitable

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank075Subtitle
values.text: *No one soldier can turn the tide, not even Colonel Burton

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank076Subtitle
values.text: *Ah, Black Lotus, you grace us with your presence. Perhaps you would consider fighting for me

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank077Subtitle
values.text: *All tanks beware: Jarmen Kell has entered the field

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank078Subtitle
values.text: *An Air Field is a wise choice against me, but it won't save you from defeat, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank079Subtitle
values.text: *Build your War Factories, General; they still will not produce tanks capable of stopping mine

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank080Subtitle
values.text: *I see you've built a Barracks, General. Please, try to keep your men out from under my tanks

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank081Subtitle
values.text: *Yes, sell all of your buildings and flee from the field, General. This battle is lost to you

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank082Subtitle
values.text: *You are losing, General. This battle is mine

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank083Subtitle
values.text: *All hope is gone now, General. Surrender or die

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank084Subtitle
values.text: *General, my forces outnumber yoursit is only a matter to time now

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank085Subtitle
values.text: *Your inferior strategy has lead you to this place, General. You can't win now

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank086Subtitle
values.text: *My victory was assured from the beginning

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank087Subtitle
values.text: *Your tactics have given you a momentary advantage,General, but you won't maintain it

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank088Subtitle
values.text: *No! You will not win, General. We will build more tanks and defeat you

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank089Subtitle
values.text: *Your cowardly tactics may have gotten you this far, but this foolishness ends now

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank090Subtitle
values.text: *I think I've let you win long enough, General. Prepare for the end

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank091Subtitle
values.text: *Arrrrrgh! This cannot be! How have you defeated my tanks?!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank092Subtitle
values.text: *Time to unleash the war machine

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank093Subtitle
values.text: *Your tank rush is nothing compared to mine

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank094Subtitle
values.text: *Don't challenge my tanks, General--you will lose

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank095Subtitle
values.text: *My armor will crush your pathetic forces

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank096Subtitle
values.text: *You may have defeated my tanks, General, but the Tigress will crush you like an insect

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank097Subtitle
values.text: *Tanks are the key to any victory, as you well know

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank098Subtitle
values.text: *I see you defeated my scouts, General. The next attack won't go so well for you, I think

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank099Subtitle
values.text: *Here we come, General, I hope your defenses are up

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank100Subtitle
values.text: *And these are just my Battlemasters, Generaljust wait until the Overlord join the battle

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Tank101Subtitle
values.text: *I'd be careful, General, sometimes the Red Guard like to take over buildings while you're busy with my tanks

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin001Subtitle
values.text: *I see you!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin002Subtitle
values.text: *One taste, and you'll never go back -- even if you wanted to!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin003Subtitle
values.text: *Have a taste of my own medicine!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin004Subtitle
values.text: *How long can you hold your breath?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin005Subtitle
values.text: *Ready for another chemistry lesson?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin006Subtitle
values.text: *It's not so bad. You should only feel a long and painful burning after this!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin007Subtitle
values.text: *Toxin troopers, attack!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin008Subtitle
values.text: *Here we come, General, like a chemical spill

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin009Subtitle
values.text: *It's so hard to find a doctor that makes housecalls, but Dr. Thrax does

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin010Subtitle
values.text: *Spill on isle one!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin011Subtitle
values.text: *Like acid rain, we decend upon your base, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin012Subtitle
values.text: *Go forth, my toxic warriors! Bring our message to the masses!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin013Subtitle
values.text: *Oh, you're going to like this, General. No, waitno you won't

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin014Subtitle
values.text: *You've brought this on yourself, General. Now watch your men pay for your mistake

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin015Subtitle
values.text: *Silent but deadly

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin016Subtitle
values.text: *That's right -- sit back and relax! Give my toxins more time to work!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin017Subtitle
values.text: *The suspense it's killing you!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin018Subtitle
values.text: *Time to brew another batch!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin019Subtitle
values.text: *Every moment you delay, you die a little bit more!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin020Subtitle
values.text: *You can tell they're just right when the flesh falls off the bone!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin021Subtitle
values.text: *Anthrax it does a body bad

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin022Subtitle
values.text: *Smell that? No?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin023Subtitle
values.text: *And breathe in out and again feel better?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin024Subtitle
values.text: *Good to the last drop!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin025Subtitle
values.text: *I'll give you a "breather" before our next attack

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin026Subtitle
values.text: *We have a clogged toxin nozzle, Generalgive me a second to fix it

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin027Subtitle
values.text: *You'll come for the toxin, but you'll staybecause you're dead!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin028Subtitle
values.text: *You will regret intruding on my experiments, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin029Subtitle
values.text: *Are you going to attack me, or are you afraid of what you might find at my base, General?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin030Subtitle
values.text: *Nothing can live beneath my toxic cloud, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin031Subtitle
values.text: *You didn't really need that anyway

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin032Subtitle
values.text: *Your troops appear intoxicated, General!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin033Subtitle
values.text: *Ohh general, looks like your troops can't hold their toxin

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin034Subtitle
values.text: *Your Air Field is destroyed, General. Now you'll have to walk through my clouds of death

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin035Subtitle
values.text: *Notice how the toxins tear everything apart?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin036Subtitle
values.text: *Argh! I had my wine collection in there!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin037Subtitle
values.text: *My toxins and your troops certainly have chemistry!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin038Subtitle
values.text: *I didn't need that anyway!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin039Subtitle
values.text: *Now where will my chemical soldiers come from?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin040Subtitle
values.text: *My toxin trucks will roll again!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin041Subtitle
values.text: *See, people don't belong in the air

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin042Subtitle
values.text: *You inconvenience me, General!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin043Subtitle
values.text: *Stop destroying my buildings, General, or I will make thingsunpleasant for you

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin044Subtitle
values.text: *You've destroyed my Command Center! Ah well, I always hated my commanders anywaynow it's just you and me, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin045Subtitle
values.text: *General, if you keep destroying my vehicles, how can I bring you your medicine?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin046Subtitle
values.text: *My brave warriors! How can you do this to them? What did they ever do to-- oh wait, never mind

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin047Subtitle
values.text: *Give that Oil Derrick back! Don't you know petroleum is a key ingredient in my toxins?!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin048Subtitle
values.text: *That Artillery Platform will not stop me, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin049Subtitle
values.text: *General, I need that Refinery to purify my toxins. What could you possibly need it for?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin050Subtitle
values.text: *Did I give you permission to come in?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin051Subtitle
values.text: *What are you doing in here? The recipes are mine!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin052Subtitle
values.text: *You are a fool to come into my base, General!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin053Subtitle
values.text: *You are too close to my precious toxins, General. Now you must die

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin054Subtitle
values.text: *Stay away from my scud missiles! I'll give them to you when I'm ready!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin055Subtitle
values.text: *I don't think you want those supplies, they aren't  ready yet

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin056Subtitle
values.text: *I see you're building another base. Soon it will be abandoned

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin057Subtitle
values.text: *Get out of my village, General. There's not much left of it, but it is mine!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin058Subtitle
values.text: *Be careful as you cross that bridge, General--the water below isn't safe for swimming

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin059Subtitle
values.text: *Watch out, General, that bridge might not be safebut then, what is around here?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin060Subtitle
values.text: *Do you think you're being clever, sneaking in my backdoor?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin061Subtitle
values.text: *So, you've made it across the river. Now the battle gets interesting

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin062Subtitle
values.text: *It looks like you're out of power, General. Perhaps I should attack now

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin063Subtitle
values.text: *You're out of power, General. It's time for me to come and play

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin064Subtitle
values.text: *Your resource pile has grown small,General. I don't think you have enough left to stop my next attackexcellent

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin065Subtitle
values.text: *Budget?! I don't want to hear about the budget!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin066Subtitle
values.text: *You dare to build a Scud Storm in my presence! You know, of course, that we are all immune to its toxins, right, General?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin067Subtitle
values.text: *A Nuke Silo? I would not have expected you to use toxic radiationperhaps we could work together sometime

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin068Subtitle
values.text: *So, a Particle Cannon to counter my toxins, eh? Your technology is no match for my toxins, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin069Subtitle
values.text: *So many defenses, General. ALL USELESS!!!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin070Subtitle
values.text: *Metal is only a temporary barrier to my toxins!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin071Subtitle
values.text: *Ah -- coward! Your pilots still need to breathe!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin072Subtitle
values.text: *Do you enjoy seeing your men glow in the dark? Build more, then!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin073Subtitle
values.text: *Your base has grown large, Generala perfect target for my Scud Storm

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin074Subtitle
values.text: *Yes, fire your Scud Stormvisit your useless toxins upon my base

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin075Subtitle
values.text: *Your nuclear missile will only mutate us and make us stronger, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin076Subtitle
values.text: *You cannot hope to clear my toxins with that particle beam, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin077Subtitle
values.text: *Yes, garrison that building--I'm sure my Toxin Tractors will love that

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin078Subtitle
values.text: *If you bring Colonel Burton into this I'll have to release Jarmen Kell

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin079Subtitle
values.text: *Black Lotus? You know, of course, that the black lotus is a poisonous flowerI think that's in one of my toxinsbut I digress

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin080Subtitle
values.text: *I see Jarmen Kell has joined our little war. Perhaps mine would enjoy a sniper duel

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin081Subtitle
values.text: *Now what do you want with that Air Field, General?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin082Subtitle
values.text: *So our General builds a War Factory. How predictable of you

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin083Subtitle
values.text: *Yeeesss, build a Barracks--send you men to me

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin084Subtitle
values.text: *Sell off allyour buildings, Generaland send your men to me

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin085Subtitle
values.text: *Give up now, and I guarantee you'll breathe easy

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin086Subtitle
values.text: *Your troops are short of breath, General. Give up!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin087Subtitle
values.text: *My second wind spells your doom, General!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin088Subtitle
values.text: *Let me drown your sorrows with a nice toxin!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin089Subtitle
values.text: *Toxic Fatality

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin090Subtitle
values.text: *You are defeated, General. Perhaps this will teach you to defy Dr. Thrax

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin091Subtitle
values.text: *Would you consider a peace offering? An antidote, perhaps?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin092Subtitle
values.text: *Perhaps I've inhaled too many of my own toxins--You can't possibly be defeating me

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin093Subtitle
values.text: *Get away from me! You will not defeat me, General. Do you hear me!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin094Subtitle
values.text: *What do you have against toxins? Have you seen what they put in food these days?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin095Subtitle
values.text: *Even if you defeat me, my toxins will get to you -- eventually!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin096Subtitle
values.text: *No! No. I am defeated. Now where is that cyanide capsule

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin097Subtitle
values.text: *That button was covered with poisonyou're already dead

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin098Subtitle
values.text: *You dare select Dr. Thrax? You should reconsider, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin099Subtitle
values.text: *You cannot defeat my toxins, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin100Subtitle
values.text: *Perhaps I shouldn't have gotten my degree from a mail-order college

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin101Subtitle
values.text: *You thought my toxins were ineffective and now look what has happened to you, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin102Subtitle
values.text: *Hello, General. Do not think I cannot see your spies flying over my base. Please, look all you wish, because this may be the last time you ever see my stronghold

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin103Subtitle
values.text: *As you can see, my defenses are impenetrable...and my toxic weapon systems will poison your troops long before they can reach me

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin104Subtitle
values.text: *And do not worry about hurting the civilian population, General; they have long since fled this valley of toxic death. Our little war will play-out uninterruptedand your delicate sensibilities will not be taxed

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin105Subtitle
values.text: *Ah yes, and here is where you've placed your pathetic base. Now make your stand against me--Dr. Thrax--and once your forces have breathed their last breath of my toxic air, I can return to my experiments

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin106Subtitle
values.text: *Do you trust your senses, General? By engaging me, you have doomed yourself to a long and painful death, for I am Dr. Thrax, and my weapons strike unseen!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin107Subtitle
values.text: *Breathe easy, General, for I am Dr. Thrax, and with every breath you take, you are on your way to defeat!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin108Subtitle
values.text: *The first sample is free!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin109Subtitle
values.text: *Would you like the green or the blue? Both are equally satisfying!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin110Subtitle
values.text: *Prepare to tell your 3-eyed grandchildren of your defeat this day!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin111Subtitle
values.text: *My precious chemicals! Do you know how long it takes to mix those?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin112Subtitle
values.text: *More victi- ah- volunteers for my experiments!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin113Subtitle
values.text: *Now I have more vehicles to ferry my toxins! So generous of you!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin114Subtitle
values.text: *Oh, did I forget to tell you about those? Watch the mines, General!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin115Subtitle
values.text: *Now where did I put those chemical troops?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin117Subtitle
values.text: *Bah! You!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Toxin118Subtitle
values.text: *Ah yes, and here is where you've placed your pathetic base

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle001Subtitle
values.text: *Oh, you're still here, General. I'm impressed by your determination. Let's dance

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle002Subtitle
values.text: *That didn't hurt too much, did it?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle003Subtitle
values.text: *The battlefield is a rough place, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle004Subtitle
values.text: *Another perfectly executed strike

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle005Subtitle
values.text: *It's all going according to plan

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle006Subtitle
values.text: *Everything seems to be going my way

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle007Subtitle
values.text: *How does that feel, General?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle008Subtitle
values.text: *Tactical superiority is key, General. Here, let me show you

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle009Subtitle
values.text: *I really don't think you're going to be able to stop this next attackdo you?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle010Subtitle
values.text: *Here comes another attackoh, and almost all of my Generals Powers are ready to gowhich one do you want to see first?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle011Subtitle
values.text: *Is that my Superweapon ready to go? Oh no, my attacks just feel like that

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle012Subtitle
values.text: *All units: Attack pattern alpha! Just kiddingwho would call something "alpha"?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle013Subtitle
values.text: *Here comes some of my units, General. Would you mind helping them gain some veterancy?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle014Subtitle
values.text: *I rarely send in the troops, but you deserve special attention, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle015Subtitle
values.text: *I warn you not to underestimate me

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle016Subtitle
values.text: *You may think I'm hiding, but I'm really just planning

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle017Subtitle
values.text: *Fools rush in, General. I take my time

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle018Subtitle
values.text: *You don't know what to expect from me, do you?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle019Subtitle
values.text: *If you fail to plan, you plan to fail, General. Think about it

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle020Subtitle
values.text: *My greatest "super weapon" is my brainwouldn't you agree, General?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle021Subtitle
values.text: *Come on, General, take your best shot

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle022Subtitle
values.text: *We're waiting for you, General. What's keeping you?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle023Subtitle
values.text: *I've been analyzing you tactics and I'm just amazeddo you even have any tactics, General?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle024Subtitle
values.text: *I'd attack if I were you, General. If you wait then I'll just have one more Superweapon to fire at you

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle025Subtitle
values.text: *So, your over-all strategy is to bore me off the battlefield?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle026Subtitle
values.text: *Are you rethinking the wisdom of attacking me, General?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle027Subtitle
values.text: *I've been trying to go easy on you, General, but you're starting to annoy me

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle028Subtitle
values.text: *This has been fun, General, but I think it's time to end this

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle029Subtitle
values.text: *Maybe we should do this some other timewhen you're not so distractedat least, I hope that's what's wrong. You did say you were a "general", right?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle030Subtitle
values.text: *You weren't using that, were you?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle031Subtitle
values.text: *I didn't like the look of that Barracks, at all

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle032Subtitle
values.text: *Your vehicles are getting on my nerves

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle033Subtitle
values.text: *Stay out of the air, General--you'll be safer on the ground

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle034Subtitle
values.text: *Was that supposed to keep me out of your base, General?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle035Subtitle
values.text: *Wow, you just lost your Command Center. That's not very good, is it

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle036Subtitle
values.text: *Your base was much too cluttered before

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle037Subtitle
values.text: *You have no respect for other people's property!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle038Subtitle
values.text: *People, who was supposed to be guarding the Barracks!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle039Subtitle
values.text: *I was using that War Factory!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle040Subtitle
values.text: *Is keeping my air field too much to ask

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle041Subtitle
values.text: *I put that there for a reason!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle042Subtitle
values.text: *I had just gotten all of those buildings where I wanted them

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle043Subtitle
values.text: *I don't appreciate that kind of disrespect!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle044Subtitle
values.text: *I built all of those planes for a reason!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle045Subtitle
values.text: *Destroy as many vehicles as you like. See if I care

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle046Subtitle
values.text: *How dare you hurt my soldiers!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle047Subtitle
values.text: *I let you have that one

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle048Subtitle
values.text: *I didn't need that anyway

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle049Subtitle
values.text: *Capturing the Refinery? Why, General, I didn't know you were so efficiency conscious

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle050Subtitle
values.text: *Who invited you here?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle051Subtitle
values.text: *I don't think you have the right security clearance to be here

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle052Subtitle
values.text: *What gives you the right to be in my base?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle053Subtitle
values.text: *This is my base, get out now!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle054Subtitle
values.text: *Don't expect me to be a good hostess

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle055Subtitle
values.text: *I don't like unexpected visitors, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle056Subtitle
values.text: *What do you think you're doing here?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle057Subtitle
values.text: *Intruders!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle058Subtitle
values.text: *Your presence is starting to bother me, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle059Subtitle
values.text: *Who was supposed to be guarding that area?!?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle060Subtitle
values.text: *So you've managed to crack my defensesthat won't happen again

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle061Subtitle
values.text: *Get out of my base, General. Don't think I'm above dropping the Particle Cannon right here

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle062Subtitle
values.text: *It's looking a little dark in your base, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle063Subtitle
values.text: *Did someone forget to pay the electric bill?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle064Subtitle
values.text: *You didn't manage your resources very wisely, did you?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle065Subtitle
values.text: *You are pushing me over-budget, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle066Subtitle
values.text: *How could this have happened! I had everything planned so perfectly!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle067Subtitle
values.text: *Do you think I'm scared of your little Scud Storm?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle068Subtitle
values.text: *That Nuke Silo doesn't frighten me

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle069Subtitle
values.text: *I appreciate your choice in weaponry, but I'm the only one allowed to have a Particle Cannon on this battlefield

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle070Subtitle
values.text: *Is that as secure as your base can be? Is it?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle071Subtitle
values.text: *That's a lot of tanks, General. Have you seen what a Particle Cannon can do to a lot of tanks?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle072Subtitle
values.text: *All these planes are just air pollution to me

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle073Subtitle
values.text: *So many troops, General. You weren't actually planning to rush me with them were you?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle074Subtitle
values.text: *That's quite a base you have going there, General. You did remember to space out your buildings to avoid weapon strikes, right?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle075Subtitle
values.text: *Do you know how long it's going to take to clean that up?!?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle076Subtitle
values.text: *Get that disgusting radiation out of my base!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle077Subtitle
values.text: *Hey, that's my Particle Cannon! You're not authorized to use it!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle078Subtitle
values.text: *Is that a tactical move, or are you just hiding?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle079Subtitle
values.text: *Colonel Burton? Really? Do you think he's going to help you?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle080Subtitle
values.text: *Black Lotus? I guess it's just a girl-power showdown, isn't it?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle081Subtitle
values.text: *Jarmen Kell! He better stay away from my tanks!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle082Subtitle
values.text: *Nice Air Field, General--just keep those planes away from my Particle Cannon

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle083Subtitle
values.text: *A War Factory? You're seriously going to attack me, aren't you? It's about time

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle084Subtitle
values.text: *Good for you - you can build a barracks

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle085Subtitle
values.text: *Selling your buildings? Is that part of your going out of business sale?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle086Subtitle
values.text: *Why don't you just give up? I have better things I could be doing today

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle087Subtitle
values.text: *Why can't I ever find one that lasts more than 5 minutes

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle088Subtitle
values.text: *Looks like you're losing, General. Now what did I say about planning to fail?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle089Subtitle
values.text: *That's quite a beating you're taking, General. Are you ready for more?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle090Subtitle
values.text: *I'd like to say, "good fight," but clearly your mind wasn't in it, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle091Subtitle
values.text: *I can't believe you would beat-up on a girl like this

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle092Subtitle
values.text: *I need time to think. Go away, General!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle093Subtitle
values.text: *Your tactics are hardly sporting, General. Play nice!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle094Subtitle
values.text: *General, look over there! Someone is capturing your buildings! Didn't buy it, huh?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle095Subtitle
values.text: *You know, if you were a gentleman, you'd give me five minutes to rebuild my defenses

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle096Subtitle
values.text: *What?! It's over? Well, it was nice dancing with you, General. Maybe next time I'll lead

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle097Subtitle
values.text: *My Super Weapons are ready... are you?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle098Subtitle
values.text: *You'll never crack my defenses, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle099Subtitle
values.text: *Your rush tactics won't work on me

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle100Subtitle
values.text: *It's not fair! One more Super Weapon and I would have beaten you, General. Challenge me again, I dare you

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle101Subtitle
values.text: *I told you you'd never beat my Super Weapons, General. Care to try again?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle102Subtitle
values.text: *Welcome, General. Are you ready to begin?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle103Subtitle
values.text: *Oh, what's that sound? Now I see a light in the sky... Hmm

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle104Subtitle
values.text: *Oh my!

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle106Subtitle
values.text: *oh dearI'm sorry, General, but that's just how I like to say, "hello." Well, good luck, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle107Subtitle
values.text: *Well, good luck, General

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXChina001Subtitle
values.text: *The Americans use the Sentry Drone as an early warning enemy detection system. The drone becomes invisible when it is not moving, and we've seen some of them upgraded with machine guns. Though no match for tanks, the drone can cause problems for foot soldiers

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXChina002Subtitle
values.text: *The American Microwave Tank is a big microwave gun that disables structures and vehicles. The radiation from the tank can also hurt infantry, so keep our men at a safe distance

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXChina003Subtitle
values.text: *The Avenger is an American laser based anti-air vehicle able to shoot down missiles and aircraft. It also helps other US units target our planes, so they should be considered high priority targets when encountered within a battle group

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXChina004Subtitle
values.text: *The Specter Gunship is a large jet powered aircraft with multiple weapon systems fixed to its side enabling it to circle a target area and rain death from above. Typical American engineering--using a shotgun to swat a fly

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXChina005Subtitle
values.text: *The Chemical Suit upgrade, makes infantry more resistant to toxins and radiation

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXChina006Subtitle
values.text: *The US Countermeasures upgrade reduces the effectiveness of enemy fire against their air units. Missiles will often miss, and bullets do less damage

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXChina007Subtitle
values.text: *The US Hellfire Drone upgrade creates an remote air drone that defends the parent vehicle with an automated hellfire missile system

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXChina008Subtitle
values.text: *The Bunker Buster is an upgrade to the US Stealth Fighter and the Aurora designed to penetrate garrisoned buildings

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXChina009Subtitle
values.text: *The Supply Lines Upgrade increases the rate that the US gathers resources from supply docks, supply drops, and oil derricks

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXChina010Subtitle
values.text: *The US Generals have seen the wisdom of propaganda. By using a Leaflet Drop they are able to temporarily disable units while they stop to read the propaganda

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXChina011Subtitle
values.text: *The MOAB is an upgrade to the US Fuel Air Bomb that includes a stun ability, temporarily shutting down surviving units and structures

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXChina012Subtitle
values.text: *The US Fire Base structure is a defensive position surrounded by sandbags and includes a howitzer and 4 firing positions

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXChina013Subtitle
values.text: *The Napalm Bomb is an upgrade to our Helix airship, allowing it to drop a pair of bombs which create a large firestorm effect

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXChina014Subtitle
values.text: *Our Listening Outpost is a slow, stealthed vehicle with a large sight radius, that can be garrisoned with 2 infantry as guards. Besides uncovering stealthed objects, it can be used to determine enemy destinations by clicking on units in range

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXChina015Subtitle
values.text: *Our Helix 2 airship is a slow transport helicopter that can carry infantry or a single vehicle. Although armed with a light machine gun, it can be upgraded with the Gattling Cannon, Propaganda Tower, or Battle Bunker. It can also be upgraded to carry a large napalm bomb

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXChina016Subtitle
values.text: *The ECM Tank disrupts electronic tracking systems, diverting enemy missile fire. It's electro-magnetic pulse can be used to disable a single enemy vehicle. It also creates a radar jamming field that disables all drones within its range

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXChina017Subtitle
values.text: *The Neutron Shell is an upgrade to our Nuclear Cannon, allowing it to fire neutron shells. These shells kill all infantry, and vehicle pilots inside the blast radius

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXChina018Subtitle
values.text: *The Systems Hack allows your hackers to steal a random Generals power from our enemies. Level 1 allows theft of a 1-star or 3-star power, while level 2 allows theft of a 5-star power

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXChina019Subtitle
values.text: *Our new Carpet Bomber plane drops a series of bombs along a targeted path, decimating all enemy forces

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXChina020Subtitle
values.text: *Our Neutron Mines are an alternative to standard explosive mines. Neutron Mines instantly disable vehicles and kill any nearby infantry

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXChina021Subtitle
values.text: *Our hackers, once vulnerable to attack, will find safety and increased hacking ability in our new Internet Center

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXChina022Subtitle
values.text: *The Satellite Hack I is an internet Center upgrade that allows a reveal around every opponent's Command Center

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXChina023Subtitle
values.text: *The Satellite Hack II is an Internet Center upgrade that grants a temporarily reveals the entire map, including stealthed enemy forces

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXChina024Subtitle
values.text: *The GLA Saboteur is a stealth infantry unit that can climb cliffs and effect enemy buildings by entering them. Entering a power plant will temporarily cut power, while entering a superweapon will reset the timer. A saboteur who enters an enemy command center will reset the timers on all enemy General's Powers

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXChina025Subtitle
values.text: *The Combat Cycle initially comes with a GLA Rebel driver and a mounted machine gun. The Rebel can be replaced with any other GLA infantry, granting the cycle their unique powers

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXChina026Subtitle
values.text: *The GLA Battle Bus can hold up to 8 infantry, who fire out windows. If destroyed, the heavy steel cabin remains like a bunker

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXChina027Subtitle
values.text: *The GLA have upgraded their Workers with Shoes to squeeze even more forced labor from their peasants

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXChina028Subtitle
values.text: *The Camo Netting is an upgrade to GLA base defense structures, making them invisible to normal detection

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXChina029Subtitle
values.text: *The GLA have begun garrisoning Elite Guard troops equipped with RPGs in all their structures. Use caution when infiltrating any GLA bases

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXChina030Subtitle
values.text: *The GLA Booby Trap upgrade enables the rebel to wire structures and civilian vehicles to explode when the enemy attempts to capture or garrison them. Watch for Rebels lurking around buildings in your area

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXChina031Subtitle
values.text: *The GLA tricks have reached a new level. They are now building Fake Structures that look like their real buildings, but are only booby-trapped facades. Destroy everything from range to avoid any GLA surprises

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXChina032Subtitle
values.text: *The GPS Scrambler targets an area of units and makes them invisible to normal detection

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXChina033Subtitle
values.text: *The Sneak Attack power allows GLA Generals to place a defenseless tunnel network anywhere they have explored. Although slightly weaker than a normal tunnel, it is connected to the main network

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXChina034Subtitle
values.text: *The Artillery Platform is a fixed-position cannon capable of single-handedly controlling an area from enemy assault. It should be a priority capture on any battlefield

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXChina035Subtitle
values.text: *A Reinforcement Pad allows a free periodic armor airdrop. Free Battlemasters can turn the tide of any battle

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXChina036Subtitle
values.text: *The Repair Bay tech building, when captured, allows battlefield repairs for any ground vehicles. Repairs for damaged armor in a forward position can make the difference between victory and defeat

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXGLA001Subtitle
values.text: *Be careful of the American Sentry Drone, General; it can see stealthed units and often has a mounted gun

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXGLA002Subtitle
values.text: *The US Microwave Tank has a beam that disables structures and units. It should be attacked by large groups only

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXGLA003Subtitle
values.text: *The US Warlock Tank has a beam that disables structures and units. It should be attacked by large groups only

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXGLA004Subtitle
values.text: *The US Avenger is a powerful laser-base anti-air vehiclebut we have no planes, so the danger from it is minimal

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXGLA005Subtitle
values.text: *The American Specter Gunship is a large plane with big guns. Do not engage it--seek refuge underground until it leaves the area

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXGLA006Subtitle
values.text: *With the Chemical Suit upgrade, enemy infantry become more resistant to our toxins. But that won't stop our bullets, will it?

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXGLA007Subtitle
values.text: *The Countermeasures upgrade reduces the effect of enemy fire against US air units. Missiles will often miss, and bullets do less damage

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXGLA008Subtitle
values.text: *The US Hellfire Drone upgrade is a little toy plane with a missile attached. Another example of American's cowardly tactics

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXGLA009Subtitle
values.text: *The Bunker Buster Bomb is an upgrade to the US Stealth Fighter and the Aurora. They use it to try to attack our bunkers

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXGLA010Subtitle
values.text: *The Supply Lines Upgrade increases the rate that the US gathers resources from supply docks, supply drops, and oil derricks

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXGLA011Subtitle
values.text: *The US Leaflet Drop temporarily disables our units as they stop to read the propaganda

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXGLA012Subtitle
values.text: *The MOAB is an upgrade to the Fuel Air Bomb that includes a stun ability, temporarily shutting down surviving units and structures

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXGLA013Subtitle
values.text: *The Fire Base is the American answer to our Stinger sites...but watch out for the big cannon in the middle

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXGLA014Subtitle
values.text: *China's Napalm Bomb is a Helix upgrade, allowing it to drop a pair of bombs which create a large firestorm

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXGLA015Subtitle
values.text: *The Listening Outpost is a slow, stealthed vehicle the China uses to find our stealthed units. Avoid them to remain hidden

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXGLA016Subtitle
values.text: *China's Helix 2 is a slow transport helicopter that can carry infantry or a single vehicle

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXGLA017Subtitle
values.text: *The Chinese ECM Tank is a vehicle which disrupts electronic tracking systems, diverting enemy missile fire

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXGLA018Subtitle
values.text: *The Neutron Shell is an upgrade to the Chinese Nuke Cannon, allowing it to fire neutron shells. These shells kill all infantry, and vehicle pilots inside the blast radius

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXGLA019Subtitle
values.text: *China's new Systems Hack technique allows hackers to steal a random power from their enemies. Such is the downfall of depending on power to fight wars

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXGLA020Subtitle
values.text: *The Carpet Bomber is a plane that drops a series of bombs along a targeted path, decimating the enemy

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXGLA021Subtitle
values.text: *The Neutron Mines are an alternative to standard Chinese Mines which disable vehicles. The mines still kill infantry as well

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXGLA022Subtitle
values.text: *The Internet Center allows China's hackers to increase their effectiveness

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXGLA023Subtitle
values.text: *The Satellite Hack I is an internet Center upgrade that allows China to see every opponent's Command Center

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXGLA024Subtitle
values.text: *The Satellite Hack II is a Chinese Internet Center upgrade that grants a temporary reveal of the entire map, as well as revealing stealthed objects

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXGLA025Subtitle
values.text: *The Saboteur is a stealth unit that can climb cliffs and effect enemy buildings by entering them

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXGLA026Subtitle
values.text: *Our new Combat Cycle has mounted machine guns and is enhanced by the abilities of any infantry riding it

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXGLA027Subtitle
values.text: *The Battle Bus is a slow moving transport that can hold up to 8 infantry, who may fire out of the bus. If destroyed, the hull of the Battle Bus remains and functions like a bunker

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXGLA028Subtitle
values.text: *The Worker Shoes upgrade increase speed and gathering efficiency for all our loyal workers

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXGLA029Subtitle
values.text: *The Camo Netting is an upgrade to our base defense structures, allowing them to be stealthed

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXGLA030Subtitle
values.text: *The Elite Guard Upgrade is a structure ability, garrisoning the structure with 4 RPG Troopers

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXGLA031Subtitle
values.text: *The Booby Trap is an upgrade to the rebel, allowing the unit to wire structures and civilian vehicles to explode when the enemy attempts to capture or garrison them. Captured structures are automatically booby trapped

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXGLA032Subtitle
values.text: *Fake Structures can be built for a greatly reduced cost. These buildings are initially a booby-trapped façade, but can be upgraded to fully functional versions of the structure

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXGLA033Subtitle
values.text: *Our newly acquired GPS Scrambler targets an area of units and renders them invisible to enemies

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXGLA034Subtitle
values.text: *Our Sneak Attack allows placement of a defenseless tunnel network at any area that has been explored. Although slightly weaker than a normal tunnel, it is connected to the main network

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXGLA035Subtitle
values.text: *The Artillery Platform fires a weapon similar to the US Strategy Center in terms of range and damage. Capture or avoid its deadly cannon

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXGLA036Subtitle
values.text: *The Reinforcement Pad periodically delivers a group of Scorpion tanks for our cause

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXGLA037Subtitle
values.text: *The Repair Bay is a front-line repair facility for vehicles. It repairs vehicles like an Arms Dealer

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXUSA001Subtitle
values.text: *The Sentry Drone is a mobile unit capable of tracking enemy movements, including those that are camouflaged. The Sentry Drone itself is also capable of stealth when not moving, and may be upgraded with an anti-personnel machine gun from the strategy center

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXUSA002Subtitle
values.text: *The Microwave Tank is armed with a Direct-Energy microwave panel that disables targeted structures and vehicles. It also emits a continuous microwave field which damages infantry

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXUSA003Subtitle
values.text: *The Warlock tank is armed with a Direct-Energy microwave panel that disables targeted structures and vehicles. It also emits a continuous microwave field which damages infantry

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXUSA004Subtitle
values.text: *The Avenger is a laser based anti-air vehicle able to shoot down missiles and aircraft. It can also award bonuses to units attacking it's "painted" target

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXUSA005Subtitle
values.text: *The Specter Gunship is a large jet powered aircraft with multiple weapon systems fixed to it's wings. While it circles the target, it auto-acquires enemies. Manual targeting is allowed, and it can upgrade to deploy countermeasures

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXUSA006Subtitle
values.text: *With the Chemical Suit upgrade, infantry become more resistant to toxins and radiation

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXUSA007Subtitle
values.text: *The Countermeasures upgrade reduces the effect of enemy fire against US air units. Missiles will often miss, and bullets do less damage

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXUSA008Subtitle
values.text: *The Hellfire Drone upgrade equips the parent vehicle with a drone capable of firing a single missile. The drones auto-acquire and require time to reload

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXUSA009Subtitle
values.text: *The Bunker Buster is an upgrade to the Stealth Fighter and the Aurora. In addition to their normal effects, these upgraded missiles damage and even kill units garrisoned within structures, including the GLA Palace, Tunnel Network, and the Chinese Battle Bunker

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXUSA010Subtitle
values.text: *The Supply Lines Upgrade increases the amount of money gathered from supply docks, supply drops, and oil derricks

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXUSA011Subtitle
values.text: *The Leaflet Drop temporarily disables units as they stop to read the propaganda. The plane dispenses leaflets over the targeted area and the effect only lasts a short time

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXUSA012Subtitle
values.text: *The MOAB is an upgrade to the Fuel Air Bomb that includes a stun ability, temporarily shutting down surviving units and structures

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXUSA013Subtitle
