values.text: *The Fire Base is surrounded by sandbags and includes a howitzer and 4 firing positions. Infantry entering the Fire Base will take firing positions behind the sandbags

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXUSA014Subtitle
values.text: *The Napalm Bomb is a Helix upgrade, allowing it to drop a pair of bombs which create a large firestorm

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXUSA015Subtitle
values.text: *The Listening Outpost is a slow, stealthed vehicle with a large sight radius, and can be garrisoned with 2 infantry as guards. Besides uncovering stealthed objects, it can be used to determine enemy destinations by clicking on units in range

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXUSA016Subtitle
values.text: *The Helix 2 is a slow transport helicopter that can carry infantry or a single vehicle. Although armed with a light machine gun, it can be upgraded with the Gattling Cannon, Propaganda Tower, or Battle Bunker. It can also be upgraded to carry a large napalm bomb

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXUSA017Subtitle
values.text: *The ECM Tank is a vehicle which disrupts electronic tracking systems, diverting enemy missile fire. It's ECM pulse can be used to disable single enemy vehicles. Finally, it creates a radar jamming field, disabling all drones within its range

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXUSA018Subtitle
values.text: *The Neutron Shell is an upgrade to the Chinese Nuke Cannon, allowing it to fire neutron shells. These shells kill all infantry, and vehicle pilots inside the blast radius

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXUSA019Subtitle
values.text: *The Systems Hack allows your hackers to steal a random power from your enemies. Level 1 allows theft of a tier 1 or 3 power, while level 2 allows theft of a 5-star power

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXUSA020Subtitle
values.text: *The Carpet Bomber is a plane that drops a series of bombs along a targeted path, decimating the enemy

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXUSA021Subtitle
values.text: *The Neutron Mines are an alternative to standard Chinese Mines which disable vehicles. The mines still kill infantry as well

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXUSA022Subtitle
values.text: *The Internet Center allows hackers to increase their effectiveness at generating money, and allows the use of Satellite Hacks I & II

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXUSA023Subtitle
values.text: *The Satellite Hack I is an internet Center upgrade that allows a reveal around every opponent's Command Center

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXUSA024Subtitle
values.text: *The Satellite Hack II is an internet Center upgrade that grants a temporary reveal of the entire map, as well as revealing stealthed objects

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXUSA025Subtitle
values.text: *The Saboteur is a stealth unit that can climb cliffs and effect enemy buildings by entering them. Entering a power plant will temporarily cut power, while entering a superweapon will reset the timer. A saboteur who enters an enemy command center will reset the timers on all enemy General's Powers

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXUSA026Subtitle
values.text: *The Combat Cycle initially comes with a Rebel driver and a mounted machine gun. Replacing him with a RPG Trooper will allow the bike to fire missiles. A Terrorist will create a suicide bike. Jarmen Kell, Hijackers, and Saboteurs can also ride, making the bike stealthed

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXUSA027Subtitle
values.text: *The Battle Van is a slow moving transport that can hold up to 8 infantry, who may fire out of the bus. If destroyed, the hull of the Battle Van remains and functions like a bunker. If it is destroyed, anyone inside is also killed

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXUSA028Subtitle
values.text: *The Worker Shoes upgrade increase speed and gathering efficiency for all GLA workers

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXUSA029Subtitle
values.text: *The Camo Netting is an upgrade to GLA base defense structures, allowing them to be stealthed

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXUSA030Subtitle
values.text: *The Elite Guard Upgrade is an structure ability, garrisoning the structure with 4 RPG Troopers

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXUSA031Subtitle
values.text: *The Booby Trap is an upgrade to the rebel, allowing the unit to wire structures and civilian vehicles to explode when the enemy attempts to capture or garrison them. The explosion damages everything within a small radius. Structures captured by an upgraded rebel are automatically booby trapped

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXUSA032Subtitle
values.text: *Fake Structures can be built for a greatly reduced cost. These buildings are initially a booby-trapped façade, but can be upgraded to fully functional versions of the structure

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXUSA033Subtitle
values.text: *The GPS Scrambler targets an area of units and renders them stealthed to enemies

values.label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXUSA034Subtitle
values.text: *The Sneak Attack allows placement of a defenseless tunnel network at any area that has been explored. Although slightly weaker than a normal tunnel, it is connected to the main network
